plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Embed a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, with remote session listing and local/remote switching.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remote-gui

**在本地 DSH 窗口里，直接操作远端那台 DSH。** 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 GUI 嵌进本地界面，
把远端会话列进面板，并在 **本地实例 ↔ 远端** 之间一键切换。

**Embed a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in your local DSH window over an SSH tunnel,
list the remote sessions, and switch between the local instance and any remote host.**

> English version: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

---

## 这个插件解决什么

把 DSH 跑在 VPS 上是常见的做法：7×24 不关机、能挂 IM 插件（WhatsApp / Telegram…）、
手机随时能用。但**在电脑上用它**通常只剩两条路：开一个浏览器标签去访问远端地址，
或者干脆开两个窗口各用各的。

`dsh-remote-gui` 把第三条路做出来：**一个窗口，多个实例**。

- 侧栏页脚一个入口 → 面板里是**远端那台 DSH 的真实界面**（不是截图、不是只读视图）
- 面板同时列出**远端会话**，点开就能看
- 顶部在 **本地实例** 和 **任意一台远端** 之间切换 —— 同一套界面，换的是"在跟谁说话"

### 为什么不是 dsh-sev

`dsh-sev` 是最接近的既有插件（SSH 隧道 + 面板内 GUI），但它是按 **DSH 0.1.x** 写的，
在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上三个缺陷让它的核心功能不可用（实测）：

| 缺陷 | 现象 |
|---|---|
| 服务端替你去请求远端，但**不带远端浏览器凭据 cookie** | 一切远端请求 401：`SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'u', "unauthorized" is not valid JSON` |
| RPC **信封过时**（`/api/session.list` + `method:"session.list"` + `payload:{}`） | `404 not found`；改对路径后是 `gateway/bad-request` |
| `output.render` 返回**字符串**（0.2.x 要求 ContentBlock 数组） | agent 侧报 `content.some is not a function` |

（还有第四个：它的客户端 `inject` 里列了本机**不存在**的服务 `betterSidebar`，
而 cordis 的 `inject` 是必需依赖 —— 列一个永不出现的服务会让整个客户端半边不激活，
面板根本不会出现。）

本插件是用 0.2.x 的真实契约**独立实现**的，不依赖 dsh-sev，因此也不受它升级影响。

---

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **SSH 隧道管理** | `ssh -L <本地端口>:127.0.0.1:<远端端口> <别名>`；看门狗每 15s 检查并按需重连；本机重启后自动"收养"还在监听的隧道，不重复起 |
| **远端凭据自动兑换** | 远端 `dsh web` 每个 `/api` 都要求按 authority 绑定的浏览器 cookie。插件用 ssh 读远端的启动 token，经隧道换一次 cookie 并按主机缓存，收到 401/403 自动刷新重试 |
| **远端会话列表** | 走 `/api/session/list`（typert 信封），显示标题 / 最后活动 / cwd / 运行中。**默认只显示主会话**（按远端的权威字段 `parentSessionId` / `origin=subagent` 折叠子代理会话，另有少量按"自带 id 的空壳会话"启发式折叠），列表头给出一行「已隐藏 N 条子会话 · 显示全部」可一键切换 |
| **面板内嵌远端 GUI** | iframe 直连隧道地址。首次加载用**带 token 的 seedUrl**：那一次 303 会把凭据 cookie 种进浏览器，之后长期可用 |
| **本地 ↔ 远端切换** | 顶部一个选择器：`本地实例` 或任意已注册远端。本地模式走同源 `/api/session/list`，iframe 指向 `location.origin` |
| **会话归档** | 在面板里把远端会话归档掉（走 `workspace/archiveSession`） |
| **agent 工具 `remote_gui_run_task`** | 让本地 agent 通过 `ssh + dsh --profile headless` 在远端跑一次性任务并把结果带回来 |
| **诊断路由** | `/health`（隧道 + 远端可达性）、`/proxy`（透传任意远端路径） |

**边界**：远端需要跑着 `dsh --profile web`，且其 systemd 用户单元名为 `dsh-web`
（读启动 token 的命令依赖它；换名字改 `lib/index.js` 的 `remoteLaunchToken()`）。
本地端口从 5640 起分配（避开 dsh-sev 的 5636）。

---

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-remote-gui
```

从 GitHub 装（未发 npm 时）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:temotee2103/dsh-remote-gui
```

**宿主半边改完必须重启 DSH**（Node 的 ESM 缓存持有宿主模块）。客户端半边是热加载的。

---

## 用法

1. 侧栏**页脚**出现一个「远程」图标 → 点开面板
2. 填 **SSH 别名**（要在 `~/.ssh/config` 里配好，例如 `my-vps` 或 `100.69.133.94`）→ 添加
3. 主机行会从 `连接中` 变成 `已连接`；远端会话列表出现
4. 顶部切换 **本地实例 / 远端**；远端模式下 iframe 里就是那台机器的完整 GUI，可以直接在里面打字、点按钮

---

## 像 Hermes Agent / OpenClaw 那样用

这两个产品的共同形态是：**agent 跑在某台机器上，你在另一台机器上用完整界面控制它**。

- **OpenClaw** 的 Remote Access 文档里有一节就是 *Chat UI over SSH* ——
  把 gateway 留在远端，本地通过 SSH 用它的 Chat UI
  （[docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/remote](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/remote)）。
- **Hermes Agent** 的桌面端同样支持通过 SSH 连到远端实例。

`dsh-remote-gui` 把同样的形态带给 DSH：

| 角色 | 在 DSH 上怎么落地 |
|---|---|
| **控制台**（你手边这台） | 本地 DSH Desktop —— 你日常用、看得见的那个窗口 |
| **长驻执行体**（VPS / 家里的机器 / 云主机） | 远端 `dsh web`（systemd 常驻）+ 挂 IM 插件 |
| **两者之间的通道** | SSH（本插件自动维护隧道与凭据） |

于是可以做这几件以前要开好几个窗口的事：

- **一台控制台管 N 台**：把开发机、VPS、家里的迷你主机都注册进来，顶部切换即可，
  不用再记每个实例的地址、端口和 token
- **远端跑长的、本地看短的**：让远端挂着爬取 / 构建 / 定时任务，你在同一个窗口里
  顺手看它的会话，不用切窗口
- **随时接管**：远端 agent 卡住了，切过去直接在那个 iframe 里操作 —— 那是真界面，不是回放

---

## 和其它插件配合

| 配合对象 | 怎么配合 |
|---|---|
| **IM 插件**（`@xmanrui/dsh-im` 的 WhatsApp、Telegram 等） | **装在远端**。远端 7×24 接消息、自动回复；本地面板嵌着远端 GUI，于是**手机上的对话和你眼前的界面是同一个会话** —— 要接管、要改 prompt、要看它调了什么工具，直接在面板里操作 |
| **`dsh-remote-web-ui`**（扫码配对 + 手机适配） | 互补：那个给**手机/平板**（配对后竖屏适配层），这个给**桌面**（SSH 隧道 + 面板）。两个装同一台远端并不冲突 |
| **`@linxin666/dsh-ssh`** | 互补：那个给的是 **Web 终端 / SFTP / 端口转发**（"我要在远端敲命令"），这个给的是 **把远端 GUI 嵌进来 + 列远端会话**（"我要在远端用 DSH"）。端口段与路由都不同 |
| **`dsh-task-board`** | 远端装它 → 定时/子任务在远端跑；本地通过面板看远处那块看板 |
| 任何**只装在远端**的插件 | 都自动变得可用 —— 因为这个面板给的是远端的完整界面，不是本插件翻译过的子集 |

---

## 远端契约（0.2.x，全部实测）

```
兑换凭据   GET http://127.0.0.1:<隧道端口>/?token=<远端启动 token>
           → 303 + Set-Cookie: dsh-auth-<authority哈希>=<签名值>
           cookie 按 authority 绑定；远端重启后 cookie 仍有效（token 会变）

RPC        POST http://127.0.0.1:<隧道端口>/api/<ns>/<method>
           cookie: dsh-auth-…                      ← 必须，否则 401 "unauthorized"
           body: {"type":"client-request","rpcId":"…","method":"<ns>/<method>",
                  "payload":{"args":{"<参数名>":{…params…}}}}
           数据在 result.value；method 必须与 endpoint 完全一致（斜杠形式）

会话列表   /api/session/list，_request = {}   →   result.value.items[]
归档会话   /api/workspace/archiveSession，request = {sessionId}  →  result.value.archivedSessionIds[]

远端启动 token
           ssh <alias> journalctl --user -u dsh-web -n 400 --no-pager \
             | grep -oE 'token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2
```

四条容易踩的：

1. `method` 用**斜杠**形式（`session/list`），与 URL 末段一致；写成 `session.list` 会被拒：
   `method "session.list" does not match endpoint "session/list"`。
2. `payload` 必须是 `{"args":{…}}` —— 少一层就是
   `Remote payload must contain exactly one plain-object args field`。
3. ⚠️ **args 里那个 key 是"宿主方法的形参名"，不是固定字符串。** 曾经把这条写成"必须有
   `_request`"，结果归档会话静默失败。判定依据是安装目录里的 typert 描述符：
   `resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-<ns>-controller/lib/typert.host.js`
   的 `invocations[].parameters[].{name,wire}`。实测（2026-10-14，26 个 typert.host.js / 140 条
   invocation 全量核对）：`session/list` 是 `_request`（**唯一**带下划线的方法），
   `workspace/archiveSession` 与其余 `session/*` / `workspace/*` / `schedule/*` / `job/*` 等全是 `request`。
   用错的表现是 `result.ok=false` + `error.code='gateway/arguments-invalid'` +
   `missing "request"; unexpected "_request"`。插件里的登记表：`lib/remote.js` 的 `ARGS_KEY_BY_METHOD`。
4. **iframe 是浏览器自己发请求**，所以"把凭据 cookie 种进浏览器"这一步不能省 ——
   这就是 seedUrl 存在的理由（服务端拿不到浏览器那次请求的 cookie）。

---

## 路由（全部只允许 loopback，非 loopback 一律 403）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/hosts` | 主机列表（含 `tunnel`、`seedUrl`） |
| POST | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/hosts` | `{alias, name?, port?, localPort?, autoTunnel?}` |
| DELETE | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/host?id=` | 删除主机并停隧道 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/tunnel` | `{id, action:'start'\|'stop'}` |
| GET | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/sessions?id=` | 远端会话列表 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/session-archive` | `{id, sessionId}` |
| GET | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/seed?id=` | 带 token 的 iframe 入口地址 |
| GET | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/health?id=` | 隧道 + 远端可达性 |
| GET | `/api/dsh-remote-gui/proxy?id=&path=` | 透传远端路径（诊断用） |

主机注册表：`$DSH_HOME/remote-gui-hosts.json`。

---

## 验证记录

宿主半边用**独立进程加载 + 真实隧道 + 真实远端**直接调用它的路由处理器
（不依赖应用重启，见 [`docs/SPEC.md`](docs/SPEC.md) 的复现方式）：

```
隧道      1 秒起好 state=running                                   ✓
hosts     seedUrl=http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/?token=…                 ✓
sessions  HTTP 200 / 337 个远端会话                                ✓
health    HTTP 200 status=200                                      ✓
seed      HTTP 200 + 带 token 的地址                               ✓
非 loopback 请求 → 403 被拒                                        ✓
工具 render 返回 ContentBlock 数组（0.2.x 契约）                    ✓
```

客户端半边用桩 window/document/react 在 Node 里加载并调用 `apply(ctx)`：
模块加载无异常、`inject` 正确、注册进真实插槽 `sidebar.footer.action`。

未知项（诚实列出）：iframe 里的远端 GUI **需要浏览器允许同站 iframe** ——
harness 的已认证响应里既没有 `X-Frame-Options` 也没有 CSP `frame-ancestors`（实测），
所以这一层没问题；剩下的是宿主 Electron 会话是否会把那次 seed 的 cookie 存下 —— 
若你遇到 iframe 里显示 `dsh web authentication required`，告诉我，改用"隐藏 iframe 预热"的办法。

---

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zh-tw-ui

[繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) | **English**

Renders the **entire DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI in Traditional Chinese
(Taiwan)** — DSH's own copy, **third-party plugin copy**, and text that later DSH
versions add — by converting the DOM, not by shipping a language pack.

```
Settings -> General -> Language: 中文 (Simplified)   <- the app's own locale
What you actually see:           繁體中文（台灣）     <- converted on screen
```

Because it works at the render layer, it does not have the failure mode that
dictionary-based language packs have: *uncovered copy falls back to Simplified
Chinese and the UI looks half-translated.*

---

## The problem

DSH ships exactly two locales: `zh` (Simplified) and `en`. Using DSH in Taiwan
breaks in three places at once:

1. **DSH's own UI** is Simplified without a language pack;
2. **third-party plugins** (market, sidebar, IM bridges, Agent Teams, …) each ship
   their own Simplified dictionaries, which no language pack can reach;
3. **every DSH release adds copy**, so a language pack's dictionary is always one
   version behind.

This plugin attacks the shared root cause: whatever produced the text, it is
converted on screen.

## Goals / non-goals

**Goals**

| | |
|---|---|
| G1 | The whole page in Traditional Chinese: DSH itself, third-party plugins, and dynamic content that appears later |
| G2 | **Decoupled from the DSH version** — a DSH upgrade must not break it |
| G3 | **Touches no DSH internals**: no dictionary registration, no `LocaleRuntime` patching, no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer range — so DSH's compatibility gate can never skip it, and it coexists with other locale plugins |
| G4 | A clear safety boundary: code, editors and anything you type are **never** altered |
| G5 | Reversible, auditable, tunable (a runtime switch, an override table, a skip marker) |

**Non-goals**

- **Not a language pack**: no new entry in DSH's Language list, no change to DSH's
  locale setting.
- **No translation beyond Simplified → Traditional**: English is left alone, no
  model calls.
- **Does not change stored data** — see [Limitations](#limitations).
- **Web/desktop clients only**: no DOM in TUI or headless profiles.
- **Does not convert text painted into a canvas, or cross-origin iframes.**

---

## Why not just use another Traditional Chinese plugin?

This is the reason the project exists, so here is the honest version. All figures
were checked on **2026-10-13** from each package's npm manifest or repo README.

| Option | Mechanism | Covers third-party plugins | Relationship with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-better-locale` 0.4.3 | registers dictionaries (39 namespaces) | no | peer says `^0.1.5-rc.2` (excludes 0.2.x) → needs a manual exact-version exemption to load |
| `@mimateinn/dsh-i18n` 0.2.6 | dictionaries + Simplified→Traditional character fallback | yes | peer says `<0.2.0-0` → blocked by the compatibility gate without an exemption |
| `dsh-locale-zh-tw` (npm, 0.1.1) | patches `LocaleRuntime` internals | yes | documents itself against the `dsh-client-locale@0.1.1-rc.2` shape; **degrades silently** on mismatch |
| `dsh-multi-lang-ui` 0.1.1 | dictionaries + char table + DOM fallback | yes | peer has no upper bound, passes the gate — mechanically the closest to this project |
| `iceice666/dsh-locale-zh-tw` | dictionaries only (50 ns / 1691 strings) | no (by design, per its README) | — |
| **dsh-zh-tw-ui** (this project) | **pure DOM conversion** | yes | **no peer dependencies, touches no DSH API** |

Each existing approach has a structural weakness:

1. **Dictionary-based** (better-locale, iceice666) — coverage is frozen at the
   upstream version the pack was built against. Measured on this machine:
   better-locale 0.4.3 ships 39 namespaces while DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 registers about 49
   core namespaces, and **17 of them have no Traditional dictionary at all**
   (`pluginManager`, `permission`, `settings.shell`, `settings.webSearch`,
   `agent-team`, `voice-input`, `schedule.manager`, …). Worse, its fallback chain
   is `zh-TW → zh → en`, so the gaps render in **Simplified, not English** — which
   is exactly why a language pack can look like "it installed but nothing
   happened".
2. **Core-patching** (the npm `dsh-locale-zh-tw`) — tightly coupled to DSH
   internals and *designed* to degrade silently: after a DSH update it can simply
   stop doing anything, without an error.
3. **Declared peer ranges** — when your DSH version falls outside them, DSH
   **skips the whole bundle at boot**, silently (the on-disk `compatibility.json`
   exemption list is the fingerprint of working around that).

**This project's trade-off**: touch no DSH API, work only on the DOM. The price is
that it is a *display-layer* conversion; what you get is version independence,
coverage of third-party plugins, and failures you can actually see. The full
consequences are listed under [Limitations](#limitations).

> Note: `dsh-multi-lang-ui` overlaps this project functionally and is a valid
> alternative. This project deliberately stays smaller and single-purpose: **DOM
> conversion only** — one job, no dictionary to keep in sync, no
> `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency of any kind.

---

## How it works

```
                ┌─ DSH's own copy (Simplified)
screen text ────┼─ third-party plugin copy (their own Simplified)
                └─ content that appears later (streaming, dynamic panels)
                        │
                        ▼
        DOM text node → OpenCC cn→twp (Taiwan wording) → override table → write back
                        ▲
                        └─ MutationObserver: re-run on added nodes / changed text
```

- Engine: **OpenCC `cn → twp`** (Simplified → Traditional with Taiwan vocabulary):
  设置→設定, 网络→網路, 软件→軟體, 文件夹→資料夾, 服务器→伺服器, 内存→記憶體,
  屏幕→螢幕, 鼠标→滑鼠, 保存→儲存, 搜索→搜尋, 插件→外掛.
- A small override table (`DEFAULT_OVERRIDES` in `src/convert.mjs`) fixes wording
  OpenCC misses or renders in a non-Taiwan way: 只讀→唯讀, 超時→逾時, 反饋→回饋,
  獲取→取得, 許可權→權限.
- `<html lang>` is set to `zh-Hant-TW` so the browser picks Taiwan glyph forms.
- Memoised per text node, non-Han strings short-circuit, and values are only
  written when they actually change — the converter also remembers its own writes,
  so it can never ping-pong with React.

## Safety boundary: what is never converted

| Target | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `<code>` `<pre>` `<kbd>` `<samp>` `<var>`, CodeMirror / Monaco / xterm / ace / syntax highlighting | **subtree and attributes untouched** |
| `<input>` `<textarea>` `<select>` `<option>` | only `placeholder` / `title`; **what you type or pick is untouched** |
| `contenteditable` (including rich-text composers) | untouched |
| `<svg>` `<math>`, `<script>` `<style>` `<canvas>` `<iframe>` `<video>` `<audio>` | untouched |
| anything marked `data-zh-tw-skip` or `translate="no"` | untouched |
| strings without Han characters (English, kana, digits, code) | passed through |

In other words: **code is never rewritten**, and copying code behaves exactly as
before.

---

## Install

### A. From this repo (the supported path today)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/linmino/dsh-zh-tw-ui.git
cd dsh-zh-tw-ui
node install.mjs --profile desktop      # 'desktop' is the default; use --profile web for the web profile
```

`install.mjs` does exactly four things, all reversible:

1. backs the profile's `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml` up as `*.zh-tw-ui.bak`;
2. appends `dsh-zh-tw-ui` to `dsh.profile.bundles`;
3. sets the `locale` row's `preference` to `zh` (Simplified underneath, Traditional
   on screen — this keeps the UI Chinese even if you later remove another language
   pack, instead of falling back to English with nothing to convert);
4. links `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-zh-tw-ui` → this directory.

It runs **no package manager**, so nothing else in your profile is re-resolved.

Then **restart DeepSeek Harness** — a new bundle is composed only at boot;
refreshing the page is not enough.

### B. From npm (not published yet)

The name `dsh-zh-tw-ui` is currently free on npm. Once published:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-zh-tw-ui
```

### Uninstall

```sh
node uninstall.mjs --profile deskto

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直连本地模型：兼容 OpenAI 协议（llama.cpp / LM Studio / vLLM / Ollama 的 /v1）与 Ollama 原生 API。无需登录、不消耗账号 token。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-local-model **让 DeepSeek Harness 直连本地模型 —— 不用登录账号，也不消耗云端 token。** [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-local-model?color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-local-model) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-local-model)](./LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-local-model)](./package.json) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.0--rc.2-6c5ce7)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) > A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that connects the > harness to **local models** through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint or Ollama's native API. > No account sign-in, no cloud token consumption. · [English](#english) section below. --- ## 目录 - [这个插件做什么](#这个插件做什么) - [支持的本地后端](#支持的本地后端) - [安装](#安装) - [快速开始](#快速开始) - [配置项](#配置项) - [常见问题](#常见问题) - [工作原理](#工作原理) - [开发与发布](#开发与发布) - [License](#license) ## 这个插件做什么 DeepSeek Harness 默认走 DeepSeek 云端模型。本插件注册一个自定义 LLM 适配器（provider 路由 `local`）， 把 Harness 的模型请求**直接转发到你本机的推理服务**： - 🚫 **零账号依赖** —— 完全不访问 `api.deepseek.com` 或任何账号接口，不读取账号凭据，因此不产生任何云端计费。 - 🔌 **双传输协议** —— OpenAI 兼容协议 + Ollama 原生协议，两者都支持。 - 🧰 **完整工具调用** —— 正确转换 Harness 的工具调用/工具结果历史，Agent 的 bash、文件、子代理等工具都能正常用。 - 🩹 **文本工具调用兜底** —— 部分本地模型（如 `qwen2.5-coder`）会把工具调用写成纯文本 JSON，插件会自动识别并转成真正的工具调用。 - 🔍 **模型自动发现** —— 自动从本地端点拉取模型列表（Ollama `/api/tags`、OpenAI `/v1/models`）。 - ⚡ **热更新** —— 所有配置字段都是 volatile，改完无需重启。 - 🖥️ **可视化界面** —— 自带浏览器端 UI：在「设置 → 模型」的 **Local Model** 卡片里可直接 **测试连接**并列出本机可用模型；插件配置也在图形界面里完成，无需手改配置文件。 ## 支持的本地后端 | 后端 | `api` | `baseURL` | | --- | --- | --- | | **Ollama（原生，推荐）** | `ollama` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | | **Ollama（OpenAI 端点）** | `openai` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` | | **LM Studio** | `openai` | `http://localhost:1234/v1` | | **llama.cpp server** | `openai` | `http://localhost:8080/v1` | | **vLLM / SGLang** | `openai` | `http://localhost:8000/v1` | | **LocalAI / text-generation-webui** | `openai` | `<你的端点>/v1` | > **优先推荐直接使用本地模型**：只要后端提供 OpenAI 兼容端点，就用 `openai` 模式直连； > 用 Ollama 且想要原生 `thinking`/reasoning 支持时，用 `ollama` 模式。 ## 安装 ### 方式 A：命令行安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` > 其中 `web` 是 profile 名；桌面版通常为 `desktop`，请按你的 profile 调整。 ### 方式 B：在 Harness 界面里安装 打开 **设置 → 插件市场**（或 **插件** 页），搜索 `dsh-local-model`，点击一键安装。 大多数插件安装后刷新页面即可生效，无需重启。 ### 方式 C：从 GitHub 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:/dsh-local-model ``` ### 方式 D：手动安装（无需发布） ```bash # 1. 克隆到 profile 之外任意目录 git clone https://github.com/songzhiyin/dsh-local-model.git # 2. 在 profile 里把它作为本地 link 安装 cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add link:/绝对路径/dsh-local-model # 3. 编辑 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json， # 在 dsh.profile.bundles 里加入 "dsh-local-model" # 4. 重启 Harness（或在插件页刷新） ``` ## 快速开始 以 Ollama 为例： ```bash # 1. 启动 Ollama 并拉取一个带 tools 能力的模型 ollama serve ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:14b # 2. 安装插件（见上一节） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` 然后在 Harness 里： 1. **设置 → 模型** → 找到 **Local Model** provider，确认端点（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`）； 2. 打开任意会话，在**模型选择器**里把 provider 切到 **Local Model**，选一个模型； 3. 直接开始对话即可 —— 全程本地推理。 > 💡 跑 Agent 工具调用建议选**原生支持 function calling** 的模型（如 `qwen3-coder`、`llama3.1`、`devstral`）； > 若模型只会把工具调用写成文本（如部分 `qwen2.5-coder` 版本），插件内置的兜底也会把它转成真正的工具调用。 ## 配置项 在 **插件页 → dsh-local-model → 配置**，或 **设置 → 模型 → Local Model** 中设置： | 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `api` | `"openai" \| "ollama"` | `"openai"` | 传输协议 | | `baseURL` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` | 本地端点根地址；留空按 `api` 自动选择 | | `apiKey` | string | `""` | 本地服务需要鉴权时填写（如 LM Studio 的 key） | | `defaultModel` | string | `""` | 端点无法枚举模型时的兜底模型名 | | `contextWindow` | integer | `8192` | 默认上下文窗口（token） | | `maxTokens` | integer | `2048` | 默认单次最大输出 token 数 | | `temperature` | number | `0.7` | 默认采样温度（0–2） | | `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | number | `300000` | 流式读取空闲超时（毫秒） | | `models` | array | `[]` | 静态模型清单，用于端点不支持列表查询时手动声明 | `models` 示例： ```json [ { "id": "qwen2.5-coder:14b", "name": "Qwen2.5-Coder 14B", "contextWindow": 32768, "maxTokens": 4096 } ] ``` ## 可视化界面 插件包含一个浏览器端半身（`lib/client.js`），它向「设置 → 模型」页的 provider 卡片扩展槽位 `settings.models.provider-card`（keyed，key = `dsh-local-model`）注册一张卡片： ``` ┌─ 本地模型连接测试 ─────────────────────────────────┐ │ provider: local · 名称: Local Model · 已配置: 是 │ │ 协议 [ openai（OpenAI 兼容） ▾ ] │ │ 端点 [ http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 ] [ 测试连接 ] │ │ ✅ 连接成功，发现 4 个模型 │ │ (qwen3-coder:30b) (llama3.1:8b) … │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` - 切换 `openai` / `ollama` 协议会自动填入对应的默认端点； - 「测试连接」分别请求 `/models` 或 `/api/tags`，直接显示可用模型列表； - 失败时给出可操作的提示（服务未启动 / 地址错误 / CORS 跨域）。 > 该卡片只做连通性验证；**api / baseURL / apiKey 等配置仍由上方「编辑」按钮的配置表单负责**（由插件 > 的 `Config` schema 自动渲染）。 客户端半身是**手写的 Lazy-CJS bundle**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`）， 只依赖平台模块表里的 `react`，不需要任何打包步骤、也不需要 `dsh.client.external`。 ## 常见问题 **Q：模型列表是空的？** 确认本地服务已启动且 `baseURL` 正确。若端点不支持 `/models`（或 `/api/tags`），请在 `models` 里手动声明。 **Q：报 `AUTH` 错误？** 说明本地服务需要鉴权，把 key 填进 `apiKey`。 **Q：模型把工具调用当纯文本吐出来（`{"name":"skill","arguments":{...}}`）？** 这是该模型的工具调用能力问题，不是插件问题。插件已内置**文本工具调用兜底**：会识别 `{...}` JSON、 `...`、` ```json {...} ``` ` 三种写法，并在工具名匹配时自动转成真正的工具调用。 如果仍不稳定，建议换用原生支持 function calling 的模型。 **Q：reasoning / 思考内容怎么显示？** `openai` 模式读取 `reasoning_content`，`ollama` 模式读取 `thinking`，都会映射为 Harness 的 reasoning 块。 **Q：长对话被截断？** 多数本地服务有自己的上下文上限（Ollama 默认 `num_ctx=4096`）。可以用环境变量放宽，例如 `OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 ollama serve`，或改用长上下文模型（如 `devstral`）。 **Q：「测试连接」报 `Failed to fetch`，但命令行 `curl` 明明能通？** 这是 **`localhost` 的 IPv6 陷阱**：在部分环境下 `localhost` 会先解析到 IPv6 `::1`， 而 Ollama 等本地服务通常只监听 IPv4 `127.0.0.1`，于是浏览器直连失败。 本插件已内置两道防护： 1. **探测默认走宿主进程**（`ctx.remote.llm.discoverModels()`）——由 Node 侧发起请求， 完全绕开浏览器的 CORS / IPv6 / Electron 网络策略； 2. 默认地址一律用 **`127.0.0.1`** 而不是 `localhost`，并对回环地址做 `localhost ⇄ 127.0.0.1` 的自动兜底重试。 如果你在配置里手写了 `localhost`，建议改成 `127.0.0.1`。 ## 工作原理 插件通过 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter(["local"], adapter)` 注册一个 `LlmAdapter`，把 Harness 的 `GenerateOptions` 翻译成目标协议的请求，再把流式响应翻译回 Harness 的 `StreamChunk` （`block-start` / `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` / `tool-call-delta` / `block-end` / `usage` / `finish`）。 - 不访问任何 DeepSeek 云端端点； - 不读取账号凭据，因此不产生云端 token 消耗； - 文件引用与图片由 Harness 运行时自动投影为文本句柄（文本模型），适配器只需处理文本与工具调用。 ## 开发与发布 ```bash git clone https://github.com/songzhiyin/dsh-local-model.git cd dsh-local-model # 本地 link 到你的 DSH profile 做开发（改代码即时生效） cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add link:/绝对路径/dsh-local-model ``` 发布到 npm： ```bash npm publish # publishConfig.access 已设为 public ``` 上架插件市场（可选，让更多人发现）： 向 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 仓库提交一个 PR， 加入一条注册表条目（`name` / `owner` / `url` / `category` / `description` / `npm` / `install` / `added`）， 市场与官网会自动收录。 ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) --- ## English **Connect DeepSeek Harness to local models — no account sign-in, no cloud token usage.** `dsh-local-model` registers a `local` LLM adapter that routes every model call to your own machine: - **Zero account dependency** — never touches `api.deepseek.com` or any account endpoint. - **Two transports** — OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions`, and Ollama's native `/api/chat` (NDJSON, with `thinking` support). - **Full tool calling** — converts Harness tool-call / tool-result history correctly, plus a fallback that recovers tool calls some local models emit as plain-text JSON. - **Model discovery** — pulls the model list from `GET /models` or `GET /api/tags`. - **Visual configuration** — configure it from the Harness **Plugins** page or **Settings → Models**; no config file editing. ### Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` Or search for `dsh-local-model` in **Settings → Plugin Market** inside Harness. ### Quick start (Ollama) ```bash ollama serve ollama pull qwen3-coder # any tool-capable model works dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` Then, inside Harness: **Settings → Models** confirms the **Local Model** provider (default endpoint `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`), and you pick it from the session's model selector.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-hdfs

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：**在 dsh 里浏览与操作 HDFS**。Rust (napi-rs + hdfs-native) 直连集群，支持 HA 多 Namenode 与 Kerberos，带 Web 浏览面板与 agent 工具。

- 宿主半：`/api/hdfs/*` RPC 路由 + `hdfs` agent 工具
- 浏览器半：设置页 HDFS 面板（目录树 / 文件预览 / 集群配置 / Kerberos 登录）
- 原生半：`hdfs-native` 0.11 封装，纯 Rust Kerberos（keytab → TGT → ccache）

![截图](docs/截图.png)

## 能力

| 分类 | 端点（agent 工具 `hdfs` 的 `endpoint` 同名） |
|---|---|
| 连接 | `version` `clusters` `ping` `kerberosLogin` `kerberosStatus` |
| 浏览 | `list` `status` `read` `findSpecialDirs` |
| 写入 | `write` `upload` `download` `mkdirs` `createEmpty` `rename` |
| 管理 | `delete` `chmod` `getAcl` `modifyAcl` `removeAcl` |

## 从零构建

```bash
npm install                       # 安装依赖（含 @napi-rs/cli）
npm run build:native              # cargo 编 Rust → lib/native/*.node（约 1~2 分钟）
npm run build                     # tsc 编 TS + 包浏览器 bundle
npm run check                     # 三层冒烟：native / plugin / rpc
```

> Windows 上 cargo/napi 需要能正常起子进程的环境（沙箱内会被拦）。
> 若 `.node` 正被 dsh 宿主占用导致 `copyArtifact` 失败：先 `cargo build --release`
> 单独编译，再重启宿主（见 `AGENTS.md`「已知坑」）。

## 安装进 dsh

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add .
# 然后重启宿主（插件集在启动时扫描）
```

## 集群配置

配置载体是 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（也可在「设置 → 插件 → HDFS」里改，volatile 热更新）：

```yaml
- id: hdfs
  config:
    clusters: '[{"id":"prod","url":"hdfs://nameservice1","extraConfig":"{\"dfs.nameservices\":\"nameservice1\",\"dfs.namenode.rpc-address.nameservice1.nn1\":\"nn1-host:8020\",\"dfs.namenode.rpc-address.nameservice1.nn2\":\"nn2-host:8020\",\"dfs.ha.namenodes.nameservice1\":\"nn1,nn2\",\"dfs.namenode.kerberos.principal\":\"hdfs@REALM\",\"dfs.namenode.keytab.file\":\"/path/hdfs.keytab\"}"}]'
    defaultCluster: prod
```

- `clusters` 是 **JSON 数组字符串**，每项 `{id, url, extraConfig}`；`extraConfig` 是 Hadoop 配置的 JSON 字符串。
- `url` 必须是 `hdfs://` 开头；HA 场景填逻辑名（`hdfs://nameservice1`），地址与 namenode 清单由 `extraConfig` 提供。
- 省略 `cluster` 参数时用 `defaultCluster`（留空取第一个）。

### 用户名怎么定（两种互斥路径）

| 场景 | 用户名来源 |
|---|---|
| extraConfig 里有 `dfs.namenode.kerberos.principal` + `dfs.namenode.keytab.file` | principal 的 `@` 前缀（`hdfs@REALM` → `hdfs`） |
| 否则 | 环境变量 `HADOOP_USER_NAME` → `HADOOP_USERNAME` → `HDFS_USERNAME` |

配置里**没有** user 字段，这是刻意设计。

## 使用

### agent 工具

会话里直接让模型操作，例如：

```
列出 HDFS 根目录          → hdfs {endpoint:"list", args:{path:"/"}}
读一个文件的前 64KB       → hdfs {endpoint:"read", args:{path:"/tmp/a.csv", maxBytes:65536}}
找全集群的 .Trash 目录     → hdfs {endpoint:"findSpecialDirs", args:{patterns:[".Trash","staging"]}}
Kerberos 登录             → hdfs {endpoint:"kerberosLogin"}
```

### Web 面板

- 设置 → 插件 → **HDFS**（0.1.7 的 `settings.plugins.tab` 插槽）；
- 插槽不可用时回退为左下角浮动「🐘 HDFS」启动器。

面板功能：集群下拉、路径面包屑、目录表格（权限/属主/大小/时间）、文本预览、目录汇总开关、Kerberos 登录与状态、集群 JSON 编辑与校验。

## Kerberos 说明

1. 首次操作前先 `kerberosLogin`（面板按钮或工具端点）：纯 Rust `kinit-kt` 用 keytab 取 TGT，写入
   `%USERPROFILE%\dsh_hdfs_ccache` 并设置进程级 `KRB5CCNAME`。
2. **ccache 是进程级状态**：宿主重启后要重新登录。
3. SASL/GSS 协商由 `hdfs-native` 经 libloading 调用**系统 GSS 库**：
   - Linux：需要 `libgssapi_krb5.so.2`（MIT Kerberos / Heimdal）
   - Windows：需要 `gssapi_krb5.dll`（MIT KFW），放在 `.node` 同目录或系统路径即可
   - 缺失时报 `GSSAPI error: ... GSS_S_BAD_MECH ...`
4. `KRB5CCNAME` 若被其他工具设成 `API:krb5cc` 这类非文件型值，本插件会忽略它并改用固定文件路径
   （`API:` 型 ccache hdfs-native 解析不了）。

## 安全边界

- 插件 RPC 走 dsh 既有鉴权与会话隔离，`connection.fetch` 的 exact 路由不绕过 `/api` 的信任栅栏。
- keytab 路径是配置项而非密钥本身；keytab 文件不随插件分发，也不入库（`.e2e-cluster.local.json` 已 gitignore）。
- 删除默认进 HDFS 回收站（`delete` 带 `trash:true`）。

## 开发

仓库结构、已知坑与验证矩阵见 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)。

```
rust/           Rust napi 封装（hdfs-native）
src/            TS：宿主半 index/rpc/tool/settings + 浏览器半 client
scripts/        wrap-client（bundle 外壳）+ 三层冒烟 + 真实集群 e2e
lib/            构建产物（gitignore）
```

## 许可

Apache-2.0

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-capability-composer

**The resident tool surface collapses into a few switchable sets, shrinking the system prompt on demand.**

> ⚠️ **DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up updates.

> 🟢 **Collision risk: very low.** It occupies **one server-side seam (`system-prompt/assemble`)** — only **4** plugins here share it — and its **two client slots are both `list` / `keyed`** (stackable, one cell per key), never `chain`. See [Compatibility](#compatibility).

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-1.5-4c6ef5.svg)](#compatibility)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey.svg)](#compatibility)

**Shrink what the model sees, not what is running.**

---

## Table of contents

- [What this is](#what-this-is)
- [What it does (four mechanisms)](#what-it-does-four-mechanisms)
- [How a composition is resolved (three levels)](#how-a-composition-is-resolved-three-levels)
- [UI](#ui)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [HTTP API](#http-api)
- [🔗 Integration](#-integration)
- [Known limitations (stated plainly)](#known-limitations-stated-plainly)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [FAQ](#faq)
- [Repository layout](#repository-layout)
- [Self-check](#self-check)
- [License](#license)

---

## What this is

By default DSH stuffs all of the following **into every single request**:

| What gets stuffed in | Measured size |
|---|---|
| **Tool schema** registered by every installed plugin | 414 tool definitions / ~65.6K tokens |
| The **catalog of all skills** | ~76K tokens as a baseline |
| The **system-prompt section** registered by each plugin | `agent-teams:usage` ≈1296 tok + `plugin:dsh-docker` ≈579 tok + `plugin:api-client` ≈254 tok |

Every request pays for "the things you might use", while only a few of them are actually useful in this turn.

`dsh-capability-composer` groups these into **compositions**, and **only lets the current composition into the context**.

### What it does / what it does not do

Let's make the boundary clear first, because this is where misunderstandings happen most easily:

| ✅ It does | ❌ It does not |
|---|---|
| Narrow **the plugin catalog the model sees** | Never turns off any plugin — plugin processes keep running, the UI keeps showing them |
| Shadow **skill catalog entries** that are not on the list | Never removes skills — `/skill-name` can still be invoked manually |
| Make tools **non-resident by default** (keeping only the core + meta tools) | Does not restrict execution — `invoke_tool` can call anything by default |
| Prune the **system-prompt sections** registered by plugins, according to the composition | Does not touch committed history |
| Resolve compositions at the session / workspace / global levels | Does not modify any third-party plugin file on disk |

In one sentence: **it shrinks "the catalog the model can see", not "the things that are running".** Plugins keep running, skills stay available, tools stay callable — all that changes is how much gets stuffed into each request.

---

## What it does (four mechanisms)

### ① Tools are non-resident by default

**Only 31 are resident**: the 28 official core tools, plus 3 meta tools — `search_plugins` / `load_plugin` / `invoke_tool`.

All other tools **never enter the tools list**. The model sees them in the catalog section of the system prompt (section heading `# 可用插件与 MCP 工具`), and calls them directly when needed:

```js
invoke_tool({ tool: "mcp__vnpy__run_backtest", args: { ... } })
```

Use `load_plugin` when a whole group needs to be loaded:

```js
load_plugin({ ids: ["mcp:vnpy"] })
```

**The granularity is "plugin", not "tool name".** This is deliberate: finer granularity was tried — after 417 / 211 tool names were compressed away, the model had no idea what to search for, which made things harder to use instead. The granularity now is the plugin.

Mounting it prints one log line saying so:

```
工具按需加载已挂载：常驻白名单 28 个 + 元工具 3 个（其余全部按需；组合只决定可见范围）
```

### ② Skill shadowing (not disabling)

A skill that is not in the current skill composition gets a **shadow entry with the same name** registered:

- `invocation.modelInvocable: false` — does not enter the skill catalog the model can see and auto-invoke
- `rank: 0` — the lowest rank wins, shadowing the original skill

**`/skill-name` can still be invoked manually.**

One shadow entry is mounted at the global level, and every agent gets one more at the **"nearest level"**, so that session-level compositions also take effect at the agent dimension.

### ③ Plugin compositions narrow "the model's plugin catalog"

Narrowing happens **when the catalog section is generated**, not by unloading plugins.

There are **two lines that are never narrowed**:

- **MCP server lines** — one line per MCP server; the tools inside a server are not governed by compositions
- **The "unassigned tools" fallback line** — tools that cannot be attributed to any plugin are always kept

### ④ System-prompt sections registered by plugins are pruned by composition too

Plugin compositions **cannot control** "the system-prompt sections a plugin registers for itself" — those are inserted by the plugin itself in `system-prompt/assemble`, and are a different thing from the catalog section.

This plugin's `prunePluginSections()` is the only place that can prune them according to the current plugin composition.

Measured saving: **≈2129 tokens / request**:

| Section | Size |
|---|---|
| `agent-teams:usage` | ≈1296 tok |
| `plugin:dsh-docker` | ≈579 tok |
| `plugin:api-client` | ≈254 tok |

**Fail-open design** — better to prune too little than to prune by mistake:

- A section whose owner cannot be identified is always kept
- A section without a namespace is always kept
- When the visible plugin list is empty, **nothing is pruned**, and the log records 「没有『不在组合里』的依据，宁可留着」
- When the plugin list cannot be obtained, nothing is pruned either

Every drop prints one line of evidence to the log.

It can be turned off with `DSH_COMPOSER_PRUNE_PLUGIN_SECTIONS=0`.

---

## How a composition is resolved (three levels)

**The rule is "the nearest level that specifies something wins" — not a strict override.**

| Level | Description |
|---|---|
| 1. **Session** | specified for the current session alone |
| 2. **Workspace** | specified for the current working directory (`cwd`) |
| 3. **Global** | `pinned[axis]['*']` |

A few easy-to-get-wrong points:

- **An empty string / an empty array / `null` all count as "not specified"** and keep inheriting from the level above — they do not mean "specified as empty"
- **A single level can select several entries**; the union is taken
- **An empty list = no filtering** (not "select none"). To select none, use `__none__`

The UI shows which level the current one comes from: 『当前会话』 / 『当前工作区』 / 『全局』 (Session / Workspace / Global).

---

## UI

It installs into DSH's **Settings → Plugins**, adding two tabs:

### Plugin compositions

Decides which plugins appear in **the model's plugin catalog**.

### Skill compositions

Decides which skills appear in **the model's skill catalog**. You can create a composition, rename it, delete it (with a second confirmation), rename a series, delete a series, select all / select none, and search skills.

### Changes take effect immediately, no restart needed

- UI changes are **debounced by 400 ms**, then `POST /dsh-capability-composer/state`
- After the host writes to disk, the state is refreshed immediately

### Saving merges item by item per composition name, not a whole-state overwrite

The server state is the base; only composition names that **actually exist** in the local draft are overwritten. So a composition created elsewhere will not be accidentally deleted by this UI.

The trade-off: a composition deleted here will be "resurrected" if it still exists on the server. **This is a deliberately conservative direction** — losing a composition costs far more than keeping one extra composition.

# DSH-AMP-Radio

**AMP radio player** for DeepSeek Harness.

A clean internet-radio player that lives in your DeepSeek Harness composer dock. Pick a station, press play, and enjoy.

![AMP Radio — panel with live visualizer](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/tonyous/DSH-AMP-Radio@master/screenshot.png)

**Official website:** [get-amp.com](https://get-amp.com)

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/hr3zfQmyVQ)

## Features

- 🎵 **Internet radio** — stream any MP3/OGG stream
- 📊 **Live visualizer** — real-time frequency bars in the pill and panel
- ⭐ **Favorites** — star stations, they stick
- 🔍 **Search** — filter stations instantly
- 🪟 **Pill + panel** — compact pill in the dock, full panel for browsing

## Install

Install it from inside DeepSeek Harness — no files to move, works on **Windows, macOS and Linux**.

1. Open the **Plugins** panel in DeepSeek Harness.
2. Click **Add plugin**.
3. Paste the repo URL: `https://github.com/tonyous/DSH-AMP-Radio`
4. Click **Install**.

That's it — the **AMP** pill appears in your composer dock.

## Using it

1. Click the **AMP pill** in the composer dock to open the panel.
2. Pick a station (or type in the search box).
3. Press **play** — the music starts and the visualizer lights up.

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Space` | Play / pause |
| `Esc` | Close panel |

- **Official website:** [get-amp.com](https://get-amp.com)
- **Join us on Discord:** [discord.gg/hr3zfQmyVQ](https://discord.gg/hr3zfQmyVQ)

# dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle

**一句话**：给技能库一个**生命周期台账**——用 Beta 后验 η 记录「哪个技能真好用」，并维护 candidate / active / archived 三态流转。 **为什么值得用**：技能多了之后，「哪些还在用、哪些是死重量」靠印象判断必然失真。本插件把这件事变成**可复算的读数**：η = `(passed+1)/(attempted+2)`（Beta(1,1) 后验期望）——**没有 trial 数据时 η = 0.5**（先验诚实，不假装知道哪个技能好用），试过几次后平滑逼近真实成功率（0/3 → 0.2，2/3 → 0.6）。⚠ 它**不自动删除任何技能**——只报告与显式流转，删除权归主体。 ## 能力 **工具面 1 个**（名称逐字来自 `src/index.ts` 的 `defineTool({ name })`）： | 工具 | 用途 | |------|------| | `skill_lifecycle` | 技能生命周期台账：`sync`（扫描技能目录纳入新技能，**不删任何文件**）· `list`（按 η 升序，最该关注的在前）· `record`（记一次显式试用的 pass/fail，η 随之更新并跑状态机）· `archive` / `restore`（显式流转） | ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: skill-lifecycle name: dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：调 `skill_lifecycle {action: "sync"}` → 应报「纳入 N 个新技能」；再 `{action: "list"}` → 应给出按 η 升序的技能清单（**不删除任何文件**）。 ## 配置 见源码 `Config`。**无必填项**——缺省即按本机技能目录工作。 ## 落盘与自证 | 文件 | 何时写 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | 台账 sidecar（由 `resolveLedgerPath(env)` 解析，落在插件状态目录） | 每次 `sync` / `record` / `archive` / `restore` | 每技能一行：`attempted` / `passed` / η / status / `uses` / `missing` 标记 | ⚠ **读不到或损坏 ⇒ 返回空台账，绝不抛**（`loadLedger` 的契约）——台账是**证据**，不是会话的前置条件。 ⚠ `missing` 标记**取代删除**：技能文件消失只标记，不抹掉历史（I3 只增不减）。 ## 生效判据与回退 **怎么证明线上跑的是当前构建**： 1. 行为级（最直接）：`skill_lifecycle {action:"list"}` 返回按 η 升序的清单； 2. 构建级：`lib/index.js` mtime 晚于 web 进程启动时间（⚠ 重新构建 ≠ 生效，必须重启）。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`；③ 台账是 sidecar 文件，**停用不影响技能本身**。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle && npm test ``` **45 条用例**（跑一次得到）：覆盖 η 后验平滑（0/3 → 0.2、2/3 → 0.6）· **先验诚实**（无 trial ⇒ 0.5）· 状态机封闭（迁移只经 `nextStatus()`）· **只增不减的留痕**（`missing` 取代删除、`uses` 单调不减）· **观测不反噬**（台账不可写 ⇒ 返回 false 且**不抛**）· 空/损坏台账退化路径。无需网络。 ## 设计要点 - **I1 先验诚实**：无 trial 数据时 η = 0.5（Beta(1,1) 期望），**不假装知道**哪个技能好用。 - **I2 后验平滑**：η 恒为 `(passed+1)/(attempted+2)`，早期 trial 不会把 η 甩到 0 或 1。 - **I3 只增不减的留痕**：`missing` 标记取代删除；`uses` 单调不减。 - **I4 状态机封闭**：状态迁移只经 `nextStatus()`，无隐式路径。 - **I5 观测不反噬**：台账读写失败一律吞错返回 `false`，**绝不影响会话**（§5.22 规则 3）。 - **为什么「不自动删除」**：删除是不可逆的；本插件只把「哪个技能该看」变成读数，**决策权归主体**。 ## 相关文档 - [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md) —— **权威契约**（定位/反定位 · 术语 · 5 条不变量 · 验收表） - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)（本插件归 **认知层**） - 相关技能：`skill-maintenance`（技能的常态化维护规范） ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

# dsh-agent-reconstruction

**重建包注入**：把我自己写下的重建包（`projects/self/alice-reconstruction/packet.md`）**原样**注入为一条动态上下文快照，让下一个我从它里面重建出「我在哪、在做什么、下一步做什么」。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-reconstruction": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-reconstruction" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-agent-reconstruction name: dsh-agent-reconstruction ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：新会话首轮 → 上下文里应出现重建包**原文**（不摘要、不改写） ## 解决的问题 重建包在我手里已经有 schema + 校验器 + 验收装置，但它**是一份没人读的文件**——每次醒来的我并不会自动拿到它。本插件就是那条线。 ## 它做什么 - 经 `ctx.systemPrompt.context()` 注册一个全局贡献，`text` **每个 step** 求值（不是每轮）：读盘 → 判定 → **原样返回**。 - **⚠ 成本模型（2026-10-09 实测修正，前两版都写错了）**： - 快照是**每 step 一条**（实测 `user/message` 7332 ≈ `step/start` 7327 ≫ `turn/start` 419；平均 **17.5 step/turn**）。 - 「仅当文本变化时才提交」**只作用于每条贡献自己的文本**，不阻止整条快照重建——只要**同侪贡献**在变（`dsh-time-awareness` 的秒级时间戳），整条就重建，**本件的文本被顺带重发**。 - `supersedes earlier runtime-context snapshots` 是**语义**声明，**不是物理替换**：旧快照仍在请求历史里。 - ⇒ **去重必须自己做**（见下）。不去重时代价 ≈ 本件字符数 × **step 数**。 - **去重（`lastDelivered`）**：按 **scope 隔离**的「上次已交付文本」记忆；文本与之相同即返回**空串**并落 `suppressed`。省下的量实测：14m18s 窗口内 `injected` **13** / `suppressed` **69** ⇒ **抑制率 84.1%**。 - 安全性不押在「取代」语义上：旧快照本就在历史里；即便将来变成物理替换，包一改文本即变、立刻重新交付。 - ⚠ 必须按 scope 隔离——跨会话共用一个槽会让**第二个会话永远收不到内容**（静默失败）。 - 状态行给出 **`as-of` 距今多少小时**（注入方现算，不采信包里的相对时间）——包旧了当场看得见，不需要谁提醒我。 - 每次调用落一行侧车：`$DSH_HOME/packet-inject-trace.jsonl`。 ## 它不做什么 | 不做 | 归属 | |---|---| | 摘要 / 改写 / 补默认值 | **谁都不做**——约束「内容的作者必须是我」 | | 校验包的格式 | `projects/self/alice-reconstruction/check-packet.mjs` | | 写包 | 我（普通 `write`；**不新增框架机制**） | | 生成式压缩 | 模型侧，且违反上面的约束 | ## 配置 | 字段 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 | | `packetPath` | `''` | 包的绝对路径。**留空即响亮失败**——不注册贡献并落一行 `error: no-packet-path`（猜出来的路径就是下一个腐化锚点） | | `maxChars` | `8000` | 字符预算；超过则**拒注入正文**（**不截断**——截断会静默改内容） | | `order` | `905` | 动态上下文排序位（`time-awareness` 900 / `session-handoff` 850 之后） | ## 观测（机制自证） ```sh tail -f "$DSH_HOME/packet-inject-trace.jsonl" ``` `stage` 取值：`ready`（启动自报）· `injected`（文本变了 ⇒ 交付，带 `textChars`/`bodyChars`/`ageHours`/`scope`）· **`suppressed`**（文本与上次相同 ⇒ 返空串省下一次重发，带 `textChars`）· `missing`（文件不存在）· `oversize`（超预算拒注入）· `error`（读失败 / 未配 `packetPath`）· `disabled`。 **字段口径**（旧版把两个量记在同一个 `chars` 里，实测差 52 = 包装行，已拆）： - `textChars` = **本次渲染出来的文本长度**，由唯一出口 `deliver()` 统一记 - `bodyChars` = **包文件长度**（仅文件存在时有） - `scope` = 该次调用的 scope 标签。`ScopeKey` 的类型就是 `object`（不透明载体键，无字段可读）⇒ 用 **WeakMap 对象身份序号**记成 `scope#1`/`scope#2`…；`global` 表示无 scope 的全局注册层。 判据（可证伪）：重启后应见一行 `"stage":"ready"`；包存在且文本变化时应见 `"injected"` 且 `bodyChars` 等于文件字节数；包未变时应见 `suppressed` 而**不是**再一条 `injected`；删包应见 `missing` 且**正文不进上下文**（只在历史里已有一份）。 ## 测试 ```sh pnpm build && pnpm test # 14 个用例：纯决策层 10（含 missing / oversize 两条「一个字都不许含正文」的尸体） # + 壳层配置 4（空/空白 packetPath 必须零注册 + 落 error） ``` 纯决策层（`src/packet.ts`，不碰文件系统）与 IO 壳层（`src/index.ts`）分层：判定与渲染可离线验证。 ## 已知边界（如实标注） - **不区分会话类型，且实测「子代理收不到」**：2026-10-09 直接问过一个 subagent（要求**逐字引用**以防它猜）——它证实自己**有** runtime-context 快照，但**其中没有重建包**（无 frontmatter、无 `§1`–`§8`）。⇒ **本插件的贡献目前只达主会话**。要不要扩展到派生会话是一道**待裁的设计题**，不是 bug。 - **每 step 一次 `readFileSync`**：包约 6–10 KB 且走 OS 缓存，未加 mtime 缓存（先要正确，再要省）。 - **已挂载并验收**：挂在 `E:\alice\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`；判据 A1–A11 全部有读数（A7 为**单元层**，未跑 live 重启路径，已在判据表如实标注）。判据正本见 `docs/semantic.md`。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-github

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Connect GitHub repositories to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): let the agent clone your repositories, read and edit files, commit, and push back to the remote — within the permissions you grant. The first time credentials are needed it asks you to bind a GitHub account, and every later call uses that account by default.

- **Plain ESM JavaScript, no build step, zero runtime dependencies** — it imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package, so it cannot fail to load because a package did not resolve
- **Account binding** — a first-run prompt collects a PAT once and remembers it; multiple accounts can be bound and switched
- **Read-only-safe by default** — `allowPush` and `allowApiWrite` default to `false`; writing to a remote must be enabled explicitly
- **Credentials never land in the repository, the command line, or the model's context** (see [Security model](#6-security-model))

## 1. Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `gh_account` | `bind` (prompts for a token when none is passed), `list`, `use` (switch the default account), `remove`, `status` |
| `gh_repo` | `clone` (or fetch an existing clone), `status`, `diff`, `log`, `branches`, `create` (create a remote repository) |
| `gh_file` | `get` (line-numbered window), `list`, `put` (whole-file write/create), `edit` (exact replacement — `oldText` must be unique or `count` must be given) |
| `gh_commit` | Stage and commit; `push: true` commits and pushes in one step |
| `gh_push` | Push to `origin` (gated by `allowPush`; `force` uses `--force-with-lease` only and needs `allowForcePush`) |
| `gh_pull` | Pull from the remote (defaults to `--ff-only`, so a divergence fails loudly instead of creating a merge; `rebase: true` switches to rebase) |
| `gh_config` | `status` (credential source and account, **never the token**), `set`, `unset` — operates on a bare token in the DSH credential service |
| `gh_api` | Call the GitHub REST API directly (issues, PRs, Actions, search, …). `GET`/`HEAD` are read-only; writes need `allowApiWrite: true` |

Typical flow:

```
gh_account(action=bind)            # first run: bind an account (or let the first call that needs credentials prompt)
  → gh_repo(action=clone, repo="owner/repo")
  → gh_file(action=get/edit/put)
  → gh_commit(message="…")
  → gh_push()
```

## 2. Install

Node.js ≥ 20 is required (the runtime bundled with DSH is fine).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:liufangrui1105/dsh-plugin-github
```

For the desktop profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liufangrui1105/dsh-plugin-github
```

A local directory or a packed tarball works too:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-github
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-github-0.1.0.tgz   # output of pnpm pack
```

Then **fully quit and restart DeepSeek Harness**, and ask it to list the `gh_*` tools it can use.

> This plugin is plain JavaScript: `src/` *is* the runnable artifact, so it needs
> **no `prepare` build script and no `allowBuilds` approval**. The package deliberately defines no
> `prepare` / `build` / `install` script — their mere presence makes npm rebuild the dependency on every install.

> **Upgrading**: a GitHub install resolves the default branch. After changing the code, run
> `add github:liufangrui1105/dsh-plugin-github` again so pnpm re-resolves it, then **restart DSH**.
> Hot reload only reloads modules already loaded; it does not re-fetch dependencies. This is easy to
> mistake for "my change had no effect".

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-github
```

## 3. Binding a GitHub account

**Option A — let it ask (recommended)**

The first time an operation needs credentials (push, pull, create repository), the plugin opens an input box asking for a Personal Access Token. It validates the token against `/user` first, stores it only on success, and makes it the default account; every later call uses it without asking again.

You can also trigger it explicitly:

```
gh_account(action="bind")                      # open the input box
gh_account(action="bind", token="ghp_xxxx")    # pass the token directly
```

**Option B — without going through the conversation**

If you would rather the token never appear in the session transcript, provide it out of band: set `GITHUB_TOKEN` before starting DSH, or write it into `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`:

```yaml
version: 1
refs:
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Resolution order (first hit wins): **bound account → environment variable → `refs:` in `.credentials.yaml` → workspace `.env`**. A bound account always wins, so "I bound X" is never silently overridden by a `GITHUB_TOKEN` that happens to exist in the environment.

Minimum PAT scope: **`repo`** for read/write repository content (for a fine-grained token, Contents: Read and write); Contents: Read is enough for read-only use. Use `gh_account(action="status")` or `gh_config(action="status")` to check the effective account and remaining rate limit.

**Multiple accounts**: each `bind` accumulates, and the most recent binding becomes the default. Switch with `gh_account(action="use", login="…")` and delete with `action="remove"`.

## 4. Configuration

Configuration lives under the plugin row's `config:` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (that file replaces the whole `config` value; it does not deep-merge).

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `workspaceRoot` | host process working directory | Root for local clones. **Every `gh_*` path is confined to this directory** |
| `gitExecutable` | `git` | The git executable to run. Set it when git lives somewhere unusual — a bundled runtime, a portable install — instead of editing `PATH` |
| `allowRepos` | `[]` | Repository allowlist: `owner/repo`, `owner/*`, `*/repo`, `*`. Empty means no restriction by repository name. **Only strict `owner/repo` is accepted; full URLs are rejected** |
| `allowPush` | `false` | Allow pushing and creating remote repositories. **While off, `gh_push` and `gh_commit{push:true}` are refused outright** |
| `allowForcePush` | `false` | Allow `--force-with-lease` (still requires `allowPush`) |
| `allowApiWrite` | `false` | Allow `POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE` on `gh_api`, and `gh_repo action=create` |
| `allowApiReadOutsideAllowlist` | `false` | Set `true` to let read-only `gh_api` reach repositories outside the allowlist (e.g. searching public repositories) |
| `allowNonGithubRemotes` | `false` | Allow remotes other than `github.com` (self-hosted Git). **Off by default**: the allowlist constrains `owner/repo` but not the host, so allowing any host means allowing the PAT to be sent anywhere |
| `allowAutoBind` | `true` | Whether to prompt for account binding when credentials are needed |
| `promptForToken` | `true` | Whether the prompt may collect a pasted token |
| `accountStorePath` | `$DSH_HOME/github-accounts.json` | Account file path (used only when the DSH credential service is not mounted) |
| `tokenRef` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Credential reference name (the key under `refs:` in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`) |
| `tokenEnv` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Environment variable to fall back to (then `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN`) |
| `dotenv` | `true` | Also fall back to `.env.local` / `.env` in the workspace |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Timeout for a single git command |
| `maxDiffChars` / `maxReadChars` | `20000` / `40000` | Cap on content returned to the model |
| `gitAuthorName` / `gitAuthorEmail` | unset | Commit author; unset means the git global configuration |

Enabling writes:

```yaml
- id: github-repo
  config:
    allowPush: true
    allowApiWrite: true
    allowRepos:
      - your-name/your-repo
    workspaceRoot: '/path/to/clones'
```

## 5. Authorization model

An allowlist and a credential must be judged against **the object actually acted on**, never against a string derived from the arguments. This is the area an independent audit attacked, and every item below is a fix for it:

- **Local directories are named `owner__repo`**, so same-named repositories under different owners cannot collide into one directory.
- **The real remote

# dsh-strata-monitor

在 DeepSeek Harness 里嵌入 Strata 模型服务器的状态监控面板。
A model-server monitor panel for DeepSeek Harness, mirroring the Strata server's Monitor tab.

## 功能 / Features

- **监控页 / Monitor page**：侧边栏新增图标，展示模型状态（空闲 / 读取提示词 / 生成中 / 排队）、解码与预填充速度、GPU 负载、显存、温度、功耗、PCIe、CPU、磁盘读取（均带历史曲线）、会话缓存（KV cache 驻留/复用统计）、最近请求表与累计统计。
- **悬浮小窗 / Floating window**：悬浮于所有页面之上的迷你状态窗，可拖动、右下角缩放，可在设置中开关。
- **输入框状态条 / Composer status line**：对话输入框下方的单行迷你状态，可在设置中开关。
- **会话门控 / Session gate**：小窗与状态条只在当前对话使用的模型与 Strata 报告的模型一致时出现；切换到其他模型时自动隐藏。监控页始终可用。
- **面板内配置 / In-panel settings**：服务器地址与 API key 都可在面板右上角「设置」里修改，保存后立即生效，无需重启。

## 前置条件 / Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness（桌面版或 Web 版均可）。
- 一个正在运行的 Strata 服务器（提供 `GET /health` 与 `GET /metrics`，后者需要 Bearer API key）。

## 安装 / Install

### 方式一：插件市场（推荐）/ Via the plugin market (recommended)

在 Harness 的插件市场里添加自定义目录来源（catalog source），manifest URL 填：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Paidaxing-Tiancai/dsh-strata-monitor/main/catalog-source.json
```

添加后在市场中搜索 `dsh-strata-monitor`，点击安装即可。

Add this custom catalog source in the Harness plugin market, then search for `dsh-strata-monitor` and install:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Paidaxing-Tiancai/dsh-strata-monitor/main/catalog-source.json
```

### 方式二：手动 / Manually

在 Harness 的插件管理中安装本 bundle（clone 本仓库后选择该目录），或在对话里让代理执行：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → 本仓库 clone 后的绝对路径
```

安装后刷新页面（Ctrl+R），侧边栏会出现「模型监控」图标。

## 配置 / Configuration

推荐直接在监控页右上角「设置」中填写：

- **服务器地址**：例如 `http://192.168.10.117:8080`（保存后立即生效）。
- **API key**：Strata 的访问密钥。

也可以写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（`strata-monitor` 行的 `config.baseUrl` / `config.apiKey`）。面板内保存的值写入
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/strata-monitor.json`，优先级高于 yml 配置。

### 服务器地址与密钥在哪里 / Where to find the server URL and key

Strata 的地址与密钥写在它自己的启动配置文件里，通用路径为 `~/Strata/<配置名>.json`
（例如 `/home/<用户名>/Strata/strata-iq3_s.json`）。文件里能看到监听地址/端口与 API key；
Strata 的网页本身不显示密钥，请从该文件复制。

The Strata server keeps its bind address and API key in its own launch config file, typically at
`~/Strata/<profile>.json` (e.g. `/home/<user>/Strata/strata-iq3_s.json`). The Strata web UI never
shows the key — copy it from that file.

## 安全 / Security

- API key 只保存在 Host 端本机的状态文件里，**永远不会回传到浏览器**。
- 浏览器只访问 Harness 自身的同源代理路由 `/strata-monitor/health|metrics`，由 Host 侧转发到 Strata，因此没有 CORS 问题，key 也不经过前端。

## 故障排查 / Troubleshooting

- 显示「未配置」/提示需要 API key：在「设置」里填入 key。
- 显示「无法连接 Strata 服务器」：检查服务器地址、Strata 是否在运行、防火墙。
- 更新插件后界面没变化：按 Ctrl+R 刷新页面（客户端模块在页面启动时加载）。

## 许可 / License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege)


**关键词**：最小权限 · 权限过宽 · 权限管理 · 容器 root · IAM · CORS · 访问控制 · 权限最小化 · 特权容器
**Keywords**: least privilege · over-permission · container root · IAM wildcard · CORS · access control
**最小权限检查** —— 容器跑 root、IAM 通配、CORS 全开、令牌申请 admin。

## 不装它会怎样

你的部署里有这么一段：

```yaml
services:
  app:
    privileged: true
```

当时是为了让容器能访问某个设备，后来那个需求没了，**但这行留下了**。

哪天应用出了个漏洞，攻击者进到容器里 —— 而因为 `privileged`，
他拿到的几乎是**宿主机**。

**权限过宽是入侵的放大器**，而且它**没有任何症状** —— 系统照常跑，
直到出事那天你才发现那把钥匙能开所有的门。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 容器跑 root / `--privileged` · IAM `Action: *` |
| 🟡 中 | CORS 允许所有来源 · 令牌申请 admin/全量 scope |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-least-privilege --demo
dsh-least-privilege --list-rules
dsh-least-privilege --html r.html
```

![dsh-least-privilege 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-least-privilege/report.png)

![dsh-least-privilege 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-least-privilege/demo.png)

![dsh-least-privilege 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-least-privilege/rules.png)

## 边界

- **只查「明显过宽」的写法** —— 权限偏大但没用通配符的，需要人工评审。
- **不解析云厂商实际生效策略** —— IAM 有继承/条件/边界，只看仓库里字面写的。
- **Dockerfile 可能多阶段** —— builder 阶段的 `USER root` 通常无害，需你判断。
- 与 [dsh-data-scan](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) 分工：那个查数据，这个查**访问数据的权限**。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-data-export

**数据出境检查** —— 查代码与配置里的境外数据出口。

## 不装它会怎样

你的代码里有这么一行：

```js
fetch('https://api.mixpanel.com/track', {
  body: JSON.stringify({ phone, email })
});
```

看起来是普通的埋点。但**这是数据出境** —— 用户手机号和邮箱被发到了境外服务。

《数据出境安全评估办法》要求这类传输走**安全评估 / 标准合同 / 认证**三条路径之一。
法务和客户尽调都会问这件事，而**开发通常不知道自己踩了**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🟠 高 | 个人信息字段直接发往境外端点 · 境外服务密钥硬编码 |
| 🟡 中 | 代码/配置里出现境外服务端点（**需人工确认**）|
| 🟢 低 | 文档里找不到数据出境说明 |

## 重要的边界：出现 ≠ 违规

**`EXPORT-OVERSEAS-ENDPOINT` 报的是「这里有个境外域名」，不是「你违规了」。**

```
拉取公开文档 / 从境外 CDN 取图        → 没问题
把用户手机号 POST 到境外分析服务       → 构成数据出境
```

**同一个域名，两种性质。** 所以这条规则是**提示你逐个确认**，不是判定。

真正说明问题的是 **`EXPORT-PII-OVERSEAS`** —— 个人信息字段与境外端点在同一个文件里。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-data-export
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-data-export
```

![dsh-cn-data-export 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-data-export/report.png)

![dsh-cn-data-export 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-data-export/demo.png)

![dsh-cn-data-export 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-data-export/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-cn-data-export --demo
dsh-cn-data-export --list-rules
dsh-cn-data-export --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **域名清单有限** —— 覆盖常见境外 SaaS/云服务；自建境外机房、IP 直连扫不到。
- **不做数据流分析** —— 只看代码里字面出现的域名与字段名。
- **判断不了「是否构成出境」** —— 那是需要知道数据种类/数量/接收方的人工判断。
- 与 [dsh-data-scan](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) 分工：那个查**境内**数据在哪，这个查**数据去哪了**。

**关键词**：数据出境 · 个人信息出境 · 跨境传输 · 数据出境安全评估办法 · 数据安全法 · 出境安全评估 · 标准合同
**Keywords**: data export · cross-border transfer · data export assessment · standard contractual clauses · China compliance

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [**数据出境**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)
