plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Matt Pocock Skills

> Matt Pocock's [engineering and productivity skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), adapted for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DSH) as a Cordis bundle plugin.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

## What's Included

This plugin provides the skills from Matt Pocock's repository that **do not overlap** with DSH built-in skills. The following are already built into DSH and are therefore **not** duplicated here:

| DSH Built-in | Matt's Equivalent |
|---|---|
| `tdd` | `tdd` |
| `grilling` | `grilling` |
| `diagnosing-bugs` | `diagnosing-bugs` |
| `code-review` | `code-review` |
| `prototype` | `prototype` |
| `research` | `research` |
| `wizard` | `wizard` |
| `writing-for-agents` | `writing-for-agents` |
| `domain-modeling` | `domain-modeling` |
| `codebase-design` | `codebase-design` |

### Skills Provided by This Plugin

#### Engineering (user-invoked)

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `ask-matt` | Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the user-invoked skills. |
| `grill-with-docs` | Grilling session that also builds your project's domain model, sharpening terminology and updating `GLOSSARY.md` and ADRs inline. |
| `triage` | Move issues through a state machine of triage roles. |
| `improve-codebase-architecture` | Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick. |
| `setup-matt-pocock-skills` | Configure this repo for the engineering skills (issue tracker, triage labels, domain doc layout). Run once per repo. |
| `to-spec` | Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker. |
| `to-tickets` | Break any plan, spec, or conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets. |
| `implement` | Build the work described by a spec or set of tickets, driving TDD at pre-agreed seams. |
| `implement-spec` | Implement a whole spec on one integration branch using concurrent subagents. |
| `wayfinder` | Plan a huge chunk of work as a shared map of decision tickets, then resolve them one at a time. |
| `retro` | Suggest improvements to the coding agent's environment after a session. |
| `pr` | The shape a pull request body should take. |

#### Productivity (user-invoked)

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `grill-me` | Get relentlessly interviewed about a plan or design. |
| `handoff` | Compact the current conversation into a handoff document. |
| `teach` | Teach the user a new skill or concept over multiple sessions. |
| `to-questionnaire` | Turn a decision into a Markdown questionnaire for the person who can answer it. |
| `wait-what` | Re-pitch a message with the context you're missing. |

## Installation

### Option 1: Install as a DSH Cordis Bundle (recommended)

1. Clone this repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Henrycheheng/dsh-plugin-matt-skills.git
   cd dsh-plugin-matt-skills
   ```

2. In your DSH session, ask the agent to install the bundle:
   > "Please install the bundle at `/path/to/dsh-matt-pocock-skills` using plugin_manager"

3. After installation, the skills appear in your session skill catalog.

### Option 2: Copy to `~/.dsh/skills/` (simple, no plugin)

```bash
# Copy only the skill directories you want
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills
cp -r assets/skills/grill-with-docs ~/.dsh/skills/
cp -r assets/skills/ask-matt ~/.dsh/skills/
# ... etc
```

DSH's filesystem skill provider automatically discovers skills under `~/.dsh/skills/`.

## Usage

Once installed, skills are available via the DSH skill system:

- **User-invoked skills**: mention the skill name in conversation (e.g., "use ask-matt", "run grill-with-docs")
- **Model-invoked skills**: the agent automatically selects them when the task matches

## Adaptation Notes

The original skills were written for Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI. This DSH adaptation:

- Replaces `sub-agent` references with DSH's `subagent` tool
- Replaces Claude Code-specific tool calls with DSH equivalents
- Adds DSH-compatible YAML frontmatter (`whenToUse`, `user-invocable`, `disable-model-invocation`)
- Skips skills already built into DSH to avoid duplicates

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

- Original skill content: Copyright © 2026 Matt Pocock
- DSH adaptation and plugin plumbing: Copyright © 2025 Contributors

plugins.description: AI research toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: model release radar, model benchmark & community report, AI news digest. 零依赖 Node，4 工具 + 3 技能。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ai-research

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ai-research.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ai-research)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-ai-research.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

**AI 研究三件套** —— 三套零依赖的 Node 工具 + 三份技能 + 一个 DSH 宿主插件：

| 工具 | 回答什么问题 | 数据面 |
|---|---|---|
| **ai-model-radar** | 「最近发了哪些新模型？」 | 发布追踪站 / OpenRouter 上架记录 / 官方博客 RSS / GitHub release / arXiv / Hacker News |
| **model-report** | 「某模型实测、口碑怎么样？A 和 B 哪个强？」 | 13 路结构化跑分（Artificial Analysis、Vals AI 50 基准、SWE-bench、SWE-rebench、ARC Prize、LMArena 人类盲测、llm-stats、benchlm…）+ 英文社区（HN / X / Reddit）+ 中文社区（B站 / CSDN / 微信公众号 / 掘金 / 知乎 / 小红书）+ 2~4 模型重合基准逐项横评 |
| **ai-news-radar** | 「AI 圈最近发生了什么？」 | 46 个 RSS/HTML 源 + 22 个官方 X 账号（按天轮转）+ Google/Bing 新闻检索 + HN / Reddit / 微信公众号，按 8 个主题分类去重 |

产物都是**带来源链接的 Markdown**（一份文档一个 H1 → 元信息引用块 → 目录 → 自动编号章节），
可直接给人读，也可喂给模型做二次解读。**所有数据都来自公开网页 / 公开接口，无 API key 依赖。**

> 研究用途。抓到的是**当时网页上写的东西**，不是事实核验；引用时请连同数据截止时间与数据缺口一起引用。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-ai-research/
  tools/                      # 工具源码（单一事实来源，零依赖纯 Node ESM）
    ai-model-radar/           #   collect / summarize / renderMarkdown / run.mjs 命令行
    model-report/             #   13 路结构化源 + 中文社区 + X/Reddit + LMArena(parquet) + 渲染
    ai-news-radar/            #   源清单 + 采集 + 分类去重 + 渲染 + cli.mjs
  skills/                     # 三份技能正文（Markdown + frontmatter）
  packages/dsh-ai-research/   # 可发布的 DSH 插件包（宿主半，注册 4 工具 + 3 技能）
    index.js                  #   注册与参数校验；工具实现在运行时 import
    cordis.patch.yml          #   profile 插入点
    sync-tools.mjs            #   tools/ → 包内 tools/（发布前 --check）
    sync-skills.mjs           #   skills/ → 包内 skills/（发布前 --check）
    tools/  skills/           #   生成物：包内自包含副本（勿手改）
  PUBLISHING.md               # 发布与投稿清单（npm / 插件目录 / Discussions）
```

## 快速开始（不需要 DSH）

需要 **Node ≥ 18**（用到内置 `fetch`；建议 20+）。无需 `npm install`，仓库零依赖。

```bash
# 最近 7 天有哪些新模型
node tools/ai-model-radar/run.mjs --days 7 --out ./digests

# 某模型体检（--brief 只出一页素材包，快得多）
node tools/model-report/cli.mjs "Gemini 4 Argon" --out ./results
node tools/model-report/cli.mjs "Gemini 4 Argon" --brief --fast

# 2~4 个模型横评（--auto 3 = 自动挑 3 个段位相近的对手）
node tools/model-report/cli.mjs --vs "Gemini 4 Argon,Claude Opus 5.5" --auto 3 --out ./results

# AI 圈新闻日报
node tools/ai-news-radar/cli.mjs --days 1 --out ./digests
node tools/ai-news-radar/cli.mjs --list-sources        # 列源清单
```

常用开关：`--fast` / `--no-x` / `--no-reddit` / `--no-lmarena` / `--no-cn` / `--per-source 5` / `--json`。
想看模块化调用（自己写脚本）见 `skills/*.md` —— 它们同时是**给 agent 的操作手册**，把每个源怎么解析、有哪些坑都写在里面。

## 装成 DSH 插件

插件让这三个工具在**任何会话 / 工作区**都能直接调（4 个工具：`ai_model_radar` / `model_report` / `ai_news_radar` / `ai_fetch_article`）。

**A. 从 npm 装（推荐）**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-ai-research          # 或：node "<DSH app>/lib/plugin-cli.js" desktop add dsh-ai-research
```

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主启动时组装 bundle 图），这三个技能与四个工具在任何会话里都能调。

**B. 本机 link（开发用）** —— 见 `packages/dsh-ai-research/README.md` 的「本机安装」。

**C. 手工三步**（等价于官方 CLI）：profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dependencies` 加一条、`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾加一条、`node_modules` 下建软链，然后**重启 DSH**（宿主插件在启动时组装 bundle 图）。

工具实现在插件里是**运行时 import**：包内 `tools/`（由 `sync-tools.mjs` 同步进来，自包含）；
包内没有 `tools/` 时回退到"本文件上两级"的源码布局；两者都可用插件配置的 `root` 覆盖。

## 环境变量

**一切运行期状态都在用户主目录，不在仓库里** —— 所以仓库可以放心公开，工具也不会因为升级包而丢缓存。

| 变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_HOME` | 状态根目录（缓存 / cookie / 限流状态） | `~/.dsh-ai-research` |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_PROXY` · `MODEL_REPORT_PROXY` · `MR_PROXY` · `HTTPS_PROXY` · `HTTP_PROXY` | 出网代理（按此顺序取第一个非空；`off`/`0`/`none` = 关闭） | 未设 = **直连** |
| `NO_PROXY` / `no_proxy` | 免代理主机（支持 `*`、`example.com`、`.example.com`） | — |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_COOKIES` · `MODEL_REPORT_COOKIES` | cookie 文件路径 | `<home>/cookies.json` |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_CHROME` · `CHROME_PATH` · `CHROME_BIN` | 浏览器可执行文件（小红书走无头 Chrome） | 按平台常见安装位置 + `PATH` 自动探测 |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_CHROME_PROFILE` | 无头浏览器 profile 目录 | 系统临时目录 `dsh-chrome-xhs` |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_OUT` | ai-news-radar 的默认落盘目录 | `./digests` |

国内网络环境常常需要代理才能访问 HF / Google News / Reddit / X，例如：

```bash
DSH_AI_RESEARCH_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 node tools/model-report/cli.mjs "某模型"
```

## 需要自备的凭据（可选）

只有两个源要登录态，**没有也能跑**（会在报告的「数据缺口」里显式声明，绝不静默返空）：

- **知乎**、**小红书** —— cookie 放进 `<home>/cookies.json`，字段名 `zhihu` / `xiaohongshu`。
  导入方式见 `skills/model-report.md`：`node tools/model-report/set-cookie.mjs zhihu ["<关键词>"] --test`。
- cookie 文件等同登录凭据：**不要提交、不要外发**（`.gitignore` 已挡）。

## 已知边界（都写在技能文件里，这里只列结论）

- **抓取是有礼貌的**：串行 + 间隔的请求节奏、磁盘缓存、以及真被限流时的熔断与 `gaps` 声明。
  X 的 syndication 是硬配额（30 次 / 15 分钟）；小红书走无头浏览器且每天新开页面上限 4 次，命中风控即 24h 冷却。
- **有些站就是拿不到**（Cloudflare / 登录墙 / 客户端渲染），技能里逐条记了「试过但拿不到，别再重复探」，例如 lmarena.ai 站点本体、HuggingFace 模型卡正文、Bloomberg / FT / Reuters 正文。
- **不同源的分数不可混算**：AA 智能指数、benchlm 综合分、LMArena Elo 是三套刻度，只能各自内部比；横评里只对**同名基准**做逐项对比（同名 harness 也可能不同，只能当方向参考）。
- 命令示例以 **Windows / PowerShell** 为准（源码作者在 Windows 上开发）；macOS / Linux 把 `$env:X=...` 换成 `X=... 命令` 即可，路径与浏览器探测都已按平台分支。

## 开发

```bash
# 改完 tools/ 或 skills/ 后同步进包（发布前用 --check 卡住漂移）
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-tools.mjs
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-skills.mjs
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-tools.mjs  --check
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-skills.mjs --check

# 语法自检
node --check tools/model-report/lib.mjs
```

改插件本体（`packages/dsh-ai-research/index.js`）后要**重启 DSH** 才生效。

## 发布

见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)：GitHub 建仓（`dsh-plugin` topic + 满 1 天）→ npm 发布 → 两个插件目录 PR → 官方 Discussions「Show Your Plugins!」。

## License

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH skill map: all your loaded skills, sorted into your own categories, in a right-sidebar tab.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-map

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![dsh-skill-map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/main/assets/banner.svg)

**It sorts all your skills, so you can find the right one fast.**

Once you have installed a lot of skills in DSH, the names stop telling you which one does what. This plugin (a small add-on for DSH) puts them on one page in the right sidebar, and you group them your own way. Code in one pile, docs in another, spreadsheets in a third — or often used and rarely used.

What you sort is saved on your own computer, so a new version of the plugin will not wipe it.

## What it looks like

![The skill map panel: workspace tabs on top, skills sorted into categories, Unassigned and the total at the bottom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/main/assets/skill-map-panel.png)

## What it does

- One more page in the right sidebar, just for skills.
- One workspace is one way of sorting. Click the little tab on top to switch to another way.
- Want to keep another way of sorting? Click "+" to make one; double-click a tab to rename it, click "×" to delete it (it asks first).
- On first open, you can let AI sort everything for you once.
- Or make your own categories first, then let AI put the skills that are still loose into them. Anything you placed stays where you put it.
- Categories can be renamed, dragged into a new order, or deleted. Drag a skill and it moves to another category.
- Each skill is one line: the name, then one sentence about what it does. Hover over the line to see which GitHub project it came from and a longer description.
- The search box finds skills by name and by those descriptions.
- Click a line and `/skill-name` is copied, ready to paste into the composer.
- Not sure where a skill goes yet? Drop it in "Unassigned" at the bottom of the list.
- If a description looks thin, press Update and let AI write more. AI never overwrites a line you wrote yourself.

## Install

Install DSH first. Then paste this line into a terminal and press Enter:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kissfire/dsh-skill-map
```

Restart `dsh web`, and the right sidebar gets one more tab: "Skill Map".

If that does not work, download the ready-built package instead. The link never changes and always points at the newest release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/releases/latest/download/kissfire-dsh-skill-map.tgz
```

## License

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

## For more detail

The fine print, for people who want it. Click to open.

<details>
<summary>Where it shows up, where the file lives, changing the language</summary>

- With `dsh-better-sidebar` installed it is a tab in that sidebar; without it, a tab in the official right Sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`), opened once on first load.
- When neither right sidebar is running it falls back to a central panel and adds an icon in the sidebar's panel list, so there is always a way in.
- Everything you sort lives in `$DSH_HOME/skill-map/map.json`. If the file is missing or broken it goes back to "no workspace yet" instead of planting a classification you never confirmed.
- The gear in the header switches the description language: the skill's own text, or a translation cache in `$DSH_HOME/skill-map/descriptions.<lang>.json`. A skill with no row in the cache keeps its own text.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Config</summary>

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Master switch for the host routes. |
| `customSkillDirs` | string[] | Extra skill roots to scan besides the official ones. |
| `dshHome` | string | DSH home override; the workspace document lives under it. |
| `agentsHome` | string | Agents home override (`~/.agents`). |
| `syncModel` | string | Model route (`provider/model`) used by Update and auto classify. Defaults to the model this profile's agent runs. |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Routes</summary>

| Route | Method | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/list` | GET | Every skill, plus each workspace with its placements resolved. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/save` | POST | Writes the whole workspace document. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/workspaces/auto` | POST | Classify with the model: propose a scheme for an empty workspace, place only the unassigned skills in one that already has categories. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/health` | GET | Health check carrying the skill and workspace counts. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/sync` | POST | Asks the model for the missing and changed copy. |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Security and limits</summary>

- At most 20 workspaces, and at most 200 categories per workspace; categories are flat, with no nesting.
- Every route is loopback-only (or a paired device), and skill roots are read-only; the plugin writes only its own files under the DSH home directory.
- The workspace document is written atomically and parsed defensively; a broken file degrades to the blank state.
- Update and auto classify need an `llm` service in the profile; without one they report it as unavailable, and a scheme proposal falls back to the built-in table.
- The browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC day (random id plus package name): [src/client/telemetry.ts](src/client/telemetry.ts).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Development and release</summary>

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
```

To ship: bump `version` in `package.json`, run `pnpm publish:npm`, then attach the `npm pack` artifact to a GitHub release.

</details>

plugins.description: dsh 插件：AI 选择题自动加一项「幸运方块」随机决定 + 说「回滚」撤销；界面上的骰子按钮长按挖穿即触发随机事件（写论文/我的世界概念合成/冷笑话/冷知识/时事新闻/弹窗表演/蓝屏屏保），整体致敬《赛博朋克 2077》的四季宝
plugins.readme_text:
# 幸运方块 (dsh-lucky-block)

一个 dsh 插件，同时工作在 dsh web 与 dsh desktop。两件事：

1. **幸运方块选项** —— AI 向你提选择题时，每个问题的选项末尾会自动多出一个「幸运方块」。
   选它，就随机替你挑一个选项、或把几个选项揉成一个新方案，全随机。
   不满意？说一句「回滚」（或打 `/rollback`），立刻回到上一版本。
2. **幸运方块按钮** —— 屏幕角落一个可拖动、可锁定的我的世界幸运方块（16×16 原版方块面贴图）。
   闲着没事就戳它一下：**左键单点**零成本，抽弹窗表演 / 假蓝屏 / 今日运气 / 冷知识 / 冷笑话；
   **长按** 1.4 秒挖穿它，伴随裂纹、碎裂粒子和原版 Minecraft 挖石头声，接着它会在你的
   默认工作区自动开一个新会话，**全程不需要你做任何事**地随机写篇论文 / 扒几条新闻 / 整理待办。
   松手时方块若离屏幕边缘够近（48px 以内）会**自动吸附贴边**。

它会说话。所有随机事件都套着一层固定的说话腔调：短句、机器口吻、偶尔损你一句。
这套腔调是纯文本的，参数在 `lib/persona.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PERSONA` 里，
可以用配置里的 `persona` 整段换成你自己写的性格。
它**从不往会话里写东西**，所以绝不会污染你的对话历史。

## 两个池：单击零成本，长按才花钱

脚本现在分成**两个互相独立的池**，触发方式不同，抽的东西也不同：

| 触发 | 代价 | 池 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **左键单点** | 零 token、零延迟、**不建会话** | 弹窗 / 蓝屏 / 抽签 / 冷知识 / 冷笑话 |
| **长按挖满**（1.4 秒） | 开新会话、调模型 | 论文 / 新闻 / 待办整理 |

单点是手滑也会发生的动作，所以它不该有成本；长按是明确意图，才值得花 token。
分成两个池而不是一个池加过滤，是为了让两边的权重能独立调节 —— 否则往单击池
里加十条音频，会把长按事件的命中率一起稀释掉。

### 单击池（5 个事件，权重合计 14）

| 概率 | 事件 | 类型 | 会做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 14.3% | 无害弹窗表演 | 视觉 | 界面上连弹 24 个无意义提示框，再按创建顺序倒序全部关掉 |
| 14.3% | 蓝屏屏保（60 秒） | 视觉 | 全屏显示一份仿 Windows 蓝屏，60 秒后自动恢复，按 ESC 提前结束 |
| 21.4% | 抽今日运气 | 本地 | 抽一档签文：鸿运齐天 / 大吉 / 中吉 / 小吉 / 平 / 凶。**不调 AI**，附「无科学依据，仅供参考」 |
| 28.6% | 随机冷知识闲聊 | 本地 | 从 818 条本地冷知识库里抽 1~3 条，一次说完 |
| 21.4% | 冷笑话专场 | 本地 | 从 353 条本地笑话库里抽 1~2 条 |

### 长按池（3 个事件，权重合计 8）

| 概率 | 事件 | 类型 | 会做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 37.5% | 随机选题写论文 | AI | 随机词条拼出题目（如「边缘计算 × 古籍数字化 × 的鲁棒性研究」），写 4 节正文并落盘到 `lucky-block-papers/<hash>.md` |
| 37.5% | 时事新闻速览 | AI | **联网**检索 3 条最近真实新闻，每条一句事实 + 一句点评 + 来源链接；查不到就直说，绝不编 |
| 25.0% | 随机整理待办 | AI | 列出工作区最近改的 5 个文件，随机分「紧急 / 不紧急」并明说自己不可信 |

**单击池五个全部零 token、不建会话、零延迟** —— 点下去立刻有反应。

「抽今日运气」**一天只抽一次**：当天再点，返回的还是那一签，并在末尾注明
「今天已经抽过了，签不会变。明天再来。」。状态记在
`$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-lucky-block/fortune-state.json`，删掉这个文件就等于当天重抽。

「抽今日运气」的签文权重是刻意偏吉的：**吉类合计 90%**（鸿运齐天 5% / 大吉 26% /
中吉 33% / 小吉 26%），平 9.9%，凶只有 **0.1%**；
而且**「凶」的正文是反着写的**（「从某种角度来说，你运气还挺好 —— 今天该踩的坑都提前踩完了」），
抽到下签也能笑一下。这个插件是用来打发时间的，不是用来给人添堵的。

### 音频事件（骨架已就位，等清单）

`lib/audio-tracks.json` 现在是空数组，对应的事件权重为 0、不参与抽取。
以后往这个 json 里填 `{ "file": "xxx.ogg", "title": "显示名" }`，
把文件丢进 `lib/audio/`，事件就自动开始参与抽取 —— **不用改代码**。
文件名只接受 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` + `.ogg|.mp3`，防目录穿越。

### 骰子会话里你只会看到一行字

开新会话的那 3 个事件，**用户消息只有一行**（`🎲 随机事件：时事新闻速览`），
人格设定和任务正文走的是**系统提示**，不会糊在你眼前。

这样做纯粹是为了观感 —— 之前用户消息里塞着几百字的指令墙，点进会话第一眼就是它。
需要说明的是，宿主没有「发一条不显示的消息」这种能力（`PromptContentPart` 只有
text / image / file 三种，没有任何可见性字段），所以这里不是把消息藏起来，
而是**根本不把它发成消息**。

清单可用 `node tools/list-events.mjs` 随时重新生成 —— 它直接从 `lib/index.js`
的 `buildEvents()` 里解析并按池分组，不会和代码漂移。

## 设置面板（右键方块 → 设置…）

| 开关 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 长按挖掘音效 | 循环挖掘声 + 碎裂声。关掉就完全静音 |

面板里还列着事件清单，每条事件标着它属于**单击**还是**长按** ——
照着这张表就知道点一下会发生什么、要不要花 token。

冷知识和冷笑话现在**固定走本地库**，不再有「调不调 AI」的开关：
它们本来就在单击池里，单击不该有成本，给一个勾选框只会让人以为这里能省钱。

| 本地库 | 条数 | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 冷笑话 + 点评 | 353 条 + 30 条 | `lib/jokes-data.json` |
| 冷知识 | 818 条（人体 133 / 动物 139 / 科学 121 / 日常 111 / 历史 111 / 地理 103 / 语言 100） | `lib/trivia-data.json` |

冷知识库里分主题存的 `topic` **只用于统计，永远不显示给用户** —— 显示主题等于
把「这是一条从哪抽的」直接摊开。笑话的 `form` 字段同理。

两个库的**完整内容**可以在 [`lib/语料库总览.md`](<lib/语料库总览.md>) 里逐条翻阅；
那份文件由 `node tools/build-corpus-overview.mjs` 从运行库生成，改动语料后重跑即可
（`--check` 用于回归时校验它没过期）。

写进配置也会被忽略并记一条警告。

设置写在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json`，是**手写与界面共用的同一个文件**
（界面保存走读-改-写，不会抹掉你手写的 `model` / `persona`）：

```json
{
  "sound": true,
  "model": { "provider": "workbuddy", "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash", "reasoningEffort": "low" }
}
```

`localOnly` 已经没有了 —— 冷知识/冷笑话现在无条件走本地库，见上面「设置面板」一节。
老配置里留着这个字段不会报错，只是被忽略。

## 安装（本地开发）

```bash
# 方式一：直接指向本目录（plugin-manager 支持本地 spec）
#   在插件市场里「安装」填本目录的绝对路径

# 方式二：npm 打包后按包装
npm pack
```

装完后**不需要**动 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`：宿主侧条目由本包
`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动插入，profile 的 patch 里再加一条同 id 的
`- insert:` 反而会造成组装冲突、让插件加载不上（实测踩过）。

只要确认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有
`"dsh-lucky-block"`（插件市场安装会自动加；手动装则加这一行）。

`"patchReload": "live"`（profile 自带）让 `cordis.patch.yml` 热生效；但**改动
`bundles` 列表必须重启 dsh**才生效。

> ⚠️ **改 `lib/` 下的任何 JS 都必须重启 dsh。** 宿主侧插件代码没有热重载 ——
> 正在跑的进程内存里持有旧模块，代码改了行为不会变。这个坑骗过一整轮排查：
> 源码里已经搜不到某段字符串，会话里却还在出现它，最后才发现是进程跑的是旧代码。
> 客户端那半（`lib/client.js`）刷新页面即可，但桌面端要重启宿主才会重新收集注入行。

## 可选配置：给骰子会话单独指定模型

**默认不启用**，骰子会话直接沿用你的默认模型。想让随机事件跑便宜/快的模型时，
在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json` 写（这个字段只能手写，设置面板里没有）：

```json
{
  "model": {
    "provider": "workbuddy",
    "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    "reasoningEffort": "low"
  }
}
```

`reasoningEffort` 可省略。`provider` / `model` 必须**精确匹配**可用目录里的名字
（目录拿不到时会跳过切换、不影响掷骰子），不确定就先用 `/dice` 命令观察日志。

> ⚠️ **为什么默认关着**：宿主只提供会话级 `sessionController.selectModel`，而它
> 成功后会把这次选择**异步写成 profile 的全局默认模型**。也就是说开启本配置后，
> 第一次掷骰子会顺带把你的默认模型也改成这里写的那个。想恢复就把文件删掉，
> 再在界面里手动把默认模型选回来。

## 用法

| 想干什么 | 怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 让 AI 给选择题加幸运方块 | 正常提问，选项末尾自动多一项 |
| 抽一次零成本的（弹窗/蓝屏/签/冷知识/笑话） | **左键单点**方块 / 打 `/dice` |
| 抽一次要花 token 的（论文/新闻/待办） | **长按**方块挖到碎裂 / 打 `/dice` |
| 不满意，回去 | 说「回滚」或打 `/rollback` |
| 方块按钮固定住不挡路 | 右键方块 → 锁定（或双击）；锁定后仍可单点/长按触发 |
| 让方块贴边 | 把它拖到离屏幕边缘 48px 以内松手，自动吸附 |
| 改设置 | 右键方块 → 设置… |

**单点零成本、长按才花钱**：单点只在单击池里抽（五个事件全是本地/视觉，
不建会话、不调模型）；长按只在长按池里抽（三个事件都会开新会话调模型）。
单点是手滑也会发生的动作，所以它不该有成本。

长按阈值 1.4 秒（`lib/client.js` 的 `BREAK_MS`）。按住时手指挪动超过 5 像素即判为
「在拖动按钮」并取消挖掘——所以拖位置和挖方块不会打架。松开或移开都会取消挖掘，
纹路和挖掘声**立刻**一起停。

音效从宿主的 `/dsh-lucky-block/sound/*.ogg` 按需取（16 个原版音节，共 142 KB），
**不内联进客户端 bundle** —— `lib/client.js` 是每次页面启动都要下载的入口，
为只在长按瞬间才用到的音效把它撑大 4 倍不划算。挖掘声每 210ms 一个、4 个变体随机轮播
（只听一个会明显「卡带」），挖穿那一刻再叠一声碎裂音；同时最多 6 个 Audio 元素，
页面切到后台自动静音。

松手吸附（`SNAP_THRESHOLD = 48`）只在**真的拖动过**时生效：鼠标只是滑出方块边缘
（会触发 `pointerleave`）不会吸附，按下就松手也不会。锁定状态下完全不吸附 —— 锁定
就是不建拖动状态，自然短路。吸附有 160ms 的 `left/top` 过渡，视觉上是滑过去而不是瞬移。

方块按钮位置与锁定状态存在浏览器 localStorage（键 `dshLuckyBlock.block`），换机器不跟。

## 出错了怎么看

方块头顶的气泡**只在报错时出现**（正常触发的进度、成功、会话 ID 都不写了 ——
有视觉表演的事件自己会演，没表演的由新会话内容承担反馈）。报错时气泡里是宿主
翻译过的**人话**，点一下可以关掉，例如：

| 情况 | 气泡说什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件本体没激活（改动 `lib/` 后没重启） | 插件没有注册这个接口，通常是插件本体未激活：重启 dsh 后再试 |
| 登录态过期 | 宿主拒绝了请求（未登录或登录已过期），刷新页面后重试 |
| 默认工作区被删/移走 | 默认工作区目录不存在或已被移动。请在 dsh 里重新确认默认工作区路径后再试 |
| 工作区不可写 | 没有权限写入工作区（被系统或沙箱拦下了） |
| `config.json` 里的模型不在目录里 | 模型不可用：config.json 里指定的 provider/model 不在可用目录中 |
| 都不是 | 意外错误：<宿主的原始信息> |

想看完整堆栈就翻宿主日志（`dsh` 标准输出）——那边始终打的是原始错误。

> 音效**不会**报错。拿不到音效文件、浏览器拦截自动播放、没有可用音频设备 ——
> 这些一律静默忽略。音效是锦上添花，为它弹一个红色报错气泡是本末倒置。

## 目录

- `lib/index.js` —— 宿主侧（Node）：选项注入、答案识别、回滚、幸运方块事件（分单击/长按两个池）、默认工作区会话创建、可选模型切换、人格层与状态机、本地语料库、音频清单、设置读写、音效文件投放、错误翻译。
- `lib/client.js` —— 客户端（浏览器）：可拖拽幸运方块按钮（含边缘吸附、锁定）+ 单击/长按分流 + 长按挖掘裂纹 / 碎裂粒子 / 音效 + 音频播放 + 弹窗表演 + 蓝屏屏保 + 设置面板 + 台词气泡。
- `lib/persona.js` —— 随机事件的人格层（纯函数，可单测）：默认人格、覆盖合并、人格段拼装、任务正文保护、收尾点评请求。
- `lib/jokes.js` —— 本地笑话库加载器（读 `jokes-data.json`，带 BOM 剥离与只读一次缓存）。
- `lib/jokes-data.json` / `lib/trivia-data.json` —— 本地语料库。
- `lib/audio-tracks.json` —— 音频事件清单（现在是空数组，填上就开始抽）。
- `lib/audio/` —— 音频文件目录，由宿主 `/dsh-lucky-block/audio/<file>` 投放。
- `lib/sounds/` —— 16 个原版 Minecraft 音效（`.ogg`，共 142 KB），由宿主按需投放。
- `cordis.patch.yml` —— 把宿主侧插件插进插件树（客户端那半由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 自动加载）。

## 素材出处

方块面与裂纹是原版 Minecraft 像素素材，以 base64 data URI 内联在 `lib/client.js` 里
（静态 bundle 的 `require()` 只认包 id、不认相对路径，所以不做成独立模块）：

| 素材 | 尺寸 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 方块面 | 16×16 | `alexsocha/luckyblock` mod 的 `lucky_block.png` |
| 挖掘裂纹 10 帧 | 16×16 ×10 | 原版资源包 `PixiGeko/Minecraft-default-assets` 的 `assets/minecraft/textures/block/destroy_stage_0..9.png` |

裂纹用 `image-rendering: pixelated` 保持硬边，长按时按进度切到下一帧，最后一帧之后碎裂。
之所以找原素材而不是手绘：手绘的裂纹再怎么调都像程序生成的线条，和那张像素方块贴图
放在一起会突兀；换成原版的黑褐裂纹 + 白色反光碎屑，才是游戏里挖方块的样子。

音效是 Minecraft 1.20.1 原版 assets（`dig/stone1..4.ogg`、`random/break.ogg`），
经 `tools/build-sounds.mjs` 从 mcasset.cloud 镜像取到 `lib/sounds/`。版权归 Mojang Studios；
本插件只作本地开发期素材镜像，**运行时不依赖网络**。

默认性格是机器客服口吻 + 音量梗 + 人体数据冷知识，靠语气和句式传达。
实现里刻意**不提任何作品名、角色名或制造商**，也不靠名字塑造性格 ——
`persona-check.mjs` 有多条断言盯着这一点。

开发期工具（`tools/`，安装运行不依赖）：
`host-smoke.mjs` 跑宿主侧回归（含音效路由与白名单）、
`persona-check.mjs` 人格层单测（真 import）、
`snap-check.mjs` 吸附纯函数（从 `client.js` 抽源码跑，不会与实现漂移）、
`config-check.mjs` 配置读取（含 BOM 坑）、
`local-check.mjs` 本地语料库与分流、
`verify-sounds.mjs` 音效文件 ↔ 客户端清单 ↔ 宿主白名单三方一致性、
`list-events.mjs` 打印事件清单与概率、
`merge-trivia.mjs` / `merge-jokes.mjs` 语料合并器（`--check` 只体检不写盘）、
`build-corpus-overview.mjs` 重新生成 `lib/语料库总览

plugins.description: Animated DeepSeek whale pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI - live status, completion chime, and an interaction + token/cost panel. No dependencies, no build step.
plugins.readme_text:
# 🐋 Whale pet

一个 DeepSeek 蓝色鲸鱼宠物插件,住在 Harness Web UI 右下角。

- **动效** — 空闲时轻轻浮动;工作时游动加快、气泡上升、光环脉动、外圈转动。
- **状态** — 实时显示 Harness 是否在工作,以及正在处理哪个会话。
- **音效** — 工作完成时播放 `assets/tone.wav`;失败时播放该音色的下行合成版本;开始工作时轻响一声。
- **用量与花费** — 点击鲸鱼展开面板,显示本会话的 token 分解(缓存命中 / 未命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出)、按官方费率算出的人民币(或美元)金额、会话时长、账户余额,以及每一次交互的明细。
- **交互记录** — 每条记录含提示词、回复摘要、工具 / 轮次 / 步骤计数、耗时与费用。

## 换音效

**完成音是一份文件,不是代码。** 直接替换即可:

```
plugin/assets/tone.wav
```

支持 `.wav` / `.mp3` / `.ogg` / `.m4a` / `.aac` / `.flac` / `.webm`(改名成 `tone.wav` 之外的扩展名后,同步改
`plugin/client.js` 里的 `TONE_URL` 常量)。

- 建议 **0.3–1.5 秒**、峰值接近但不超过 1.0,否则会被削波
- 改了资源要**重启 DSH**(主机端只在加载时读取一次,之后从内存提供)
- 若资源缺失或无法解码,**自动回退到合成音效**,不会静音

## 面板里的音色选择

下拉框的 5 个选项**播放的确实是不同的声音**:

| 选项 | 完成音来源 |
|---|---|
| **明亮铃音 Bright（音频文件）** | `assets/tone.wav` |
| 柔和木琴 Soft | 实时合成 |
| 木质马林巴 Marimba | 实时合成 |
| 轻点提示 Click | 实时合成 |
| 长尾钟声 Bell | 实时合成 |

每个音色用 `source` 字段声明完成音走哪条路:`'asset'` 播文件,`'synth'` 实时合成。
**失败与开始提示音始终是合成的**(资源里只有成功音),会跟随所选音色。

想只保留一种声音,把 `DEFAULT_TONE` 改成对应名字即可;其余选项仍留在下拉框里。

## 安装

需要 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2**(已验证版本)。

通过 Plugin Manager 安装,路径必须是**绝对路径**:

```
install_bundle  target: <绝对路径>/dsh-whale-pet/package
```

也支持 tarball(本地或 HTTP)与 git 仓库:

```
install_bundle  target: C:\path\to\dsh-whale-pet.tgz
install_bundle  target: https://example.com/dsh-whale-pet.tgz
```

`install_bundle` 会自己完成 profile 的包安装与 bundle 启用。**不要**手改 profile 的
`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`,也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm。

## 启用与确认

- `Config.listConfigs name=dsh-whale-pet` → 应有一条 `include:pet-whale`
- `Slots.listSubTree root=shell.overlay` → 占用者 `pet-whale`,`active: true`
- `GET /pet-whale/state` → `{"ok":true,"version":3,…}`

## 改动后如何生效

| 改了什么 | 需要做什么 |
|---|---|
| `client.js`(界面) | 刷新页面(必要时 Ctrl+Shift+R 绕过缓存) |
| `index.js`(主机端) | **重启 DSH** |

原因:加载器每个进程世代只 import 一次 ES 模块,禁用/启用 bundle 只是复用缓存,
不会重新读取 `index.js`。

## 依赖情况

**没有任何运行时依赖,也没有 import。** 不需要 `node_modules`、不需要构建步骤:

- 主机端只用 Node 内置能力,不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包(这也是它能从裸
  `link:` 目录加载的原因)。
- 浏览器端是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` 格式,Web shell 本来就
  消费这种格式;React 从浏览器模块表里取。

安装方式决定了后续行为:

- 从**目录**安装 → profile 里建立 `link:`,指向你的文件夹,之后改动立即生效。
- 从 **tarball** 安装 → 复制一份,版本被冻结。**分发时用 tarball。**

## 运行环境要求

- profile 必须提供 `webServer`(随 Web 组合自带),否则面板拿不到数据。
- `deepseekAccount` 为可选:有它才显示账户余额;没有它其余功能照常,余额行不出现。
- 面板样式只使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token,自动适配明暗主题。

## 说明

鲸鱼轮廓取自官方 Harness 品牌标的几何数据(`FISH_LOGO_PATH`),以便宠物与产品
视觉一致;该美术资源版权归 DeepSeek 所有,本包不主张任何权利。详见 `LICENSE`。

完整的设计说明、实现取舍与验证方式见仓库根目录的 `DESIGN.md`。

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

plugins.description: DSH 出口线路池（测试阶段）: 集中管理 GitHub/npm/PyPI/HF 出站线路，自动探测健康度、按速选线、失败切换；子进程走正规通道且零污染全局配置
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-line-pool · DSH 出口线路池

> ⚠️ **测试阶段（v0.6.2）** — 核心能力已实现并通过 562 项测试（离线 472 项，不含核对脚本），但在真实使用中的长期表现尚未积累数据。接口与线路表可能调整。欢迎试用与反馈，不建议在生产环境依赖。
>
> 给 DeepSeek Harness 一个**集中管理的出站线路池**：把 GitHub / npm / PyPI / HuggingFace 等各类出口的候选线路收在一处，**自动探测健康度、按速度选线、失败自动切换**，让模型不再把时间浪费在慢线路和超时上。

- 许可：MIT
- 平台：Windows（DSH Desktop 实测）；核心逻辑跨平台
- 无需管理员权限：不改 hosts、不装 CA、不设系统代理
- 状态：**测试阶段**（见上方提示）

## 快速开始

```powershell
cd <你的路径>\line-pool
node install-line-pool.mjs install    # 装进 profile 并跑 pnpm install
```

然后**完全退出并重启 DSH**（不是刷新页面）。重启后自动生效，无需任何配置：

- 模型写 `pip install requests` → 实际执行 `pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ requests`
- 模型写 `git clone https://github.com/o/r` → 自动走最快的 GitHub 镜像
- 面板出现在右侧栏（装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 则在「设置 → 侧边卡片」）

装完没反应？看 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\line-pool\line-pool.log`，或查[故障排查](#故障排查)。

---

## 这个插件解决什么

原始痛点不是"不通"，而是**"用错了那条"**：

```
npm 装包     官方源超时 10.3s  →  腾讯镜像 224ms        差 46 倍
GitHub raw   直连 653ms 可用   →  而 DSH 里硬编码的第一条兜底 gh-proxy.com 是死的
pip 装包     官方源 817ms      →  阿里云镜像 983ms      ← 反直觉：官方更快
```

最后一条尤其关键：**"国内镜像一定快"是错的**。速度随时间和网络环境波动，必须实测，不能按刻板印象写死。本插件就是干这个的。

---

## 它能干什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **线路池管理** | 内置 15 条实测过的线路（GitHub raw/codeload/main、npm、PyPI、HF、通用直连），外加 10 条已知失效线路备查 |
| **两阶段探测** | 先并发 TCP/TLS 握手（便宜）→ 按延迟+丢包排序 → 只对前 N 条做真实 HTTP 拉取（贵）。15 条线路约 7 秒探完 |
| **健康状态机** | `HEALTHY → COOLING → PROBING`，失败只认 DNS/TLS/超时/断连四类；冷却阶梯 2→5→15 分钟，成功即恢复 |
| **按类选线** | 专线优先、通用兜底。`github-raw` 请求只走 GitHub 类线路，全挂才用直连垫底 |
| **URL 改写** | 4 种规则：前缀拼接（gh-proxy 类）、registry 替换、index 替换、域名替换（HF）；另有 `rewrite: null` 表示直连不改写 |
| **子进程传递** | `git` / `pip` / `npm` / `pnpm` / `gh` / `curl` 各走各自的正规通道，**零污染用户全局配置** |
| **上游 IP 表自验** | 拉取公开的 GitHub 域名→IP 表（多源自动切换），**逐个 IP 做 TLS 握手 + 证书链校验**（自签名/过期/域名不符一律拒），只保留真正可用的 IP；导出 `hosts` 片段供用户自行应用 |
| **线路表自动更新** | 内置 **20 条候选镜像**，全部经真实握手 + HTTP 验证后才纳入（实测：纳入 16 / 拒绝 4）。**每次启动后若无记录则自动发现一次，之后每 24 小时一遍**；另支持人工补充（`lines-custom.json`）。优先级 `custom > auto > seed` |
| **侧边栏面板** | 可视化查看每条线路的健康/延迟/失败原因、按类别的选线顺序、上游自验结果；支持**单条手测**、**启停线路**、**手动重测**、**复制 hosts 片段**。挂在 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的侧边卡片上（可启停开关），没装时自动回退到 DSH 原生右侧栏 |
| **接线：给模型的工具** | 注册 `line_pool_status`（查现在哪条快、各类目标会选哪条）与 `line_pool_run`（跑一条下载命令并自动注入最快线路的镜像参数） |
| **接线：拦截子进程** | 包住 DSH 的 shell seam，**自动改写模型的下载命令**：`git clone` → URL 加前缀、`pip install` → 插 `-i`、`npm`/`pnpm` → `--registry=`、HF → `HF_ENDPOINT`、`curl`/`wget` → URL 加前缀。改写失败或无可用线路 → 原样放行；用户已指定镜像 → 不覆盖；命令结构复杂 → 整体放弃 |
| **网络环境检测** | 面板常驻显示 **TUN 开关状态**与**本地代理端口**：网卡名 + TUN 常用网段（198.18/15）实时判定，纯本地零成本；代理端口扫描 13 个常见端口（回环，7ms）。两枚芯片均可点击立即重测 |
| **状态可观测** | 探测结果落 `status.json` + 日志；每次探测后刷新 |

### 覆盖范围（诚实声明）

| 范围 | 是否覆盖 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| **模型用 bash 工具跑的下载命令** | ✅ **覆盖** | 插件包住 `ctx.shell.execute`，命令到达 shell 前被改写 |
| **模型主动调 `line_pool_run`** | ✅ **覆盖** | 插件注册的工具，显式走线路池 |
| **其他插件显式调 `ctx.linePool.fetchLine()`** | ✅ 可覆盖 | 但**需要调用方自己这么做**，插件不会替它接管 |
| **DSH 宿主自身的 `fetch`** | ❌ **不覆盖** | 技术可行（P0 实测 `setGlobalDispatcher` 能接管原生 fetch），但**本插件从未接线**。当前接管方式只有上表前两条 |
| **Electron 渲染进程的 `fetch`** | ❌ **不覆盖** | 走 Chromium 网络栈，与 Node/undici 是两套独立栈（实测确认，见下文） |

> ⚠️ 上表第 4 行是最容易误解的一条：**"装了本插件"不等于"DSH 里所有网络请求都会走最优线路"**。
> 它只接管模型跑的命令与显式调用。宿主内部、页面里、其他插件自己的 `fetch` 都不受影响。
> B 方案（接管宿主 fetch）在 P0 验证过可行性，但未实现 —— 见 `P0/verdict.md`。

### 它不做什么（同样重要）

| 不会做的事 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **不设系统代理、不改注册表** | 一旦进程崩溃不恢复，会导致整机断网（dev-sidecar 记录过这类副作用） |
| **不装 CA 证书、不做 MITM** | 装 CA 需要管理员权限，且部分应用仍不信任；出问题排查成本极高 |
| **不自动写 `hosts`** | 写 hosts 要管理员权限，写错会让整机某些域名全挂。只**产出**已验证片段，应用与否由你决定 |
| **不修改你的全局配置** | 不写 `~/.npmrc`、不写 `git config --global`、不写 `pip.conf`。所有改写都用命令行参数或单次 env 传递 |
| **不联网上报任何数据** | 只有出站请求（拉上游 IP 表、探测线路），没有遥测、没有回调 |

设计原则：**能力靠 URL 改写实现，出问题最多影响一次请求，不会让整机断网。**

---

## 安装

### 前置

- DSH Desktop（本机实测 `0.2.0-rc.2`，Node 24.18.1）
- **无第三方依赖**（v0.6.1 起移除了 undici —— 它当时只用于一个没人读的版本字符串）。
  插件的宿主包解析走 `createRequire().resolve()`，从 profile / DSH 安装目录动态定位，不写死路径

### 安装步骤

```powershell
# 1. 进入本目录
cd <你的路径>\line-pool

# 2. 安装（自动改 profile 的 dependencies + bundles，并跑 pnpm install）
node install-line-pool.mjs install

# 3. 完全退出并重启 DSH
#    重启后插件会自动做首次探测

# 4. 查看结果
#    日志  : %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\line-pool\line-pool.log
#    快照  : %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\line-pool\status.json
```

**可选参数**：

```powershell
node install-line-pool.mjs install --profile=<profile名>       # 默认 desktop
node install-line-pool.mjs install --profile-dir=<绝对路径>     # 直接指定目录
node install-line-pool.mjs status                               # 只看状态，不改动
```

### 卸载

```powershell
node install-line-pool.mjs uninstall
# 然后重启 DSH。数据目录会保留（供诊断），需要的话手动删 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\line-pool
```

---

## 怎么用

### 1. 看线路状态（安装后无需配置）

重启后自动探测，结果在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\line-pool\status.json`：

```json
{
  "lastProbeAt": "2026-10-16T10:02:45.194Z",
  "envInfo": { "viaProxy": false, "note": "未检测到代理环境变量…" },
  "lines": [
    { "id": "pypi-aliyun", "healthy": true, "latencyMs": 75, "state": "HEALTHY" }
  ],
  "availableByKind": {
    "github-raw": ["gh-raw-ghfast", "gh-raw-direct", "http-direct"]
  }
}
```

`availableByKind` 就是**每类请求会按什么顺序尝试**——排在最前的是最快的。

### 2. 把请求走选中线路（宿主内）

```js
// 在你的插件里：从 ctx 拿到本插件实例
const pool = ctx.linePool;

// 按类别发请求，自动选最快线路 + 失败自动换下一条
const res = await pool.fetchLine('github-raw', 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a/b/c');
```

### 3. 让子进程走选中线路

```js
import { spawnWithLine } from 'dsh-line-pool/lib/spawn.js';

// 各工具自动选正经通道，不改任何全局配置
await spawnWithLine('git',  ['clone', 'https://github.com/a/b'], line);
await spawnWithLine('pip',  ['install', 'requests'],            line);
await spawnWithLine('npm',  ['install', 'lodash'],              line);
```

先用 `planSpawn` 预览会执行什么（**不实际运行**）：

```js
import { planSpawn, planToCommandLine } from 'dsh-line-pool/lib/spawn.js';
const plan = planSpawn('git', ['clone', 'https://github.com/a/b'], line);
console.log(planToCommandLine(plan));
// git -c http.proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7890 clone https://github.com/a/b
console.log(plan.warnings);  // 例如 --trusted-host 的安全提示
```

### 4. 上游 IP 表自验（可选）

插件每 30 分钟自动拉取一次公开的 GitHub 域名→IP 表，逐个 IP 做 **TLS + 证书链校验**，结果落
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\line-pool\upstream-ips.json`，并生成可直接使用的 hosts 片段
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\line-pool\hosts-fragment.txt`。

```js
import { fetchAndVerify, saveUpstreamSnapshot } from 'dsh-line-pool/lib/upstream.js';

const up = await fetchAndVerify({ onLog: console.log });
console.log(up.verified);
// { 'github.com': [{ ip: '20.205.243.166', ms: 8 }], ... }
console.log(up.domainsWithoutUsableIp);   // 上游给了 IP 但实际全部连不上的域名
```

**为什么不自动写 hosts**：需要管理员权限（本机实测 `Access denied`），而且写错会导致整机某些域名全挂。插件只**产出经过验证的片段**，是否应用由用户决定（可粘贴到 hosts，或用 SwitchHosts 等工具）。

**为什么必须自验**：实测证据 —— 上游表给的 IP 里有相当比例从本机根本连不通。
2026-10-16 一次实测：7 个 IP 中 **2 个不可用**（`gist.github.com`、`github.global.ssl.fastly.net` 全部失败）。
**上游 IP 表不是全可用，且可用性会波动**，所以自验必须每次都做，不能缓存一次结果永久使用。

**为什么判据是 TLS 而不是 TCP**：TCP 握手可以被「本地应答」欺骗 —— 本机有 TUN/代理时，
连 RFC 5737 保留地址都能秒回成功（实测 3ms 连上 Azure 是不可能的）。
所以判据是 **TLS 握手 + 证书链过系统 CA + CN/SAN 覆盖目标域名**，三者缺一不可。
伪造一张 `CN=github.com` 的自签名证书会被拒（报 `CHAIN_INVALID`）。

### 5. 侧边栏面板

装好后会出现在两个地方（取决于你是否装了 `dsh-better-sidebar`）：

- **装了 `dsh-better-sidebar`** → 设置 → 侧边卡片 里出现「线路池」卡片（带**启停开关**），同时作为原生 chip 出现在右侧栏
- **没装** → 直接从右侧栏 **+** 菜单打开（自动回退到 DSH 原生右侧栏）

面板内容：

```
┌─ 线路池 ───────────────[重测]─┐
│ 3 分钟前探测                    │
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ 按类别（选线顺序，可折叠）        │
│  ▾ github-raw       3 条        │
│    ● GitHub raw 直连     97ms   │  ← 实心=当前首选
│    ○ ghfast.top 前缀   218ms   │
│    ○ 直连（不使用代理）  —       │
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ 全部线路（15/15 启用）           │
│  ● 阿里云 PyPI  pypi-index  75ms │
│  ◐ hf-mirror    hf          —   1:42  ← 冷却倒计时
│  ○ npmjs 官方源 npm-registry —  TIMEOUT
│              [测] [停]           │  ← 单条手测 / 启停
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ 上游 IP 自验                    │
│  源 github520-json · 可用5/不可用2 │
│  ⚠ 无可用 IP: gist.github.com…   │
│  [复制 hosts 片段]               │
└──────────────────────────────┘
```

**两个功能开关**（在卡片的「功能设置」里）：

| 开关 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **自动探测** | 开 | 关闭后**host 侧每 10 分钟的周期探测停止**，面板也不自动刷新（只能手动「重测」）。选择持久化，重启后延续 |
| **显示上游 IP 自验** | 开 | 关闭后隐藏面板底部的上游区块 |

**注意**：better-sidebar 的卡片开关在**关闭状态下不绘制开关图形**（它用"开关消失 + 卡片失去高亮"表达已关闭）。点击卡片主体仍可重新启用。这是上游设计，对所有卡片一致。

### 6. 线路表自动更新

**为什么需要**：镜像死亡率极高（gh-proxy 类实测 9 个里 7 个死），而且**会复活**——实测发现我 5 小时前手工判定"死了"的线路里，`gh-proxy.com`、`g

plugins.description: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness: memory and system prompt, search routing, interactive visual cards, prompt rewriting.
plugins.readme_text: # DSH 插件集 **中文** | [English](#english) 一套用于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 桌面版的插件。每个独立成仓库、独立安装 —— 只取你需要的即可。 ## 插件一览 | 插件 | 作用 | |---|---| | [dsh-memory-system-prompt](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-memory-system-prompt) | 全局记忆（AI 主动写入与读取）+ 用户级系统提示词。索引每轮注入但不占上下文。 | | [dsh-web-search-router](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-web-search-router) | 按模型通道分流搜索：官方账号走 DeepSeek 官方搜索，其它通道走你的自建服务。失败时给出可读原因，而不是一句 500。 | | [dsh-visual-card](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-visual-card) | AI 交一段 HTML，在对话里渲染成可交互卡片 —— 能点、能键盘操作、能全屏、能导出。 | | [dsh-prompt-enhancer](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-prompt-enhancer) | 发送键旁一个按钮，把草稿改写成更好的提示词。三档力度，跟随当前对话的模型。 | ## 安装 **推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用： ``` dsh-visual-card ``` 安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。 命令行方式（先完全退出应用）： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` 然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。 > 四个包都已发布到 npm，当前版本 `1.0.0`。 ## 共同的取舍 这几个插件针对同一版 Harness 编写，有几处一致的判断： - **Host 与 Client 分开。** 凡是涉及模型可见状态的（工具、路由、提示词装配）都在 `index.js` 里跑在 Host；用户看得见的在 `client.js` 里填槽位。改 Host 要重启，改 Client 通常刷新页面即可。 - **填槽位，不改造。** 都不修改宿主原有界面，只往宿主已经渲染的槽位里注册内容，所以 Harness 升级不会悄悄把它们弄坏。 - **失败要说清楚。** 配置不对时，提示直接指出该去改哪个设置，而不是甩一段堆栈。 - **设置在 `~/.dsh/` 下。** 每个插件各占一个目录，卸载包不会删数据，重装后自动接上。 ## 许可 MIT，各仓库内有独立副本。 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) A set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Desktop. Each lives in its own repository and installs independently — take only the ones you want. ## The plugins | Plugin | What it does | |---|---| | [dsh-memory-system-prompt](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-memory-system-prompt) | Global memory the model writes and reads itself, plus a user-level system prompt. The index is injected every turn without consuming context. | | [dsh-web-search-router](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-web-search-router) | Routes search by model channel: official DeepSeek search on account routes, your own endpoint elsewhere. Readable failure reasons instead of a bare 500. | | [dsh-visual-card](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-visual-card) | The model hands over HTML and it renders as an interactive card in the conversation — clickable, keyboard-operable, fullscreen, exportable. | | [dsh-prompt-enhancer](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-prompt-enhancer) | One button next to the send key rewrites your draft into a better prompt. Three levels, follows the model you are chatting with. | ## Install **The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app: ``` dsh-visual-card ``` The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits. From the command line (quit the app completely first): ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app. > All four packages are published to npm at `1.0.0`. ## Common ground These plugins were built against the same Harness and share a few deliberate decisions: - **Host versus client split.** Anything that touches model-visible state (tools, routing, prompt assembly) runs in `index.js` on the host; anything the user sees runs in `client.js` and fills a slot. Host changes need a restart, client changes usually just a page refresh. - **Slots, not forks.** None of them modify the shipped UI. They register into slots the host already renders, so a Harness update cannot silently break them. - **Readable failures.** When something is misconfigured, the message names the setting to fix, rather than surfacing a stack trace. - **Settings live in `~/.dsh/`.** Each plugin keeps its own directory there, so uninstalling the package leaves the data behind and reinstalling picks it up again. ## License MIT. See each repository for its own copy.

--- # dsh-locale-es-419 Paquete de idioma **Español (Latinoamérica) - `es-419`** para la interfaz web y desktop de [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Este plugin comunitario registra el idioma `es-419` en el selector de idiomas de la configuración (**Settings → General → Language** / **Configuración → General → Idioma**) y suministra 58 diccionarios traducidos con terminología adaptada a América Latina (por ejemplo: *archivo* en lugar de *fichero*, *computadora*, *configuración*, *guardar*, *cancelar*, *detener*). --- ## 📸 Guía visual paso a paso de activación ### Paso 1: Abrir "Add plugin" e ingresar la dirección del repositorio En la app de DeepSeek Harness (Desktop o Web), dirígete a la sección **Plugins** en la barra lateral y haz clic en el botón superior derecho **`+ Add plugin`**. En el cuadro de texto que aparece:

> **¿Qué debes escribir en el campo de texto?** > Copia y pega exactamente esta URL: > ```text > https://github.com/Dreftian/dsh-locale-es-419 > ``` > *(También puedes usar el atajo `github:Dreftian/dsh-locale-es-419` o la ruta de tu carpeta local).* --- ### Paso 2: Presionar "Install" Haz clic en el botón **`Install`** al pie de la ventana modal. DeepSeek Harness descargará y registrará automáticamente el plugin `dsh-locale-es-419`. --- ### Paso 3 & 4: Cambiar el idioma en Configuración Una vez instalado: 1. Abre **Settings** (Configuración) desde la barra lateral o presiona `Ctrl + ,` (`Cmd + ,` en macOS). 2. Selecciona la pestaña **General**. 3. En la fila **Language** (Idioma), haz clic y selecciona **Español (Latinoamérica)**.

🎉 **¡Listo!** Toda la interfaz se adaptará de inmediato a español latinoamericano y la preferencia quedará guardada de forma permanente para tus próximas sesiones. --- ## ⚡ Instalación alternativa por terminal (CLI) Si prefieres instalarlo mediante la línea de comandos de `dsh`: ### Para la interfaz Web: ```bash # Mediante enlace directo al repositorio: git clone https://github.com/Dreftian/dsh-locale-es-419.git cd dsh-locale-es-419 dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd) ``` En **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Dreftian/dsh-locale-es-419.git cd dsh-locale-es-419 dsh plugin --profile web add link:(Get-Location).Path ``` ### Para la aplicación Desktop: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:$(pwd) ``` En **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:(Get-Location).Path ``` --- ## 🌟 Características clave | Característica | Detalle | |---|---| | **Estándar BCP 47 (`es-419`)** | Reconocimiento automático para navegadores y sistemas operativos de Latinoamérica (México, Colombia, Argentina, Perú, Chile, etc.). | | **Terminología neutra** | Vocabulario natural para la región: *archivo*, *computadora*, *configuración*, *guardar*, *cancelar*, *detener*. | | **58 Módulos cubiertos** | Cobertura integral: chat, workspace, terminal, modelos, configuración, atajos de teclado, subagentes y herramientas. | | **Fallback resiliente a inglés (`en`)** | Cualquier función nueva o texto pendiente recurre de forma segura a inglés, evitando errores en la UI. | | **Persistencia duradera** | Tu selección se guarda en `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` bajo la clave `locale.preference`. | --- ## 🤝 Cómo contribuir ¡Las contribuciones de toda la comunidad hispanohablante son bienvenidas! 1. Los diccionarios editables están en [`locale/es-419/*.json`](locale/es-419/). 2. Reconstruye el paquete con: ```bash npm run build ``` 3. Envía un Pull Request con tus mejoras y ajustes de traducción. --- ## 🌐 English **dsh-locale-es-419** is an open-source community language pack plugin providing Latin American Spanish (`es-419`) localization for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). ### Quick Install In DeepSeek Harness: 1. Go to **Plugins** → **+ Add plugin**. 2. Enter: ```text https://github.com/Dreftian/dsh-locale-es-419 ``` 3. Click **Install**. 4. Open **Settings → General → Language** and pick **Español (Latinoamérica)**. --- ## 📄 Licencia [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Dangelo Vilchez ([@Dreftian](https://github.com/Dreftian))

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: global search across session content, ordered by content time.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-search

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that searches the
**content** of every session — not just session titles — and orders hits by the **time of the
matched record**, newest first.

It adds a first-class search destination to the sidebar (a panel icon beside *Plugins* and
*Schedules*, plus a full-width results page) and a `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F` shortcut. Clicking a hit
opens its session.

```
┌─ sidebar ─┐  ┌─ main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Plugins  │  │  Search session content                                    │
│ ▸ Search  │  │  [ 会话                                            ]        │
│  Schedules│  │  All · My prompts · Replies · Tool output   ☐ subagents    │
│           │  │  43 hits · 8 sessions · 4 ms                               │
│           │  │ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│           │  │ 2026-09-11 01:55   user   修改 FreeCAD MCP 服务端口         │
│           │  │   我在使用这个 mcp 服务[插件]，但是端口被占用了…            │
└───────────┘  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Why this plugin exists

Stock DSH can already *search* sessions — the sidebar search box is wired to a real
content-search pipeline:

```
WorkspaceBrowser → sessions.search(query) → ctx.remote.session.search
  → SessionController.search → ctx.sessionQuery.searchSessions(…)
```

It only ever finds titles because **three independent things** are true at once:

| # | Fact | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The content backend is **switched off** in the stock profile — `openAt: never`. The shipped comment says it plainly: *"the Web sidebar search matches titles and workspace names only."* | the `session-query-sqlite` row in `dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml` |
| 2 | That backend tokenizes with FTS5 `unicode61`, which treats **an entire CJK run as a single token**. Measured on a real machine: `光速太慢，星际文明无法成为整体` yields exactly two tokens, `光速太慢` and `星际文明无法成为整体` — so `MATCH '光速'` and `MATCH '星际'` both **return nothing**. The `trigram` tokenizer is no help either: it rejects 2-character queries. | verified locally against SQLite 3.53.4 |
| 3 | Even with the backend enabled, the wire shape is `{ items: [{ sessionId, snippet }] }` — **each hit's `time` is dropped at that layer**, and ranking is relevance-first (`time` is only a tie-breaker). | `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` |

So "order results by content time" is **not achievable through any shipped public remote**, and
for CJK content the shipped engine is the wrong tool regardless. This plugin therefore builds its
own index on the host: it incrementally parses every session transcript, keeps each record's text
together with **that record's own `time`**, matches by substring (correct for both CJK and Latin
text), and sorts by time. It needs **no profile configuration changes**.

---

## Where the search entry lives — and why

DSH's Web/desktop UI has **no global top bar** and **no global command palette** (`/` commands are
the composer's slash menu and are bound to the current session). Only three global seats are
available:

| Seat | Verdict |
|---|---|
| **`sidebar.panellist` icon + its matching `main` panel** | ✅ **Used here.** This is DSH's first-class "global panel" mechanism: the sidebar owns the button, the label and the selected state, and the list `id` maps directly to the `main` panel `key`. The shipped **Plugins** (order 0) and **Schedules** (order 10) panels work exactly this way; this plugin slots in between at order 5. `replaceRisk: none` — it cannot be clobbered by an upgrade. |
| `sidebar.footer.action` (next to Settings) + a `shell.overlay` dialog | ⭕ Viable alternative, better suited to a "spotlight" quick-search. Costs you hand-built overlay, focus and Escape handling, and leaves little room for snippets. |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (where the existing search box lives) | ❌ **Not used.** It is a `single` seat occupied wholesale by `ui-workspace`, with `replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui` — taking it means replacing the entire shipped session browser and breaking on the next DSH release. |

A **`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`** shortcut (registered through `dsh-client-shortcuts`) selects the panel from
anywhere. The combination is not on the reserved list, and `web:linux` is deliberately left
unbound: the Web allowance there admits only a few two-modifier combos, and a shortcut definition
is validated across all six profiles atomically.

---

## Install

This package is a standard DSH **bundle** (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` in its manifest).
Install it with the plugin manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target="<absolute path to this repo>"
```

That writes the package into the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` and links it
into the profile's `node_modules`. You do **not** need to hand-edit the profile's `package.json` or
`cordis.patch.yml`.

Disable or remove it again:

```
plugin_manager action=set_bundle    target=dsh-session-search enabled=false
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-session-search
```

### Mounting it manually instead

Add a row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (the `name` may be a bare package specifier, a
path relative to the patch file, or an absolute path):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-search
      name: 'dsh-session-search'
```

> **A note on reloading.** The Harness loads plugin rows through Node's ESM loader, which caches
> both the resolved package entry and the module itself for the lifetime of the Host process.
> Re-enabling a row that previously failed re-runs the *cached* module, so a fix on disk is not
> observed until the app restarts — `dsh-hmr` can activate a **new** row, but it cannot swap a
> JavaScript module generation for an already-loaded package. `lib/entry.js` exists to work around
> this during development: it re-imports `lib/host.js` behind an mtime-keyed query, so host-side
> edits take effect on the next activation. In normal use it is simply the entry point.

---

## Usage

1. Click the magnifier icon in the sidebar (between *Plugins* and *Schedules*), or press
   `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`.
2. Type a query. Matching is **substring**, case-insensitive, and works for CJK (a 2-character
   query matches inside a longer run, which the shipped FTS5 engine cannot do).
3. Narrow the results with the chips — *All* / *My prompts* / *Replies* / *Tool output* — and the
   *Include subagent sessions* toggle (off by default; subagent sessions routinely outnumber your
   own).
4. Click any hit to open its session.

Queries are debounced by 220 ms and each superseded query is aborted. `Esc` clears the box.

---

## Configuration

The plugin exports **no `Config` schema** on purpose: bare specifiers such as
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` do not resolve from a plugin that lives outside the profile tree, and
Cordis passes a row's `config:` through untouched when a plugin has no `Config`
(`if (!runtime.Config) return config` in `cordis/lib/index.js`). So every key is optional:

```yaml
- id: session-search
  name: 'dsh-session-search'
  config:
    root: 'C:/Users/me/.dsh/sessions'   # sessions root; defaults to <DSH_HOME>/sessions
    maxHits: 300                        # cap on returned hits
    maxCharsPerRecord: 65536            # per-record text ceiling, guards against one huge tool result
    includeSubagents: false             # exclude subagent sessions by default
    warmup: true                        # build the index in the background after startup
    warmupDelayMs: 3000
```

A patch row **replaces** the whole `config` of its target id, so write every value you want.

---

## How it works

```
package.json                bundle manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
cordis.patch.yml            bundle patch: the insert row
icon.svg                    icon for the Plugins page
locale/{en,zh}.json         title/description for the Plugins page
lib/entry.js                loader entry: exports name/inject, loads the implementation
lib/host.js                 host half: index lifecycle, HTTP channel, sessionContentSearch service
lib/core/session-index

plugins.description: In-conversation workflow run timeline for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workflow-ui

[![CI](https://github.com/zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

An in-conversation workflow run timeline for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web GUI. It replaces the stock `workflow` tool card and the `workflow-run` chat node with a horizontal timeline: a rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs, parallel bands — and the full **plan is visible before the run reaches it**.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

![dsh-workflow-ui screenshot](docs/screenshot.png)

## What you get

- **In-conversation card** — one card per workflow run, right in the chat flow. No panel to open, nothing to configure.
- **Plan-ahead rendering** — the card scans the workflow script client-side (`phase()` calls, `parallel()` blocks, revisited phases) and renders every planned station, pill placeholder and dependency arc before the run gets there.
- **Parallel bands** — `parallel()` phases become raised tracks with rounded fork/merge joins.
- **Arcs** — non-adjacent forward edges and loop (return) edges fly above the rail with lane assignment (short spans low, crossing spans pushed up), rounded corners and landing arrows; arcs entering a running station light up as `march`.
- **Pill overflow** — stations with more than 5 agents collapse behind a `+N` expander; the full plan stays one click away.
- **DSH-native iconography** — StateDot status dots (6px core for done/error, neutral spinner arc for running, idle dot for pending), official ListPen header icon, 1px Check/Close marks.
- **Agent pills** — per-agent status with face expressions (glance/blink while running), settled check marks, planned placeholders for agents that have not started.
- **Theme + a11y** — light/dark via DSH alias tokens, `prefers-reduced-motion` honored everywhere, `aria` labels on status glyphs.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui
```

Restart dsh once after installing (composition change), then refresh the page. Requires DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.5`; verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`, web profile.

## How it works

Two keyed slot registrations shadow the official renderers (`priority: -1`; official stays at `0`, lowest priority renders, and any crash in this component abdicates back to the official one):

- `conversation.chat.node` key `workflow-run` — data is the official Definition's projection over durable events (`tool-workflow/run-start|agent-start|agent-end|run-end`); this plugin only changes the presentation.
- `tool.call.toolview` key `workflow` — renders an invisible marker (its row is hidden via CSS `:has`) and stashes the tool input's script metadata into a module store, which run cards consume for plan-ahead rendering.

Styles are injected once as a `<style data-plugin>` element and removed on unload; all classes are `zcf-`-prefixed. Colors land on 14 local `--color-*` tokens mapped to DSH `--dsw-alias-*`.

## Development

No dependencies. Node >= 20.

```bash
npm run check     # syntax checks + unit tests + build + lib checks + facade smoke
npm run preview   # generate docs/preview/preview.html (light/dark cards)
```

Screenshot a preview headlessly:

```bash
chrome --headless=new --virtual-time-budget=3000 --screenshot=shot.png docs/preview/preview.html
```

Layout constants follow ZCode's public workflow presentation (station 168 / pitch 192 / lamp at +17, arc base 26 / lane 14, 6–8px rounded joins, 120/160/200/320ms motion tokens). Status dots and iconography reproduce the shapes of DSH's official `dsh-client-ui-primitives` (StateDot, ListPen, Check, Close); this plugin is not affiliated with ZCode or the DSH team.

## Notes & limitations

- The tool row exists only as an invisible data source; the timeline card is the single entry point in a conversation.
- Arcs render in the wide (single-row, ≥920px container) mode; wrap mode hides them.
- Status words are built-in Chinese; pill → child-session navigation, run metrics and the locale channel are not wired yet.
- Workflow events are consumed read-only; the plugin keeps no parallel orchestration state.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © zuiyouli

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Replace DSH's built-in DeepSeek search with SearXNG / Tavily / Exa / Brave / Serper / Bing / Google CSE. web_search keeps its name and schema.
