plugins.description: DSH 超大会话压缩插件：上下文实时监测（窗口×0.85）触发，分块摘要再合并，小会话仍走自带压缩
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-big-compact

**[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)**

**超大会话压缩插件。** dsh 自带压缩（compaction-basic）会把要压缩的旧历史一次性塞进一个模型请求；会话涨到几 MB 之后，中转会拒绝（404 `model_not_found`），`/compact` 只剩一句 “Compaction could not produce a useful summary”。本插件在 `llm/stream` 瀑布上兜底：**只在压缩请求超过阈值时接管**，把它切成多块分别摘要、再合并成最终检查点；小会话与普通对话一律原样放行。

设计取向参考 [billion-context](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context)：普通请求/小上下文不走它，只有大到本地压缩处理不了时才启用。

## 触发条件（实时监测）

1. 每次 `llm/stream` 都用 `ctx.tokenMeter.measure(session)` **实测该会话当前上下文 tokens**（上下文每轮都在变，按实测算）；
2. **窗口是动态的**：每次压缩请求先 `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)` 读模型声明的 `contextWindow`（例如 profile 里写 850000 → 安全线 850000 × 0.85 = 722500）；解析失败才退回配置/500k 兜底；
3. 实测值（拿不到时退回请求体估算）> **窗口 × 0.85** 就分块；
4. 另外保留 **请求体 > 4 MB** 的字节兜底（中转请求体上限）。

上下文占到 85% 时会打一行预告：`上下文实时监测：… tokens，已达窗口 … 的 95%，下次压缩将分块`。

## 工作方式

```
dsh 压缩引擎
  └─ ctx.llm.stream({ purpose: 'compaction', messages: [系统提示, 历史…, 压缩指令] })
       └─ [本插件] 先实测上下文 / 解析窗口，再决定
            ├─ 未超线 → next()，走 dsh 自带压缩（行为不变）
            └─ 超线   → 分块模式
                 1. 历史消息按时间顺序装箱（默认 1.5 MB/块）
                 2. 每块一个小请求 → 结构化要点（默认 max_tokens 6000，3 路并发）
                 3. 各块摘要合并；合并后仍超线就再做一轮
                 4. 合并摘要 + dsh 原始压缩指令发给模型，得到最终检查点
                 5. 按 raw chunk 协议回放（text 块 + finish stop）给压缩引擎落盘
```

- 子请求的 `purpose` 是 `compaction-chunk` / `compaction-final`，不会再次触发插件（无递归）。
- **空摘要算失败**：某块返回空或少于 10 字时，自动重试并把输出预算翻倍（最多 20000 tokens），仍失败则二分再试（最多 2 层）。
- 整条链路失败时回放 `finish{kind:'error'}`，`/compact` 会照常报错并写会话日志，不会静默。

## 配置

`/root/.big-compact/config.json`（不存在时用默认值）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `thresholdBytes` | 4000000 | 请求体超过该字节数才接管（字节兜底） |
| `maxContextTokens` | 0 | 0 = 按模型动态解析 `contextWindow`；>0 = 强制覆盖 |
| `contextFillRatio` | 0.85 | 实测上下文 > 模型窗口 × 该比例 就接管 |
| `chunkBytes` | 1500000 | 每块字节预算（UTF-8 字节） |
| `chunkMaxTokens` | 6000 | 每块摘要的 max_tokens（重试时翻倍，上限 20000） |
| `finalMaxTokens` | 8000 | 最终合并的 max_tokens |
| `concurrency` | 3 | 分块请求并发数 |
| `retries` | 2 | 单块失败重试次数 |
| `maxMessageChars` | 200000 | 单条消息最多保留字符数（防一个巨大工具结果吃掉整块） |
| `maxDepth` | 2 | 失败二分重试的最大深度 |
| `verbose` | true | 是否打印每块进度 |

## 日志

`/root/dsh-web.log` 里搜 `[big-compact]`：

```
[big-compact] 已启用：窗口 按模型动态解析，安全线 85%，分块 1.43 MB，并发 3
[big-compact] 上下文实时监测：6464308 tokens，已达窗口 850000 的 760%（安全线 85%），下次压缩将分块
[big-compact] 超大压缩请求（上下文 6464308 tokens（实测）> 窗口 850000 × 0.85 = 722500）→ 分块模式
[big-compact] 压缩请求 23.13 MB，切成 9 块
[big-compact] 分块 1/9 完成（1.43 MB → 3621 字）
...
[big-compact] 压缩完成：9 块，用时 96.6s，摘要 3586 字
```

## 测试

```bash
node test/unit.mjs          # 离线：分块、合并、拦截边界、空摘要重试、动态窗口、失败兜底
node test/live.mjs 12 3     # 真机联调：12 MB 合成压缩请求 → 分块 → 合并（直连中转）
```

## 安装 / 卸载

- 已注册进 `profiles/web/package.json`（依赖 + `dsh.profile.bundles`）并建立
  `node_modules/dsh-big-compact` 链接；**重启一次 web 生效**（`patchReload: startup`）。
- 卸载：从 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉 `dsh-big-compact`，
  删 `node_modules/dsh-big-compact` 链接；重启 web。插件文件在 `/root/dsh-big-compact`。

## 已知限制

- 分块摘要是有损的：每块只保留要点，细节以原会话日志为准。
- 依赖中转能接受单块 1.5 MB 的请求；若某个中转更严格，把 `chunkBytes` 调小即可。
- 只处理 `purpose === 'compaction'` 的请求；普通对话不拦截。

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Cut model-facing tokens out of tool output before it enters a request. A global DeepSeek Harness plugin: lossless normalization, annotated repetition collapse, and recoverable structure-aware trimming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-diet

A global DeepSeek Harness plugin that removes tokens from tool output **before**
that output can enter a model request — without removing anything the model may
need, and without changing what the model is able to do.

```
tests/t0.py::case PASSED
tests/t1.py::case PASSED
…
[... 12235 of 12416 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 4 diagnostic lines
 retained, middle elided ...]
______________________ test_charge_card_rejects_expired _______________________
src/payments/charge.py:118: in charge_card
E   CardExpiredError: card expired 2024-01-31
FAILED tests/test_payments.py::test_charge_card_rejects_expired
[…]
…899 tests collected…
(Trimmed 12235 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/session-…/bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path.)
```

## The problem it solves

Every tool result becomes part of the conversation the moment it is logged, and
from then on the model re-reads it on every step of the session. The shipped
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` only trims **once a compaction trigger
qualifies**, and rewriting a result that late invalidates the prompt-cache prefix
that was already established — so trimming late costs extra as well as saving.

`dsh-context-diet` runs at `tools/post-execute`, the last waterfall before the
registry freezes a result into a `tool/result` event. A rewrite there belongs to
the call it came from: there is no cache prefix to invalidate, no second copy to
reconcile, and no durable edit to replay.

## What it removes

### 1. Lossless normalization (on by default)

Reduces output to what a terminal would actually display. A terminal shows no
glyph for an escape sequence, so removing one cannot change meaning.

| Transform | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escape sequences | `\e[31merror\e[0m` | `error` |
| OSC hyperlinks and titles | `\e]8;;http://x\a link` | `link` |
| Carriage-return overlays | `10%\r50%\r100%` | `100%` |
| Backspace erasure | `ab\bc` | `ac` |
| Trailing whitespace | `a   \n` | `a\n` |
| Blank-line padding | `a\n\n\n\n\nb` | `a\n\nb` |

### 2. Annotated compaction (on by default)

A run of at least `repeatThreshold` (8) byte-identical consecutive lines that is
also at least `repeatMinRunChars` (1000) characters long becomes one line naming
the exact repeat count:

```
npm warn deprecated inflight@1.0.6: This module is not supported…  [x400 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

The run is collapsed **only when the annotation is strictly shorter than the run
it replaces**, so this pass can never enlarge a result. The count is preserved, so
the run is exactly reconstructible from the annotation and nothing is dropped
silently — which is why this pass needs no recovery file.

### 3. Recoverable, structure-aware trimming (on by default above 32,000 characters)

A result still larger than `maxInlineChars` is replaced by:

1. its head (`headChars`),
2. an omission marker stating exactly how much was dropped,
3. **the diagnostically significant lines from the omitted middle** — errors,
   failures, exceptions, assertions, stack frames, diff hunks and headers, and
   `file:line:col` references (`significantChars`), and
4. its tail (`tailChars`),

followed by a notice naming a spill file that holds the complete normalized text,
with the backend's own retrieval guidance.

Blind head/tail cutting discards the middle unconditionally. Keeping the
diagnostic lines makes the same budget **strictly more informative**, not less —
measured on a 900-test `pytest -v` run, every one of `CardExpiredError`,
`charge.py:118`, `test_charge_card_rejects_expired`, and `1 failed, 899 passed`
survives with this plugin and is lost by a head/tail cut of the same size.

## Why quality is not affected

- **Nothing is dropped without a record.** Every removal is either a
  control character a terminal never displays, or something that is counted,
  annotated, and written verbatim to a spill file the notice tells the model how
  to read.
- **`read` is exempt by default.** File-content output is line-addressed: blank-line
  or trailing-whitespace rewriting would corrupt content a model may quote back
  at an editor. This matches the shipped `dsh-spill-policy`, which exempts `read`
  for the same reason.
- **The default budget is conservative.** No result under 32,000 characters —
  roughly 8,000 tokens — is touched at all, except by the lossless passes.
- **It cannot alter capability.** It registers no tools, removes none, changes no
  prompts, and changes no model or reasoning settings. Tool schemas, the system
  prompt, and the tool catalog are byte-identical to a run without it, so the
  prompt cache behaves exactly as before.
- **It never makes a model call and never adds a request.**
- **It fails open.** Any unexpected shape, missing service, or thrown error
  returns the incoming result untouched and logs a warning. `verify.mjs` covers
  each of those paths.

## Measured effect

On a synthetic but realistic bash-heavy corpus (900-test `pytest -v`, `npm install`
with 400 repeated deprecation warnings, 2,400-line `cargo build`, a `curl`
progress bar, and a 3,000-entry `find`), with shipped defaults:

| Result | Before | Model sees | Removed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `pytest -v`, buried failure | 48,002 | 12,555 | 74% |
| `npm install`, 400 repeats | 33,711 | 236 | 99% |
| `cargo build`, buried error | 158,997 | 20,218 | 87% |
| `curl` progress bar | 4,572 | 61 | 99% |
| `find` over a large tree | 130,890 | 12,218 | 91% |
| **Total** | **376,172** | **45,288** | **88%** |

The lossless tier alone accounts for 15% of that; the rest is annotated
compaction and recoverable trimming. Character counts are not billed tokens —
the figures are indicative, and `/diet` reports the real numbers for the session
you are in.

### Verified against a running Harness

Both passes were exercised live, through the real `tools/post-execute` waterfall
of a running `dsh web` profile, using the real `dsh-spill-local` backend:

```text
$ for i in $(seq 1 30); do echo "SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING"; done
SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING  [x30 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

```text
$ awk '… 570 lines with an error at line 285 …'
download asset 0000 of 0570 ================================================
…
[... 31890 of 43967 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 1 diagnostic lines retained, middle elided ...]

src/engine/pipeline.rs:204:7 - error TS2345: UNIQUE_BURIED_DIAGNOSTIC_MARKER

[...]
…
download asset 0569 of 0570 ================================================

(Trimmed 31890 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/c1cbcd405966-bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path to search within it.)
```

The 43,967-character result reached the model as 12,077 characters (72% smaller),
the diagnostic line that a head/tail cut would have dropped was retained, and the
recovery file was verified to hold all 571 lines of the original output.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-context-diet
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-context-diet → on**.
   An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.

The bundle inserts one global Host row, so it applies to every session in the
profile — not to a single session. It needs no credentials and no other plugin;
the `tools/post-execute` seam is part of `dsh-tools`, and the spill backend comes
from `dsh-spill-local`, both of which the shipped compositions provide. Without a
spill backend the plugin still normalizes and compacts, and simply declines to
trim, because trimming without a recovery file would lose information.

## Configuration

Every field is optional; omitting it keeps the shipped default. Override any of
them in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is applied after bundle
layers and therefore survives plugin upgrades:

```yaml
- id: context-diet
  name: 'dsh-context-diet'
  config:
    maxInlineChars: 64000     # 0 keeps only the lossless and annotated passes
    exemptTools: ['read', 'read_image']
    repeatTh

plugins.description: 抓虾 Office 插件｜DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 生成、文本提取与 OOXML 检查校验。独立运行，无需 Python 或抓虾后端。
plugins.readme_text:
# 抓虾 Office 插件 · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 文档

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

`dsh-crawshrimp-office` 是一个独立的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Office 文档插件，面向本地、可复核的小型 Word 和 PowerPoint 工作流。它可以生成真实的 `.docx` 和 `.pptx` 文件，将有界 Markdown 转换为 DOCX，读取 Word 与逐页 PowerPoint 文本，检查 OOXML ZIP 结构，并按预期文本或数量校验文档。

它适合生成会议纪要、周报、简短方案、简单演示文稿和本地文档质量检查。文件留在配置的工作区内，不调用抓虾 API、共享 connector、模型服务或外部网络。

## 快速开始

需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，以及已验证的 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4`。当前发布标签是 `v0.2.0`，通过 DSH 官方插件加载器从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile demo add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office#v0.2.0
```

安装后，可以直接让 DSH 完成本地任务，例如：“用 `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` 把这份周报保存为 `reports/weekly.docx`，再用 `crawshrimp_office_validate` 检查它是否包含‘本周总结’。”也可以直接调用工具；示例参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)。

插件默认将 `./crawshrimp-office-output` 作为工作区。启动 profile 前可以指定专用目录：

```bash
export CRAWSHRIMP_OFFICE_WORKSPACE="$HOME/crawshrimp-office-output"
```

`-w` 让 DSH CLI 在 profile workspace 中添加插件。安装器会读取 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，并自动加载 `cordis.patch.yml`；需要手动加载 patch 的宿主可以使用 [`examples/cordis.patch.yml`](./examples/cordis.patch.yml)。如果宿主需要直接嵌入插件，请加载完整模块命名空间，让 Cordis 同时注册 `apply` 和工具 schema：

```js
import * as office from 'dsh-crawshrimp-office'

await ctx.plugin(office, { workspaceDir: './crawshrimp-office-output' })
```

## 能力与工具

插件实际注册以下 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 用途 | 审批 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_create` | 用标题、段落和简单字符串表格生成 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_read` | 从现有 DOCX 提取有上限的纯文本。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_create` | 生成标题页以及标题/项目符号页组成的 PPTX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_inspect` | 查看 DOCX/PPTX 的 OOXML ZIP 结构、条目元数据和数量。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` | 将有上限的 Markdown 标题、段落、列表和简单表格转换为 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_read` | 读取 PPTX 每一页的有上限纯文本，不解码媒体。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_validate` | 校验 DOCX/PPTX 必需部件及可选的预期文本、表格数或幻灯片数。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |

所有文件名都必须是工作区内的相对路径。插件会解析真实路径，拒绝目录穿越和逃逸到工作区外的符号链接，不覆盖已有输出，并先写临时文件，再以不可覆盖的原子方式落盘。

## 使用示例

生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/brief.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "paragraphs": ["A short, reviewable summary."],
  "tables": [{
    "headers": ["Metric", "Value"],
    "rows": [["Orders", "12"]]
  }]
}
```

用 Markdown 生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/weekly.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "markdown": "# Weekly brief\n\n- Orders: 12\n- Returns: 1\n\n| Metric | Value |\n| --- | --- |\n| Conversion | 4.2% |"
}
```

生成 PPTX：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/launch-plan.pptx",
  "title": "Launch plan",
  "slides": [{
    "heading": "Milestones",
    "bullets": ["Design", "Review"]
  }]
}
```

更多参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)、[`examples/slides-read.json`](./examples/slides-read.json) 和 [`examples/validate.json`](./examples/validate.json)。

Markdown 转换支持标题、段落、有序/无序列表、引用、作为纯文本保留的围栏代码和简单管道表格。行内强调和链接会展平为文本。HTML 会被剥离并返回 warning；图片和媒体语法会保留 alt 文本并返回 warning。插件不会抓取或嵌入外部媒体，也不会执行 HTML；不支持的 Markdown 会在安全范围内保留为纯文本。

`crawshrimp_office_slides_read` 返回 `slideCount` 和每页有上限的文本，只读取 OOXML 文本节点。`crawshrimp_office_validate` 在预期文本或数量不满足时返回 `valid: false`；损坏 ZIP、缺失 OOXML 必需部件、无效 XML 及 DTD/entity 声明会真实返回工具错误。

## 权限与上限

写调用使用宿主的 DSH 原生权限信号。会话同时处于 `danger-full-access` 且原生审批策略为 `never` 时，已有的完全权限授予允许写入，无需重复弹出逐次审批；`ask`、受限模式，或审批/沙箱服务缺失、读取异常时，仍走原生审批路径，只有收到 `allowed-once` 才执行。插件没有单独绕过原生审批的配置项。

默认限制单个输入文件 16 MiB、单个生成文件 16 MiB、Markdown 输入 512 KiB、文本提取 128 KiB；段落、表格、幻灯片、项目符号、Markdown block 和 ZIP 条目也有数量上限。可以通过插件配置中的 `workspaceDir`、`maxInputBytes`、`maxOutputBytes`、`maxTextBytes`、`maxMarkdownBytes` 在限定范围内调整。

## 实际边界

实现范围是 OOXML 包的生成、读取和结构校验。插件不转 PDF/PNG，不运行 LibreOffice，也不执行视觉审查。生成成功结果会返回 `visualReview: "not_rendered"`；只有在另行完成渲染并经过人工或模型检查后，才能描述为视觉已验证。`office_run`、Office COM、宏、公式、图表、媒体解码和任意 Python 执行不属于本包。

示例和测试只使用本地临时文件，不调用模型、商家账号或外部网络服务。该包不编辑已有 Office 文档的任意复杂排版，也不渲染图表或重新计算公式。

## 与其他功能包的关系

当前维护三个可独立安装的功能包：[Browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) 负责网页操作、登录态和页面脚本，[Data](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data) 负责记录与表格，Office 负责文档。PDF、标签、模板和渲染归 Office 路线图，0.2.0 尚未实现。

0.2.0 新增 Markdown 转 DOCX、PPTX 逐页文本读取、结构/内容校验，并对齐 DSH 原生完全权限映射。

plugins.description: 把腾讯 ima 知识库接进 DeepSeek Harness：在侧边栏浏览知识库与文件，并让 AI agent 自动检索、读取库内资料。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ima

> 把腾讯 [ima](https://ima.qq.com) 的知识库接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：侧边栏浏览知识库，**agent 能自动检索并读取库内文件**。

[English](#english) · 简体中文

---

## 它解决什么问题

你在 ima 里攒了很多资料（文档、笔记、网页、录音转写…），但对话里的 agent 看不见——每次都要手动复制粘贴。

装上这个插件后：

- **侧边栏多一个「知识库 ima」**：左目录、右文件地浏览，点击直接预览
- **agent 自动知道有这个知识库**：每轮对话开头会把库清单注入上下文，模型知道「这儿有资料可查」
- **按正文内容搜索**：不记得文件叫什么名？问「我的资料里提到过 X 吗」，agent 自己去搜

## 功能一览

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 绑定 | 一键绑定：自动打开浏览器让你登录 ima，其余全自动，不需要复制粘贴 |
| 浏览 | 全部 / 共享 / 个人 三类筛选，多层文件夹 + 面包屑 |
| 预览 | PDF、Word、Excel、PPT、图片、音视频、Markdown、XMind 等在面板内直接看 |
| 文件图标 | macOS 风格 SVG 图标：访达同款蓝色文件夹 + 各类型渐变色块（PDF 红 / Word 蓝 / Excel 绿 / 播客 粉…）；左侧知识库统一用单色 macOS 文件夹 |
| 左侧分组 | 与 ima 一致的「个人知识库 / 共享知识库」折叠分组，可一键去 ima 新建 |
| 更新时间 | 文件行预留了最后更新时间列；ima 官方接口暂未提供该字段，开放后自动显示 |
| 笔记排版 | ima 的笔记接口只返回一段**展平过的纯文本**（段落边界在服务端就丢了）；插件按标点、序号、「发言人 + 时间戳」等锚点尽力还原段落，会议记录能恢复成一句一条的发言列表，并保留「原文」按钮随时对照 |
| 网页类 | 网页、微信文章点击直接在新窗口打开原文 |
| 引用到对话 | 文件一键交给 agent 读取 |
| Agent 工具 | 5 个工具，含**按正文内容搜索** |
| 上下文注入 | 模型每轮自动看到知识库清单，主动去查 |

## 界面预览

> 以下截图为**演示数据**（虚构的库名与文件名），实际界面与之一致。

左侧浏览知识库，右侧文件按类型显示彩色徽章；网页 / 微信文章直接「打开原文」，文档类一键「引用到对话」：

![知识库面板](docs/screenshots/shot-1-panel.png)

一键绑定：自动弹出浏览器登录 ima，其余全自动：

![一键绑定](docs/screenshots/shot-2-bind.png)

笔记类文件自动还原排版：ima 返回的是一段展平的纯文本，插件按「发言人 + 时间戳」「中文序号」等锚点重建段落，右上角可「看原文」对照；右上角「引用到对话」把当前文件直接交给 agent 读取：

![详情页与引用按钮](docs/screenshots/shot-3-detail.png)

没有 Chrome/Edge 时的手动兜底（每一步都告诉你去哪拿、怎么拿）：

![手动填写兜底](docs/screenshots/shot-4-manual.png)

## 环境与版本适配

| 项目 | 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.0-rc.1** | 开发与测试所用的版本；0.2.x 其他小版本理论兼容，未逐一验证 |
| Node.js | ≥ 18（推荐 ≥ 22） | 宿主半要求；绑定自动化用到 Node 内置 WebSocket，22 起零依赖 |
| 浏览器 | Chrome 或 Edge | 仅「一键绑定」需要；都没有会自动降级为手动填写方式 |
| 操作系统 | Windows / macOS / Linux | 宿主半为纯 Node 实现，无原生模块依赖 |
| ima 账号 | 能登录 [ima.qq.com](https://ima.qq.com) 即可 | 订阅类知识库 ima 不开放读取（产品策略，见「已知边界」） |

> DSH 的插件接口在 0.2.x 阶段仍在演进。升级 DSH 后如果插件异常，欢迎[提 issue](https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima/issues)，附上 DSH 版本号即可。

## 安装

### 前置条件

- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness（下文以 `~/.dsh` 为其 home 目录）
- Node.js ≥ 18

### 方式一：一行命令（推荐）

把 `web` 换成你要装的 profile 名即可（桌面端用 `desktop`）。

**从预构建包安装** —— 最快，不需要 git，也不需要本地构建：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima/releases/latest/download/dsh-ima.tgz
```

**从源码安装**：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima.git
```

装完**重启 DSH**（Web 端也可以只重启服务后刷新页面）。

> ⚠️ **不要写成 `github:ikevss/dsh-ima`。** npm 会把 `github:` 这种简写解析成 **SSH** 地址（`ssh://git@github.com/...`），没配过 SSH key 的机器会直接报
> `Permission denied (publickey)` 装不上。要让人人都能装，必须用上面的 `git+https://` 形式或 tarball 链接。

> 💡 预构建 tarball 里已经包含编译好的 `lib/client.js`，所以安装时不会触发构建；从源码装也一样，`lib/` 是随仓库提交的。

### 方式二：手动安装（改 profile 配置）

适合想改代码、或者网络环境装不了包的情况。

**1. clone 到插件目录**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima
```

**2. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`** —— 加依赖和 bundle：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-ima": "file:../../plugins/dsh-ima"   // ← 新增
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ...原有内容...
        "dsh-ima"                               // ← 新增
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**3. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`** —— 文件末尾加一段：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ima
      name: dsh-ima
```

**4. 把插件文件拷进 profile 的 node_modules**（不要用 `pnpm add`，容易搞坏 profile 的依赖解析）：

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ima
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/{package.json,cordis.patch.yml} ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ima/
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/lib/*.js ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ima/lib/
```

**5. 重启 DSH。**

### 桌面端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop）

把上面的 `web` 全部换成 `desktop` 即可：

```bash
# 一行命令方式
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima/releases/latest/download/dsh-ima.tgz
```

手动方式同样三步，只是 profile 目录换成 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`：

```bash
# 1. 改 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json（加 dependencies + bundles，同上）
# 2. 改 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml（加 insert 段，同上）
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-ima
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/{package.json,cordis.patch.yml} ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-ima/
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/lib/*.js ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-ima/lib/
# 3. 重启桌面端
```

> ⚠️ desktop profile 由桌面端独占管理，命令行 `dsh --profile desktop` 会拒绝启动——这是正常的。

## 它访问什么（权限说明）

装之前你大概想知道它碰了什么。全部如实列出：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **访问的域名** | 只有 `https://ima.qq.com`（腾讯 ima 官方 OpenAPI）。预览/下载文件时用的是 ima 接口返回的腾讯云 COS 签名直链 |
| **读取的本地文件** | `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-ima/credentials.json`（插件自己的凭证）；取不到时回退读 `~/.config/ima/{client_id,api_key}`（ima 官方技能的标准位置）。除这两个位置外不读任何本地文件 |
| **写入的本地文件** | 只在 `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-ima/` 下写凭证与绑定用的浏览器 profile；**不碰 `~/.config/ima/`**（那是 ima 自己技能的资产，解绑只用标记文件） |
| **启动的进程** | 仅「一键绑定」时会拉起你本机的 Chrome / Edge，带 `--remote-debugging-port=9333`（只监听 `127.0.0.1`），用完即关 |
| **本机 HTTP 路由** | `/api/ima/*`，由 DSH 的 webServer 提供，与 DSH 面板同源。之所以要这层中转，是因为 ima 的接口不返回 CORS 头，浏览器不能直连 |
| **安装期脚本** | **没有**。`package.json` 里没有 `postinstall`/`prepare`，装的时候不会执行任何脚本 |
| **遥测 / 上报** | **没有**。不收集、不上传任何数据到第三方；除了上面那个域名不连任何服务器 |

> 想自己核对：`grep -rn "https://" lib/index.js lib/ima-client.js`，宿主半只有 `ima.qq.com` 一个外部地址。

## 绑定 ima 账号

1. 打开侧边栏「知识库 ima」→ 点「一键绑定 ima 账号」
2. 会自动弹出一个浏览器窗口，已打开 ima 授权页
3. **登录**（唯一需要你做的事）
4. 自动完成绑定，面板刷出知识库

> **备用方式**（没有 Chrome/Edge 时）：点「都试过了还是不行？」，打开 ima 授权页 → 点第 1 步的**「一键复制」**→ 回到插件，会自动识别。
> 注意：API Key **不在页面上显示**，藏在「一键复制」复制出来的那段文字里。

## Agent 工具

插件注册 5 个工具，模型按需调用：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `ima_search_files` | **按正文内容搜索文件**（最常用）——不知道文件叫什么、想找"哪些资料提到过 X"时用 |
| `ima_list_knowledge_bases` | 列出全部知识库 |
| `ima_search_knowledge_bases` | 按关键词搜知识库（匹配库名/描述） |
| `ima_list_kb_files` | 列出某个库里的文件和文件夹 |
| `ima_read_file` | 读取文件正文（文本直接返回，二进制返回下载直链） |

### 上下文注入

插件在每轮对话的第一步，会把知识库清单注入模型上下文（10 分钟内不重复注入）：

```
[ima 知识库] 用户已连接 ima 知识库，下面这些库可以直接搜：
· 我的笔记（个人）
· 项目文档（共享）
...
· 找"哪份资料提到过 X" → ima_search_files
· 想浏览某个库里有啥 → ima_list_kb_files
· 读全文 → ima_read_file
```

所以模型会**主动去查**，而不是说"我看不到你的资料"。

## 架构

```
dsh-ima/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        宿主半：agent 工具 + 上下文注入 + /api/ima/* 路由
│   ├── ima-client.js   ima OpenAPI 客户端
│   ├── ima-browser.js  浏览器自动化取凭证（CDP，零依赖）
│   └── client.js       浏览器半产物（由 build/ 生成，已随仓库提供）
├── build/
│   ├── client.src.js   界面逻辑源码
│   ├── viewer.src.js   预览引擎配置
│   └── build.mjs       构建脚本（esbuild）
└── cordis.patch.yml    bundle patch
```

**两半设计**：宿主半跑在 Node 里（工具、HTTP 路由），浏览器半跑在 DSH 页面里（侧边栏面板、预览）。两者通过同源的 `/api/ima/*` 通信。

> 为什么要有 HTTP 路由？因为 ima 的接口**不返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`**，浏览器直连会被 CORS 拦死。只能由宿主半代理。

## 开发

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima
npm install          # 构建依赖（约 400MB，仅开发时需要）
npm run build        # 重新生成 lib/client.js
npm test             # ima-client 冒烟测试
```

改 `build/client.src.js` → `npm run build` → 把 `lib/client.js` 拷进各 profile 的 node_modules → 刷新页面。
改 `lib/index.js` 等宿主半 → 拷进 profile → **重启 DSH**。

> `lib/client.js` 是构建产物，已随仓库提供，**普通用户不需要构建**，clone 下来即可使用。

## 预览能力

内置 [open-file-viewer](https://github.com/xushanpei/open-file-viewer)（MIT）做纯前端渲染：

| 类型 | 预览方式 |
|---|---|
| PDF | 浏览器原生 |
| Word / Excel / PPT | docx-preview / xlsx 纯前端渲染 |
| 图片 | 直接渲染 |
| 音视频 | 内置播放器 |
| Markdown / 文本 / 思维导图 | 内置渲染 |

> 小技巧：ima 的文件标题常常**没有扩展名**（例如播客标题就是一段描述）。插件会从文件真实地址里取扩展名补上再交给预览引擎，否则会误报"不支持预览"。

## 已知边界

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 订阅知识库 | ima 产品策略不开放读取（错误码 220030），默认不显示 |
| 文件更新时间 | ima OpenAPI 目前不返回任何时间字段（实测 2026-10-16，已探测多个候选接口），插件已预留显示通道，ima 开放后无需更新插件 |
| 笔记段落结构 | ima 笔记接口 `note/v1/get_doc_content` 只返回一个已展平的纯文本字段：`data` 顶层只有 `content` 一个键，`format` / `with_blocks` / `rich` 等参数全部被忽略（返回字节一致），另探 8 个结构化候选接口全部 404。**原始段落结构在 ima 服务端就丢失了，插件无法无损还原**，只能按可见锚点尽力重排（右上角「看原文」可对照）；表格类内容展平后无法重建 |
| 知识库列表 | 单页上限 20 个 |
| 浏览器要求 | 一键绑定需要本机有 Chrome 或 Edge；没有会自动降级到手动方式 |
| API Key | 有效期一年，到期需重新绑定 |
| 桌面端 | 插件支持，但 desktop profile 由桌面端独占管理 |

## 更新日志

| 版本 | 要点 |
|---|---|
| 1.7.2 | 笔记预览排版还原：ima 展平的纯文本按锚点重建段落（发言人 + 时间戳 / 中文序号 / 序号列表 / 裸链接），新增「看原文」对照开关与链接识别 |
| 1.7.1 | 左侧知识库图标统一为单色 macOS 文件夹（之前按库配色太花） |
| 1.7.0 | macOS 风格类型图标（访达文件夹 + 渐变色块）、左侧改为 ima 同款折叠分组、更新时间通道 |
| 1.6.0 | 按正文内容搜索（`ima_search_files`）、agent 上下文注入、开源发布 |
| 1.5.0 | 一键绑定产品化：CDP 浏览器自动化 + 四级兜底 + 手动路径自解释 |
| 1.3.0 | 内置 open-file-viewer 纯前端预览（替代在线预览，国内可用） |
| 1.0.0 | 首个可用版本：侧边栏浏览 + 基础 agent 工具 |

## 致谢

- [open-file

plugins.description: 检查软件物料清单：有没有、全不全、格式对不对、新不新
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-sbom

**你的产物里到底有谁，清单说了算。**

**关键词**：软件物料清单 · SBOM · 供应链安全 · CycloneDX · SPDX · 依赖透明 · 行政令 14028 · NTIA 最低要素

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：检查一个项目的 SBOM —— **有没有、全不全、新不新、格式对不对**。
有 lockfile 却一份清单都没有、清单是个空壳、文件名叫 `bom.json` 却不是标准格式、
清单一整年没更新、组件没有 `purl` 唯一标识 —— 这些它都会指出来。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不是 SBOM 生成器** —— 它**不生成**清单，只检查已有的清单（生成是 cyclonedx-npm / syft / spdx-sbom-generator 的活）
- ❌ **不是漏洞扫描器** —— 不查 CVE，那是 `dsh-dep-audit` 的活
- ❌ **不做许可证合规判定** —— 只关心「清单里有没有写清谁是谁」
- ❌ **不下「合规 / 不合规」的结论** —— 只描述事实，判断留给你

**一句话分界**：**别的工具负责写清单，它负责查清单。**

```
dsh-dep-audit  = 查【依赖树】里的漏洞与许可证
dsh-sbom       = 查【物料清单】本身有没有、全不全、新不新
```

---

## 它查什么（5 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `SBOM-NO-LIST` | 有 lockfile，却找不到任何 SBOM 文件（absence）| 🔴 |
| `SBOM-EMPTY-SHELL` | SBOM 在，但里面没有任何组件条目 —— 空壳 | 🔴 |
| `SBOM-NOT-STANDARD` | 没有 `bomFormat` / `spdxVersion`，下游工具没法消费 | 🔴 |
| `SBOM-STALE` | SBOM 超过 180 天没更新 | 🟡 |
| `SBOM-NO-IDENTIFIER` | 组件只有名字和版本，没有 `purl` / `CPE` | 🔵 |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、什么证据、依据是什么、怎么办。**

### 认哪些文件名

`sbom.json` · `bom.json` · `*.cdx.json` · `*.spdx.json` · `*.sbom.json` · `cyclonedx.json` ·
`bom.xml` · `sbom.xml` · `*.cdx.xml` · `*.spdx`（可放在任意子目录）

### 认哪些格式

**CycloneDX**（JSON / XML）· **SPDX**（JSON / tag-value）

### 出处

- 美国行政令 14028《改善国家网络安全》第 4(e) 条
- NTIA《SBOM Minimum Elements》（Components / Component Identifier / Timestamp 等最低要素）
- CycloneDX 规范 / SPDX 规范的官方文档

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-sbom
```

## 用法

```bash
# 检查当前项目
dsh-sbom

# 检查指定目录
dsh-sbom --root /path/to/project

# 看内置演示（一个「有 lockfile、清单却各种残缺」的样本项目）
dsh-sbom --demo

# 列出判据与出处
dsh-sbom --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告（可截图存档）
dsh-sbom --root /path/to/project --html sbom.html

# 给 CI 用：有 high 命中时退出码 1
dsh-sbom --root . --quiet
```

---

## 一个真实的例子

`--demo` 那个样本项目，看起来挺正常：有 `package.json`、有 `package-lock.json`、有 CI，
`npm run sbom` 脚本也在。仓库里甚至有四份「清单」：

```
sbom.json              导出脚本生成的，但 components 是空的
bom.json               其实是 npm ls --json 导出后改的名
security/bom.xml       内部库存系统导出的 XML，不是 CycloneDX
docs/deps.cdx.json     一年多前导出的老清单，组件没有 purl
```

工具会把它们一条条拎出来：

```
🔴 SBOM 文件里没有组件条目 —— 清单是个空壳        sbom.json / bom.json / security/bom.xml
🔴 SBOM 文件不是标准格式 —— 没有格式标识          bom.json / security/bom.xml
🟡 SBOM 文件超过 180 天没更新                     docs/deps.cdx.json（949 天）
🔵 SBOM 里的组件没有唯一标识（purl / CPE）        docs/deps.cdx.json / sbom.json / …
```

而「有 lockfile 却一份清单都没有」这种项目（`tests/fixtures/absent/minimal`）会报：

```
🔴 有依赖清单却没有物料清单 —— 项目里找不到任何 SBOM 文件
```

**「有清单」和「有一份能用的清单」是两件事**，这个工具查的就是后者。

---

## 边界

- **不生成清单** —— 只检查；生成请用 cyclonedx-npm / syft / spdx-sbom-generator
- **只看清单文件本身** —— 不读产物二进制、不递归进依赖树、不查 CVE
- **不判定合规** —— 报出来是提示确认。清单在发布流水线里临时生成、不进仓库，
  在很多团队是正常做法；工具会照报，需要你自己说明
- **有扫描盲区** —— `dist/` `build/` `node_modules/` 等目录默认跳过，清单若只存在于
  这些目录，会被报成「找不到」；如果清单放在别处且命名不同，也可能漏认
- **时效判断用文件修改时间** —— 如果文件被重新 checkout 过，`SBOM-STALE` 可能不报或误报

---

## 开发

```bash
bash tests/run.sh        # 双向验证：正例全报 + 反例 0 命中
```

> `SBOM-STALE` 看的是**文件修改时间**，而 git 不保存 mtime。如果 `docs/deps.cdx.json`
> 的修改时间被重置（重新 checkout、拷贝目录），这条判据在正例上就报不出来 ——
> `tests/run.sh` 会自动回拨，手动修复用：
> `touch -t 202403110820 tests/fixtures/fail/demo-project/docs/deps.cdx.json`

样本目录（同时是 `--demo` 的数据源，没有第二套）：

```
tests/fixtures/fail/demo-project/     正例：清单空壳 / 非标准格式 / 过期 / 无标识
tests/fixtures/absent/minimal/        正例·absence：有 lockfile、没有任何 SBOM
tests/fixtures/pass/clean-project/    反例：CycloneDX JSON+XML、SPDX JSON 三种格式都合规
```

---


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [**物料清单**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。

plugins.description: A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.
plugins.readme_text:
# Agent Office

**Tiny coworkers. Real work.** Watch your DeepSeek Harness agents work in a living pixel office.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · MIT · Zero runtime dependencies · No extra API key

![Animated Agent Office preview — simulated events](docs/demo.gif)

Your agents leave their desks to use tools, queue up when they need approval, and take a breather when a turn finishes. Click a coworker to inspect their activity. Everything in live mode comes from Harness session events.

## Try the office in 10 seconds

Clone this repository and run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office.git
cd dsh-agent-office
node src/demo.mjs
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319**. No install, build step, model, or API key required. Demo mode uses **simulated events** and is visibly labeled. This command previews the UI; it does not connect to a running Harness.

## Connect your actual agents

Requires Node **22.19+** and DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-alpha.4**. This first release deliberately declares only the DSH version whose API was checked. New DSH releases need compatibility verification before widening `engines.dsh`.

From a directory containing the downloaded `dsh-agent-office` folder:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile office add ./dsh-agent-office
dsh --profile office web
```

If the CLI is not globally installed, replace `dsh` with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.4`. Configure your model in the Harness profile as usual. Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319** alongside the Harness UI and start a task. The office logs its URL to the terminal when loaded.

To install into an existing profile, substitute its name for `office`. A server restart is needed after installation. Stop the standalone demo before enabling the plugin: both default to port 4319. The first release is a separate browser dashboard, not an embedded Harness sidebar or an operating-system desktop overlay.

### Source checkout / overlay

Generate an overlay with the absolute module path:

```sh
node scripts/make-patch.mjs > office.local.patch.yml
dsh --profile office web --patch ./office.local.patch.yml
```

The generated YAML uses an absolute path because DSH resolves plugin module paths from the profile. The overlay command works without installing the bundle.

## What's inside

- Original procedural pixel art: focus desks, tool lab, approval corner, sofas, plants, and animated coworkers. No downloaded assets or font services.
- Real event projection for main sessions and subagent sessions. Parent links represent **session lineage**, not inferred conversations.
- Independent pending-tool and approval tracking; parallel requests do not prematurely clear a waiting status.
- Distinct completion, error, blocked, paused, and idle states. “Done” means a turn completed, not that the project passed acceptance tests.
- Clickable roster, activity feed, per-session steps/tool calls/reported tokens, and PNG scene export.
- English / 简体中文, midnight / daylight themes, focus view, mobile layout, and reduced-motion support.
- Reconnecting event stream with an explicit stale-state indicator.
- No model calls, extra API keys, runtime dependencies, telemetry, or changes to the agent loop.

![Desktop preview — simulated events](docs/screenshot.png)

## Configuration

Edit the installed bundle row through your profile overlay:

```yaml
- id: agent-office
  config:
    port: 4320
    maxAgents: 48
    maxEvents: 120
```

| Setting     | Default | Range      | Purpose                                               |
| ----------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `port`      | 4319    | 1024–65535 | Loopback-only office server                           |
| `maxAgents` | 48      | 1–200      | Tracked sessions; inactive sessions are evicted first |
| `maxEvents` | 120     | 10–500     | In-memory activity history                            |

Up to **12 coworkers are drawn at once**; all tracked sessions remain selectable in the roster. Selecting another session brings it onto the floor. If the tracking cap is full of active sessions, new sessions are ignored until a slot becomes available. Counters cover retained sessions since plugin startup, not lifetime totals. UI feed shows the latest six events.

The port is fixed rather than silently changed. If occupied, the plugin logs an actionable error and leaves Harness running. Change it in your configuration and restart.

## Data and permissions

The office observes `session/event` and `session/disposed` at the profile root. It does not register tools, intercept execution, approve operations, or send data to a third party. Approval happens in the original Harness conversation.

Only session IDs, parent IDs, generated names, the last folder name of the working directory, tool names, lifecycle statuses, timestamps, and reported token counts enter the office projection. Prompts, assistant text, reasoning, tool arguments/results, full paths, and approval explanations are excluded. Displayed text is inserted as text, not HTML.

The HTTP server binds exclusively to `127.0.0.1`, checks Host and Origin, has no write endpoints, and closes on plugin unload. Any process or user with access to this machine's loopback can read the displayed metadata. This version is intended for a trusted local machine, not remote hosting. Do not expose its port publicly.

State is in memory. Existing idle conversations and pre-load history are not imported; a session appears on its next observed event. A restart clears the office. A detached session remains as a paused/terminal entry until eviction. Tasks run in a different Harness process are not visible.

## Development and verification

```sh
node --test
node --check public/app.js
```

Eight dependency-free tests cover concurrent tools/approvals, terminal reasons, bounded history, sensitive-data exclusion, token accounting, HTTP/SSE, host/origin protection, port conflicts, and cleanup. Published Cordis **4.0.5-alpha.2** and DSH SessionStore **0.2.1-alpha.4** were separately used to check real session append → plugin → HTTP state and unload cleanup. A full model-backed DSH end-to-end run has not yet been performed.

Browser checks cover desktop/mobile layouts, SSE updates, selection, both languages, themes, focus, and PNG export. See [verification notes](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Share the little office

The preview GIF and screenshots in `docs/` are ready for a GitHub README or release post. They are labeled demonstrations. Source: [xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office](https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office). This plugin has not been published to npm.

Suggested repository description: **A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.**

Suggested GitHub topics: `dsh-plugin`, `deepseek-harness`, `ai-agents`, `pixel-art`, `agent-observability`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Independent community plugin; not an official DeepSeek product.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-feng-gu-lite

极简、离线的 DeepSeek Harness 会话输入框下方指示器。正常仅显示 **梁文峰**（警示图标、暖色）或 **梁文谷**（弱化色），日历歧义/缺口在可能峰窗口显示 **时段待确认**（不提醒）；高峰进入和高峰中打开/切换会话时，在窗口顶部显示同名、非阻塞短暂提醒。无声音，无点击，无输入/发送拦截；定时刷新不重复提醒。呼吸仅约 2.7 秒，`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 完全关闭动画，静态提醒仍短暂显示。

## 状态与日历

规则来源：[DeepSeek 官方定价页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)。北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00为高峰，其余含周末全天空闲。显示计算使用 `[09:00,12:00)` 与 `[14:00,18:00)` 半开区间；这是本插件边界约定，**不是实际账单保证**。调休上班周末仍依据官方“周一至周五”判为空闲。

`src/calendar.js` 提供离线注入数据：`years` 明确声明完整覆盖年份，`holidays` 日期字符串集合，`uncertain` 为已知歧义日期，`source` 记录证据。`createCalendar(data)` 将输入复制成独立集合；`periodAt(timestamp, calendar)` 接受此接口。不得把未覆盖年份当成无节假日。未覆盖年份/歧义日如果处于工作日可能峰窗口，返回 `unknown`，**仅显示“时段待确认”，不显示误导性的峰或谷，也不提醒**；周末和非峰窗口仍可确定为空闲。没有联网回退，也不在用户 UI 显示日历/规则/来源。

当前离线数据仅覆盖 **2026**。法定本日13天依据[国务院令第795号《全国年节及纪念日放假办法》](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202411/content_6986380.htm)，完整放假安排依据[国务院办公厅2026年通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm)。春节本日为除夕与正月初一至初三（2026-02-16至19），端午五月初五为06-19，中秋八月十五为09-25；已用 Node Intl 中国农历独立检查映射。放假区间中非法定本日的平日（01-02、02-20、02-23、04-06、05-04、05-05、10-05至07）按用户确认视为歧义：高峰窗口显示“时段待确认”，并非自行认定谷。法定本日为谷，周末不论调休均谷。DeepSeek定价页未定义调休放假与法定本日的细分，故保留不确定性而非承诺账单。未来年份必须人工核实后添加。

## 构建与自检

无需安装依赖。Node.js 18+（本机执行 Node.js v24.19.0）：

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
node --check lib/client.js
node --test
```

`src/` 为源码，`scripts/build.mjs` 将纯逻辑与客户端合成无外部本地 import 的 `lib/client.js`；React 由宿主模块系统提供。`lib/index.js` 为无操作服务端入口，`cordis.patch.yml` 为最小 bundle 补丁。`node --test` 覆盖北京时间/UTC跨日跨年、周末、节假日、四个半开边界、未知覆盖、日历注入、提醒去重与会话切换、定时器/监听清理，以及客户端 factory/slot 注册/基本渲染的 VM smoke test。

VM smoke test **不是浏览器或桌面视觉验证**：没有验证真实 React reconciler、DOM布局、桌面路由切换、系统 reduced-motion、动画观感或窗口前后台节流后的端到端效果。需要后续获准安装后在真实 desktop 实测，尤其窄窗口布局和 `useSession` hook 稳定性。

## 安装边界

目标运行时：desktopVersion `0.2.0-rc.2`。已只读检查本机 app.asar 中 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js`：`conversation.composer.dock` 是 `kind=list, scope=session`；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/lib/client.js` 的标准组件 props 中 `useSession` 按 source 缓存，用其稳定引用识别会话，不读取会话正文。客户端用 `ctx.slots.inject` + `ctx.slots.register` 注册，slot disposer 交宿主管理；组件卸载清理间隔、可见性监听和提醒 timeout。

### Windows 手动安装本地包

先保存工作并**完全退出 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（包括托盘进程）**。将 `dsh-feng-gu-lite-0.1.0.tgz` 下载或复制到当前目录，再在 PowerShell 中执行：

```powershell
$desktop = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\DeepSeek Harness'
$cli = Join-Path $desktop 'resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
$package = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.\dsh-feng-gu-lite-0.1.0.tgz').Path
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cli)) {
  throw '未找到桌面自带 CLI；请将 $desktop 改为实际桌面安装目录。'
}
& $cli plugin --profile desktop add $package
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw '插件安装失败，请检查 CLI 输出。' }
```

以上使用桌面自带运行时；默认 Windows 安装位置已在本机核对，非默认安装需要调整 `$desktop`。不要对 desktop profile 使用 npm 版 CLI，不要手改运行中的 profile。安装命令会修改 desktop profile，须由用户主动执行；本次发布准备不会执行它。安装后重新打开桌面，在会话输入框下方检查指示器，并切换会话、调整窗口宽度、开启系统减少动态效果设置进行人工检查。

已有用户反馈安装操作完成，但本次自动验收没有复查 desktop profile，也没有完成真实桌面的视觉/交互验收。安装反馈不等同于装载兼容或视觉通过；上面的 VM smoke test 局限仍然适用。

## 公开发布（v0.1.0）

许可证为 [MIT](./LICENSE)，版权标注为 `dsh-feng-gu-lite contributors`。源码仓库：[linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite](https://github.com/linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite)；[v0.1.0 Release](https://github.com/linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 提供源码及 [tgz 安装包](https://github.com/linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-feng-gu-lite-0.1.0.tgz)，SHA-256 见 Release 说明。问题反馈：[Issues](https://github.com/linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite/issues)。**未执行 npm 发布，未提交插件市场申请，也不表示市场已收录。**

在项目根目录重新验证并打包（无依赖，无需 `npm install`）：

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
node --check lib/client.js
node --test
npm pack --ignore-scripts --cache .\.npm-cache
# 检查发布附件内容及 SHA-256，保存哈希用于下载校验
tar -tzf .\dsh-feng-gu-lite-0.1.0.tgz
Get-FileHash .\dsh-feng-gu-lite-0.1.0.tgz -Algorithm SHA256
```

`package.json` 的 `files` 白名单只包含 `lib/`、`src/`、`scripts/`、`test/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md`、`LICENSE`；npm 另自动包含 `package.json`。缓存与本地 tgz 不进入安装包。`.gitignore` 排除本地 npm 缓存、账户配置、环境文件、依赖和临时输出；它不会删除已有文件，也不能替代公开前的暂存区检查。

发布源码时应检查暂存清单，避免提交 `.npm-cache/`、`.npmrc`、`.env*`、日志、账户资料或其他本地文件。本项目的 GitHub Release 不等同于 npm 或插件市场发布；若以后申报插件市场，需等待仓库创建满 24 小时，再单独按市场流程提交并核实收录结果。

## 复用检索与最小权限

已加载 `dsh-reuse-first`，用附带 `search-catalog.mjs pricing --limit 4` 查询 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录，并只读取得 GitHub `ZhangBo-cmd/dsh-pricing-badge` 的 `package.json`、`lib/client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` 参考接口。目录候选 `dsh-pricing-badge` 0.1.3 标注 `network, credentials, env`，还显示价格、规则、余额，不符合需求；`dsh-peak-pricing-warning` 也有 network/倒计时/费用。采用独立实现，仅参考模块工厂与 slot 接口，没有复制整份插件。

运行时代码不请求网络、不读取密钥/环境变量/账户、不声明 network 或 credentials 权限、不持久化任何数据，不调用模型。无 npm dependencies；没有构建期网络请求。检索阶段的网络访问不属于插件运行时能力。

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: DSH Desktop 右上角电源菜单：关闭 / 重启整个应用。Windows only, MIT.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-power-menu 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个右上角电源按钮：点开只有 **关闭DSH** 和 **重启DSH** 两项，省得每次改完插件/配置还要去系统托盘里翻「退出」。 > Windows 专用 · 只支持 DSH Desktop · 纯本地 · 无外部依赖 · MIT > > ⭐ 如果这个小工具帮你省了点时间，欢迎点个 **Star** 支持一下，感谢～ ![dsh-power-menu 菜单截图](docs/screenshot.png) ## 为什么做这个 DSH Desktop 关窗口只是收进托盘，真正退出或重启要走托盘菜单；而改插件、改配置之后又经常需要重启一次。这个插件把这两步搬到会话标题栏右上角：一个电源键，两项操作，点完就走。 ## 功能 - **右上角电源按钮**：位于会话标题栏图标行最右侧，顺序为「布局 / 侧栏 / 电源」。 - **空会话也显示**：欢迎页和对话内使用同一个挂载位置，透明无底色，不会破坏主题，也不会出现两个按钮。 - **Windows 电源菜单风格**：白色圆角卡片、悬浮阴影、左侧线性图标 + 右侧文本，只有两项，不塞多余入口。 - **关闭DSH**：结束整个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用（Electron 主进程 + Host），不重新启动。 - **重启DSH**：结束整个应用，等旧端口释放后用原可执行文件重新拉起，窗口自动回来。 - **键盘可用**：`↑` / `↓` / `Home` / `End` 在两项间移动，`Enter` / 空格执行，`Esc` 关闭，点菜单外部也能关。 - **执行反馈**：点击后整页盖一层半透明遮罩，显示「正在关闭DSH…」/「正在重启DSH…」。 - **纯本地**：没有外部依赖、没有遥测；接口只监听本机回环地址，并做同源校验。 ## 安装 ### 方式 A：通过 DSH 插件管理器（推荐） 1. 打开 DSH Desktop 的 **插件 / 插件市场**。 2. 选择 **添加插件**，输入： ```text github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` 3. 安装完成后重启一次 DSH。 4. 在 **插件市场 → 已安装** 里确认 `dsh-power-menu` 处于「启用中」。 ### 方式 B：命令行安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` > `dsh` 是 DSH 自带的 CLI；如果 PATH 里没有，请用 DSH 安装目录里的 `dsh` / `dsh.cmd`。 ### 方式 C：本地开发安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/xichen-62/dsh-power-menu.git ``` 把插件链接进 desktop profile： ```powershell # Windows PowerShell $profileDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop" New-Item -ItemType Junction ` -Path "$profileDir\node_modules\dsh-power-menu" ` -Target "<你 clone 下来的目录>" ``` 然后在 `$profileDir\package.json` 里： - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-power-menu": "link:<你 clone 下来的目录>"` - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-power-menu"` 重启 DSH 生效。这个插件没有构建步骤，改完 `lib/` 里的文件重启即可。 ## 使用 1. 在会话标题栏右上角点电源图标。 2. 选择 **关闭DSH** 或 **重启DSH**。 3. 等待遮罩出现：关闭会退出应用；重启会在几秒后把窗口拉回来。 | 动作 | 结果 | 需要手动重开？ | | --- | --- | --- | | 关闭DSH | 结束整个桌面应用，不重新启动 | 是 | | 重启DSH | 结束应用 → 等端口释放 → 重新拉起 | 否，窗口自动回来 | > **注意**：点击即执行，没有二次确认。两个动作都会中断正在生成的回答、运行中的工具和后台任务。请在点之前保存手头的事情。 ## 工作原理 桌面版的进程树大致是： ```text Electron 主进程 └── Host 子进程（dsh-desktop-host，ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1） └── 本插件 ``` 插件跑在 Host 里，不能直接调用 Electron 的 `app.quit()` / `app.relaunch()`。所以 Host 只负责“交接”，真正的进程切换交给一个分离的 helper： ```mermaid flowchart LR UI[电源菜单] -->|POST| Host[Host 插件] Host -->|写 handoff + spawn| Helper[detached helper] Helper -->|taskkill /PID main /F
不带 /T| Main[Electron 主进程] Main -.->|IPC 断开| Host Host -->|application.shutdown| Disk[(会话日志落盘)] Helper -->|等端口释放 + 重新拉起| NewMain[新的 Electron 主进程] ``` 具体步骤： 1. Host 把交接信息写到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\`，用 `process.execPath` + `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 启动 `lib/helper.cjs`。 2. helper 等 1.2 秒，让 HTTP 应答先到浏览器。 3. helper 执行 `taskkill /PID <主进程> /F`，**刻意不带 `/T`**：只结束 Electron 主进程，让 Host 子进程有机会收到 IPC 断开。 4. Host 检测到断开后走自己的 `application.shutdown`，尽量把会话日志正常落盘。 5. 重启模式下，helper 等旧监听端口释放，清掉 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` / `DSH_DESKTOP_NODE_EXECUTABLE`，用原可执行文件重新拉起，并确认新进程存活；失败会重试，仍失败就弹窗提示手动打开。 6. 关闭模式下不拉起，等 Host 自己退出。 ### 接口 Host 半注册三个仅限本机回环的接口： ```text POST /api/dsh-power-menu/shutdown POST /api/dsh-power-menu/restart GET /api/dsh-power-menu/health ``` ## 安全 - 三个接口只接受回环地址（`127.0.0.1` / `::1`），校验 `Host` 必须是本机，拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`，带 `Origin` 时必须与本机同源。 - 没有鉴权令牌的第三方网页无法跨站触发关机/重启。 - 只支持桌面版；`dsh web` 下接口返回 409，不会去杀别的进程。 - 不收集任何数据，不联网，不写注册表；日志只写在本地 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\`。 ## 兼容性 - **系统**：Windows 10 / 11。插件依赖 `taskkill` 和 Electron 桌面进程树，其他系统未实现。 - **DSH**：在 **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2** 上实测通过（2026-10-18）。其他 0.2.x 版本可能可用，但未逐一验证。 - **Node**：跟随 DSH 自带的 Node（22+），无需单独安装。 ## 开发 ```text dsh-power-menu/ ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js Host 半：三个回环接口 + 交接调度 │ ├── client.js 浏览器半：window.__ModuleLoader__ bundle │ └── helper.cjs 分离的交接 helper ├── cordis.patch.yml bundle 插入层 ├── package.json ├── docs/screenshot.png └── README.md ``` - 客户端 bundle 不是普通 ESM，必须用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 格式；`dsh.client.inject` 声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`。 - 没有构建步骤，也没有运行时 npm 依赖。 - 提交前跑一次静态检查： ```bash npm run check ``` - 本地调试日志：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\power-menu.log` 和 `helper-*.log`。 ## 常见问题 **按钮没出现？** 确认插件处于「启用中」，并重启过一次 DSH；按钮只出现在有会话标题栏的页面。 **插件卡片上没显示介绍？** 本地开发（link 安装）的插件，卡片不读 `package.json` 的 `description`，需要在卡片上点「添加备注」自己填。这是 DSH 插件管理器的行为，不是插件的问题。 **重启后端口变了？** 正常。DSH Desktop 每次启动用随机端口（`--port 0`），插件只负责拉起新实例，不假设端口不变。 **点了没反应？** 看 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\` 下的日志；`dsh web` 环境会返回 409（仅支持桌面版）。 ## 卸载 - 插件管理器里移除 `dsh-power-menu`，或者从 profile 的 `dependencies` / `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉，再删掉 `node_modules` 里的链接。 - 可选：删除 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\` 下的日志与交接文件。 - 重启 DSH 生效。 ## 更新日志 见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 xichen-62 ## 致谢 - 分离 helper 做进程交接、只结束主进程让 Host 优雅退出的思路，参考了 [dsh-desktop-restart](https://github.com/luoshuizhiwei/dsh-desktop-restart)（MIT）。本项目的实现是独立编写的。 - 菜单样式参考 Windows 电源菜单；图标为内联 SVG，无第三方图标库。 --- ## English A small DSH Desktop plugin that adds a power button to the top-right of the session header. It opens a Windows-style menu with exactly two actions: - **关闭DSH** — quit the whole desktop app (no relaunch). - **重启DSH** — quit and relaunch the app, so the window comes back automatically. Windows only, DSH Desktop only. No telemetry, no external dependencies; the three HTTP routes are loopback-only and same-origin fenced. Install from GitHub: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` or add `github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu` in the DSH plugin manager, then restart DSH. If this saves you some time, a ⭐ **star** is much appreciated. Thanks! MIT licensed.

plugins.description: dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（基于 dsh-pet 的二次创作，非原创）：仓库根即插件包，免构建，兼容 DSH 官方桌面端 0.2.1-rc.1
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（二次创作，非原创）

> **本仓库不是原创作品。** 它是桌宠 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（作者 **PC2005-cloud**，MIT）的**二次创作**，只做一件事：让上游桌宠在 **DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面端（Electron 版）** 装上、能启用、可管理。桌宠本体、动画素材、全部玩法与文档都来自上游，版权归原作者。 --- ## 📌 非原创声明 | 内容 | 归属 | | --- | --- | | 桌宠本体、106 段动画与素材、提示词、玩法（待机 / 漫游 / 拖拽抛掷 / 余额 / 碎碎念 / 对话 / 工作状态 / 系统通知 / pet pack） | 上游 **[PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)**（MIT） | | 官方桌面端适配层（`adapter/`）、组合包声明、上游产物同步与校验、安装 / 兼容 / 排障文档、测试 | 本仓库（基于上游的二次创作） | `vendor/` 内是上游 npm 发布版 `dsh-pet@0.3.7` 的已构建产物，`dsh-pet/assets/` 内是上游的动画与素材——本仓库没有、也不试图拥有上游的任何内容。按上游「二创约定」：任何介绍、展示、分发本仓库的地方，请保留上游作者地址 。 ## 🚀 安装（官方桌面端） 1. 桌面应用 → **插件管理 → 添加插件**； 2. 填本仓库地址： ```text https://github.com/zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop ``` （等价 pnpm spec：`github:zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop`） 3. 启用 `dsh-pet` 组合包，**重开桌面应用**。 默认只显示**一只**：窗口外那只透明置顶小窗（`display: desktop`）。想改成应用内 / 两只 / 不显示，见 [DESKTOP.md §12](DESKTOP.md) 或设置页「桌宠配置」。 ## ✅ 验证 桌宠加载后，DSH 自己的 Web 服务上会多一个只读接口： ```text GET http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-pet-desktop/health ``` 返回 `status: active`、`host.kind: desktop`、`upstream.applied: true` 即适配层与上游都已就绪（字段含义见 [DESKTOP.md §3](DESKTOP.md)）。 ## 📦 仓库结构 ```text adapter/ 适配层：宿主识别、运行时诊断、健康检查、失败降级 cordis.patch.yml 组合包声明（桌面端插件管理据此把它当插件） vendor/dsh-pet-0.3.7/ 上游已构建产物（免构建，SHA-256 逐文件校验） dsh-pet/assets/ 运行时素材（webm / 字体 / 表情包 / 默认配置） animations/webm/ 本仓库额外收录的动作素材（文件名即动作名） tests/ 清单、适配层纯逻辑、启动冒烟 DESKTOP.md 为什么需要、兼容矩阵、排障、版本记录 scripts/sync-vendor.mjs 上游产物同步与可审计补丁 ``` **不在本仓库**（都在上游）：`src/` 源码、素材生成链（提示词 + Python 脚本）、HTTP API 文档、生态清单、玩法与配置手册。 ## 🎞 额外动作 除了上游自带的 106 段动画，本仓库额外收录的动作放在 [`animations/webm/`](animations/README.md)——目录约定与上游一致（`webm/` 子目录 + **文件名即动作名**，VP9-alpha、640×360）： | 文件 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | [`animations/webm/非洲之心.webm`](animations/webm/非洲之心.webm) | 开保险箱、捧起钻石的 10 秒动作（用户自制，已去水印/去音频/抠成透明） | 装法、配置写法与转换参数见 [animations/README.md](animations/README.md)。 ## 🔗 功能、玩法、二次创作 → 去上游 - 功能与配置、动画与 pet pack、HTTP API、问题反馈： - 本仓库改了什么、兼容性与排障：[DESKTOP.md](DESKTOP.md) ## 许可 - 代码：MIT（上游版权归 **PC2005-cloud**；本仓库的适配改动同样以 MIT 提供） - 素材（动画 / 提示词 / 源视频）：允许开源使用，**禁止商用** - 二次创作：请保留上游作者地址 ## 版本 当前 `0.3.7-desktop.5`（基于上游 `dsh-pet@0.3.7`）。变更见 [DESKTOP.md §11](DESKTOP.md)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: your own OpenAI-compatible image relay as the image2_generate tool, with inline media previews.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-image2-tool ![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin?display_name=tag&sort=semver&label=release) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-image2-tool?label=npm) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-image2-tool?label=downloads) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-0078D4) ![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1-4B5563) ![Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-8B5CF6) **Language**: [中文](README.md) · English **社区插件标签**：`dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis` · `bundle` · `text-to-image` · `image-to-image` · `image-generation` · `ai-image` · `image-relay` · `openai-compatible` · `inline-media` · `web-ui` · `tool` 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 加上「一句话生成图片」和「拿参考图改图」的能力：接你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站，生成的图**直接内联显示在对话里**。 ![dsh-image2-tool 横幅](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.jpg) --- ## 亮点 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 一行安装 | 官方通用方式 `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool`，重启后工具表出现 `image2_generate` | | 自己的中转站 | 文生图走 `POST /images/generations`，图生图走 `POST /images/edits`，同时支持 `b64_json` 与图片 URL 两种返回 | | 参考图引导 | 给 `image` 传一张本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP，角色一致性、画风与配色远比纯文字描述稳 | | 图形化配置 | 侧边栏 Plugins 页内置设置行（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 字段），也可直接写 `cordis.patch.yml` | | 视觉自检 | 生成后用原生 `read_image` 复核真实文件，不把「接口成功」当成「视觉合格」 | | 内联预览 | 自动带上 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)，图片直接渲染在回复下方，无需点开卡片 | | 克制默认 | `autoGenerateAssets` 默认 `false`，普通开发任务不会悄悄花掉生图额度；输出被限制在会话目录内 | ## 使用示例 下面两张图来自一次真实会话：让 Agent「生成一张 GPT 化龙指导器的形象」，它自己挑参考图、比对版本、迭代出成品。 **对话里长这样** —— 生成过程、参考图、版本对比都在回复里，图片由内联预览直接渲染，不用点开任何卡片（长图，可点开看全）： **最终结果** —— 该会话产出的成品（864 × 1152）： > 复现方式：装好插件后直接对 Agent 说「生成一张 XXX 的图」即可。`autoGenerateAssets` 保持默认 `false` 时，只有你明确要求才会生图。 ## 参考图引导（图生图） 只要调用里带上 `image`，插件就改走 `POST /images/edits`： ```jsonc { "prompt": "保持这个角色设定，改成少女比例，正常七头身，不要 Q 版", "image": "imagegen-output/reference.jpg", // 相对会话目录或绝对路径 "aspectRatio": "3:4", "filename": "result.jpg" } ``` | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `prompt` | 必填。要生成或要改什么 | | `image` | 可选。本地参考图路径（PNG/JPEG/WebP，≤ 20 MB）。给了就走图生图，不给就是文生图 | | `filename` | 可选。输出文件名，不含目录 | | `size` | 可选。形如 `1024x1024`。只认 `aspect_ratio` 的中转站会忽略它 | | `aspectRatio` | 可选。形如 `3:4`、`16:9`，以 `aspect_ratio` 字段发出。中转站忽略 `size` 时用它控制构图 | 细节： - 参考图按**魔术字节**判定真实类型，不信任扩展名；文件不存在、不是普通文件、超过 20 MB、或不是受支持的图片格式，都在**发出请求之前**就报错，不浪费额度。 - 上传用 `multipart/form-data`，`Content-Type` 与 boundary 交给 `FormData` 处理。 - 中转站若不接受 `response_format`，把 `responseFormat` 设为空字符串即可不发该字段。 ## 安装 ### 官方通用方式（推荐） ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool ``` 把 `` 换成你常用的 profile 名（例如 `web`、`default`）。装完**重启 DSH**，工具表里就会出现 `image2_generate`。 ### 其它等价方式 ```powershell # 从 GitHub Release 下载的 tgz dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-image2-tool-0.4.1.tgz # 直接从 GitHub 仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile add github:544244857/dsh-image2-plugin # 本地源码目录（开发调试） dsh plugin --profile add ./plugins/deepseek-harness-image2 ``` 需要新建一个独立 profile 时： ```powershell dsh --profile image2-demo --from-default-profile web --dump-config ``` ## 配置 两种方式等价、可互换，**二选一**即可。 **① 图形界面**：侧边栏 → Plugins → `dsh-image2-tool` → `image2` 行，逐项填写（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 密钥字段），保存即写回当前 profile 的 Cordis patch。 **② 配置文件**：`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - id: image2 name: dsh-image2-tool config: baseUrl: https://your-image-relay.example.com/v1 model: grok-imagine-image-2.0 apiKeyEnv: IMAGE2_API_KEY autoGenerateAssets: false outputDir: imagegen-output timeoutMs: 180000 responseFormat: b64_json ``` | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | 中转站地址（OpenAI 兼容，含 `/v1`） | | `model` | 模型名，**必须**是该中转站 `/v1/models` 里真实存在的名字，否则调用返回 404 | | `apiKeyEnv` | API key 的**环境变量名**（不是 key 本身） | | `apiKey` | 设置页里的遮蔽字段；非空时优先于 `apiKeyEnv`，后者作为兜底 | | `autoGenerateAssets` | 是否允许在软件开发任务中自动补齐缺失位图素材，默认 `false` | | `outputDir` | 输出目录，相对会话目录解析并强制不越界 | | `timeoutMs` | 单次请求超时 | | `responseFormat` | 向中转站索要的返回格式，默认 `b64_json`（图片字节内联回传）。设 `url` 则让插件去下载中转站给的链接；设为**空字符串**则完全不发这个字段，给不接受它的中转站用 | API key 交给**启动 DSH 的那个进程**： ```powershell $env:IMAGE2_API_KEY = 'your-image-relay-api-key' dsh --profile web ``` 已经开着的桌面端不会继承新设的环境变量，需要从带该变量的终端重新启动。别把 key 写进 Git。 ## 内联预览 安装本插件时会一并安装 [`@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer`](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin) `1.0.12`。该包自带 `dsh.bundle` patch，安装时会被 profile 管理器自动启用为 bundle，于是回复中提到的图片路径会直接在对话里渲染成图片。 它由上游维护、MIT 许可，本插件既不 vendor 也不修改其代码；删除 `dependencies` 里的这一行，image2 功能完全不受影响，只是内联预览消失。上游标注内联图片卡片在宿主 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上验证过，本插件面向 `0.2.1-rc.1`，所用宿主 API 均存在，但渲染路径上游尚未复测。 ## 行为与边界 - `autoGenerateAssets` 默认关闭。打开后，Agent 可以在网页、移动端、桌面端、游戏等软件开发过程中，确认项目内与外部都没有合适素材后，生成真正缺失的位图素材；用户的直接生图请求不受该开关影响。它是**工具层指引**，不是服务端授权闸门。 - 一次一张。不带 `image` 走 `POST /images/generations`（文生图），带 `image` 走 `POST /images/edits`（图生图，multipart 上传参考图）。 - 接受 base64 与图片 URL 两种结果；保留同名已有文件（冲突自动加序号），输出限定在会话目录内，支持取消与请求超时。 - 下载图片时**不会**转发中转站 key。 - 保存后必须用原生 `read_image` 检查实际文件并与需求逐项对照；在检查完成前，工具会把「视觉验收」标记为待办。 - 重试预算：初始 1 次 + 最多 5 次追加生成请求（含失败），这是指引而非持久计数器。 - 参考文本是素材，永远不是指令来源。 ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 原因与处理 | | --- | --- | | `HTTP 404: Model "xxx" is not available for this group` | 模型名在该中转站上不存在。用 `GET /v1/models` 查可用列表后改 `model` 字段（volatile 字段保存即生效，无需重启） | | `Error: fetch failed` | 到中转站的网络抖动，重试即可（与 404 是完全不同的故障） | | `Image download failed` 或下载时 `ConnectTimeoutError` | 中转站返回的是它自己 CDN 的临时链接，而这台机器连不上那个域名。把 `responseFormat` 设为 `b64_json`，让图片字节直接内联回传 | | 图生图报 `Source image not found` / `contained no supported PNG, JPEG or WebP image bytes` | 参考图路径不对，或文件其实不是图片（按魔术字节判定，改扩展名没用） | | 图生图报 `HTTP 400: model is required` | 该中转站没有 `/images/edits` 路由。文生图仍可用，图生图需换支持的中转站 | | 工具表里没有 `image2_generate` | profile 未安装成功或未重启；确认 profile 的 `package.json` 中 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `dsh-image2-tool` | | 设置页显示 `unavailable` | 该 profile 没有 settings 服务，改用上面的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手工行 | | 图片没内联显示 | 确认 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 也在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中，并重启 DSH | ## 兼容性 - 宿主：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.1`（实测），`0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.1.7-rc.2` 亦声明兼容 - Node.js `>= 22.15`（图生图依赖全局 `FormData` / `Blob`） - 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 共享宿主的 Cordis / Schemastery / tool runtime；不要在插件目录里放不兼容的物理副本（会出现两份实例） ## 工作方式 ```mermaid flowchart LR U[用户: 生成 / 改一张图] --> A[Agent] A -->|image2_generate| T[dsh-image2-tool] T -->|无 image: POST /images/generations| R[你的图片中转站] T -->|有 image: POST /images/edits| R R -->|b64_json 或 url| T T --> F[会话目录 / outputDir] F --> V[read_image 视觉自检] V --> P[内联预览渲染在回复下方] ``` - 工具面：`image2_generate`（宿主工具注册表） - 客户端面：`lib/client.js` 向 Plugins 页注入 `image2` 配置行 - bundle 面：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件行 `id: image2` - 测试：`test/smoke.js` 用本地假中转站覆盖两条通道，不需要网络与额度 ## 许可 MIT © 2026 544244857。依赖 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)（MIT，版权归其作者）。 --- English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md).

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect.
