[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Wake the agent when a directory changes, with the diff and without the echo of its own writes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folderwatch

**Wake the agent when the filesystem changes — not when you remember to look.**

An agent can already be woken on a clock (scheduled tasks) and on an HTTP request (webhooks). Neither covers the case that actually matters mid-session: something *outside* the conversation touches a file. A build finishes. A formatter rewrites the tree. A test runner drops a report. A download lands. A colleague pushes into a shared folder. Today the agent finds out only if it happens to look.

`dsh-folderwatch` arms a directory against the agent that armed it. When the tree changes, the agent receives an exact account of what changed — and can either be woken to act on it or simply find it waiting at its next step.

```
[folderwatch] 3 changes under /work/shop/reports
watch: reports · 14:02:11
1 created · 1 modified · 1 deleted
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
(4 events suppressed as this session's own writes)

Read the new report and summarise what failed.
```

## Why it is not just `fs.watch` and a callback

Three decisions separate a watcher you keep armed from one you uninstall after an afternoon:

### 1. Snapshots, not raw events

`fs.watch` reports that *something* happened, not *what*. It double-fires on Windows, sometimes reports no filename at all, and silently drops events under load. A watcher built directly on it tells the agent "something changed" — which is not enough to act on.

This plugin takes **snapshots and diffs them**. Renames, deletions and bursts are classified correctly on every platform, and each change arrives with its size. `fs.watch` is kept only as a *hint to rescan sooner*; the periodic rescan is the correctness path.

### 2. Echo suppression

A watcher on a directory the agent is editing has an obvious failure mode. The agent writes `src/app.ts`, the watcher fires, the agent is told `src/app.ts` changed, it reads the file it just wrote. That one settles — but a build, a formatter or a test runner the agent *itself* started keeps writing, and each write wakes the agent again. The result is a loop that burns tokens and reads as if the workspace were under attack by a stranger.

So tool calls that name a file are recorded in a short-lived ledger, and changes to those paths inside the window are counted as **suppressed** rather than delivered. The window is deliberately short (`echoWindowMs`, default 2500ms): a file the agent wrote ten minutes ago changing *now* is real news.

The suppression is visible rather than silent — every batch reports how many events it filtered, so you can tell "nothing happened" from "the agent did it itself".

### 3. Delivery is opt-in per watch

| mode | call | effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wake` *(default)* | `agent.followup(message)` | starts a new turn |
| `queue` | `agent.inject(message)` | waits for the agent's next step |

A watcher that can always interrupt is a watcher nobody leaves armed. The quieter option is one argument away, so you can arm a watch for a whole session without handing it the power to interrupt you.

## Install

```
dsh plugin add https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-folderwatch
```

From a checkout instead of a git host, pass the absolute path:

```
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-folderwatch
```

The package declares no `dsh-*` peer dependency on purpose: it imports only `node:*` plus `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, all of which the harness resolves from its own installation. Nothing is bundled that could shadow the host's copy.

To tune it per profile, add a `config` block to the row the installer inserted in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: folderwatch
      name: 'dsh-folderwatch'
      config:
        quietMs: 400
        cooldownMs: 5000
        watches:
          - path: E:/work/reports
            label: reports
            pattern: '**/*.json'
            prompt: Read the new report and summarise what failed.
            mode: wake
```

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `watches` | `[]` | Watches armed at load time. Arming from a session with the tool is the usual path. |
| `ignore` | build/VCS/dependency dirs | Ignore patterns applied to every watch, merged with each watch's own list. |
| `quietMs` | `400` | Quiet period before a batch is delivered. |
| `maxWaitMs` | `5000` | Ceiling on how long changes may wait for quiet, so a never-quiet tree still reports. |
| `cooldownMs` | `5000` | Minimum gap between deliveries for one watch. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `1500` | How often the tree is rescanned. |
| `maxWatches` | `16` | Maximum number of simultaneously armed watches. |
| `maxEntries` | `20000` | Snapshot entry cap, guarding against a runaway tree. |
| `echoWindowMs` | `2500` | How long a path stays suppressed after this session writes it. |
| `maxEventsPerMessage` | `60` | Events listed in one notification before truncation. |

## Tools

### `folderwatch_add`

Arm a watch. Returns the arm report, or the reason it could not be armed.

| argument | type | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string *(required)* | Directory to watch. Absolute, or relative to the workspace. |
| `label` | string | Short name shown in listings and notifications. |
| `prompt` | string | Instruction appended to each notification, e.g. `re-run the failing test`. |
| `pattern` | string | Glob selecting which paths are reported, e.g. `**/*.log`. |
| `ignore` | string[] | Extra ignore patterns for this watch. A bare name like `tmp` matches at any depth. |
| `recursive` | boolean | Descend into subdirectories. Defaults to `true`. |
| `once` | boolean | Disarm after the first delivery. Defaults to `false`. |
| `mode` | `"wake"` \| `"queue"` | Delivery mode. Defaults to `wake`. |
| `sessionId` | string | Session to notify, when it is not the calling one. |

```
dsh-folderwatch · armed "reports"
  root:      /work/shop/reports
  watching:  12 file(s), 3 directories (recursive)
  pattern:   **/*.json
  ignoring:  node_modules, .git
  deliver:   wake the agent (followup)

Changes are reported in batches after the tree goes quiet, and this session's own writes are filtered out.
```

### `folderwatch_list`

The inventory: what each watch is watching, how often it has fired, and whether anything is pending.

```
dsh-folderwatch · 2 watches
  reports  running  12 file(s)  2 delivery(ies)  last fired 1m ago
    /work/shop/reports  [**/*.json]
  inbox  stopped  12 file(s)  0 delivery(ies)  never fired
    /work/shop/inbox
    3 change(s) pending delivery
```

### `folderwatch_check`

Rescan now and report what changed **without delivering a message**. This is how you answer "has anything happened yet" during a turn instead of waiting to be woken.

```
dsh-folderwatch · check "reports" · 3 change(s) since the last scan
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
  (4 further event(s) were this session's own writes)

This was a check: the snapshot advanced and no message was delivered.
```

### `folderwatch_fire`

Deliver a watch's pending changes immediately instead of waiting for the quiet period. Useful to confirm the delivery path works, or when a batch is known to be complete. When nothing is pending, it says so and sends nothing.

### `folderwatch_remove`

Disarm a watch and release its filesystem handles. Reports what it delivered while armed.

```
dsh-folderwatch · disarmed "reports"
  root: /work/shop/reports
  delivered 2 batch(es) over 7 event(s) while armed
  filtered 4 event(s) that were this session's own writes
```

## Slash command

```
/watch                                              # inventory
/watch add ./reports --pattern '**/*.json'          # arm, waking the agent
/watch add ./build --queue                          # arm, waiting for the next step
/watch add ./inbox --once                           # disarm after the first delivery
/watch check reports                                # rescan without delivering
/watch fire reports                                 # deliver now
/watch rm repor

# 🛡️ dsh-permission-rules - **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Project-based session dashboard and cross-session inbox for DeepSeek Harness Web
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Research Hub · 研究指挥中心

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub)](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/latest)
[![License: BSD-3-Clause](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-BSD--3--Clause-blue)](LICENSE)

把分散的 DSH 会话组织成项目工作台。集中处理问题与交付结果，直接回复，并在会话与指挥中心之间往返。

这是独立的第三方插件，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。当前公开版本为 **v0.1.1**，已在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web profile** 验证。DSH 的预发布接口可能变化，其他版本不作兼容承诺。

## 功能

- **常驻收件箱**：首页集中显示跨项目问题与交付。紧急优先，同级按入箱时间排序。空箱仍显示，查看不会自动关闭待处理状态。
- **项目总览**：等宽瀑布流减少空位，保持项目排序与键盘访问顺序。每张卡片显示最近更新的三个会话，以及两条待处理摘要。
- **原地处理**：文本回复、结构化选项作答、交付查收、忽略、重开。Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交回复。
- **会话导航**：点击标题打开会话。会话头部的“指挥中心”按钮回到此前页面。
- **自动归属**：从项目根目录发现项目。手动锁定绑定优先于会话自报，再以标题及首条消息推断归属。无法判断的会话进入未分配区。
- **高效分拣**：建议归属、就地创建项目、指挥中心专属回收站。回收站只隐藏会话，不删除 DSH 会话本身。
- **范围过滤**：排除子代理、空白会话、已归档会话和回收站会话。归档状态跟随宿主推送。
- **主题适配**：亮暗主题、自然卡片高度、按面板实际宽度切换分栏、明确焦点和减少动画支持。

## 安装

### 推荐：安装 GitHub Release 的预构建包

从 [Releases](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/latest) 下载 `.tgz` 和 `SHA256SUMS`。安装包包含编译后的 host、client 与 bundle patch，不需要在用户机器编译。

```bash
curl -fL -O https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-external-dsh-research-hub-0.1.1.tgz
curl -fL -O https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/download/v0.1.1/SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

在 DSH 的插件管理界面使用安装包的绝对路径或下列 tarball URL 安装并启用 bundle：

```text
https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-external-dsh-research-hub-0.1.1.tgz
```

若界面没有插件安装入口，参见下方 CLI 方法。**只安装到可信的本机 DSH 环境。插件可读取会话标题、项目文件和消息，并可向会话发送回复。**

### CLI 方法

先停止目标 Web profile，再安装预构建包：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-external-dsh-research-hub-0.1.1.tgz
```

DSH 会自动将 bundle 追加到目标 profile 的 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。可以检查该数组是否包含 `@dsh-external/dsh-research-hub`。**不要额外把相同插件手动插入 profile patch**，避免重复装配。

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@dsh-external/dsh-research-hub"]
    }
  }
}
```

以上仅示意字段位置。保留原有 bundle 数组项，不要整段覆盖 profile。安装机制见 [DSH 官方打包与安装说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.zh.md)。

重新启动 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。指挥中心入口位于侧栏图标区。实际 profile 名不同于 `web` 时，替换上述命令中的名称。

GitHub 源码快照不含 `lib/`，不能替代 Release 安装包。当前未发布 npm 包，不要使用 npm 包名安装。

## 配置

配置字段：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `projectsRoot` | `DSH_RESEARCH_HUB_PROJECTS_ROOT` 环境变量，否则为启动 DSH 的工作目录 | 自动发现项目的根目录 |
| `storeFile` | profile 目录内的 `research-hub.json` | 指挥中心持久化文件 |

推荐启动时指定项目根目录：

```bash
DSH_RESEARCH_HUB_PROJECTS_ROOT="$HOME/projects" dsh web
```

插件会将根目录本身登记为项目，并扫描含 `paper.toml` 或 `.git` 的直接子目录。也可以在界面新建项目。插件不包含作者个人项目注册表、会话记录或机器路径。

## 会话工具

```text
hub_register(project, note?)
hub_post(type, title, body?, priority?, project?)
```

- `hub_register`：会话声明所属项目。`project: "auto"` 请求自动推断。
- `hub_post`：`type` 为 `question` 或 `deliverable`。`priority` 为 `normal` 或 `urgent`。
- `ask_user_question`：宿主自动镜像结构化问题。会话作答后同步关闭镜像，不必重复投递。
- 子代理不调用这些工具。子代理结果直接汇报给父会话。

## 数据与安全

- 数据只保存在当前 DSH profile 的本地 JSON 文件中。没有外部分析服务，不上传会话数据。
- 快捷回复通过宿主控制器执行，效果等同于用户在目标会话中输入。
- HTTP 路由位于 `/rhub/api`，只接受回环 Host 的 POST 请求。不是面向公网的 API。
- 建议仅通过 loopback 或 SSH 隧道访问 DSH。当前不支持远程自定义域名或反向代理 Host。
- API 和本地状态包含会话标题、问题与回复。不要把 profile 状态文件提交到仓库。
- 删除插件前先备份 `research-hub.json`。取消归档或从回收站恢复后，会话重新显示。

## 源码开发

需要 Node.js 24.11+、npm、bash 和已安装的 DSH。运行环境已验证 Node.js 24.4.1，但构建依赖声明要求 Node.js 24.11+。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub.git
cd dsh-research-hub
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm run build:client
npm test
npm run test:package
npm pack --ignore-scripts
```

构建脚本会探测全局 DSH 安装。非全局安装时，用 `DSH_ROOT` 或 `DSH_CHECKOUT` 指向含依赖的 DSH 包根目录。脚本不含固定绝对路径，不覆盖既有依赖目录。宿主侧只依赖 DSH 提供的同名 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，不装入另一个 Cordis 运行时。

`npm run test:package` 在临时目录解包、检查 gzip 完整性、bundle patch、入口文件和敏感路径，并验证 host/client 可加载。

浏览器回归需要已有的 `react`、`react-dom`、`esbuild`、`playwright-core` 和 Chromium：

```bash
BROWSER_TEST_MODULE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/browser-test-project/package.json \
  node scripts/client-home.browser.mjs
```

测试使用真实 client bundle 与模拟宿主，不读写真实收件箱。覆盖亮暗主题、四种屏宽、瀑布流填空、动态高度、面板缩放、回复、查收、选项作答与跳转返回。

## 已知边界

- DSH 预发布版本之间接口可能变化。目前只验证 0.2.0-rc.2。
- AUQ 仍在前台工具等待窗口内时，结构化回答可能不可用。文本回复可作为备用。
- 新安装后标题缓存需要后台补齐。后续刷新使用持久化缓存。
- 自动推断可能归错项目。界面手动绑定会锁定归属。
- 当前未接入 npm 或官方公共插件目录。分发渠道是本仓库的 GitHub Releases。

## License

plugins.description: DSH Tavern 长局后续提醒插件：记录约定、托办与来信，到时间提醒正文
plugins.readme_text: # Knock Knock · 敲敲门 **DSH Tavern 插件。长局里，让故事推动过的事按时找上门。** 后续提醒 · 控制频率 · 不替你做主 · 后台记账 · 三种日历 [安装](#快速开始) · [看看实际效果](#看看实际效果) · [史事写法](史事条目写法.md) · [反馈](#交流与反馈) · [DSH Tavern](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern) - **不断线**：寄出的信、托人打听的事、约好的日子、答应别人的事，自动记下；到了时间敲一下门，告诉正文一次；过期还没下文，再敲一次。 - **不刷屏**：每件事最多敲两次，每轮最多 3 件；当天的零碎小事只记不提；两次没人应就放手，正文以后再提起会自动重新打开。 - **不替你做主**：只说“按理该有动静了”，到了、迟了、路上丢了由正文决定；主角答应的事只让相关的人问一句，不替主角去办。 - **后台记账**：每轮正文结束后在后台记账，通常可利用阅读和输入的时间完成；下一轮开始时若尚未完成，会先等待。建议选择较快、成本较低的模型，耗时随模型、正文长度和网络情况变化。 - **三种日历**：支持古风日历、公历和故事天数；记账前过滤已识别的选项、小剧场、状态栏等非正文内容。不同卡和预设的适配效果仍需实测。 ![面板：今日、台账、设置](images/banner.png) ## 没有插件 vs 敲敲门 | | 没有插件 | 敲敲门 | | ------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | | **寄出去的信** | ❌ 长局中可能忘记来信，后续未被接上 | ✅ 按路程估好时间，到时候提醒正文：可以送到，也可以交代路上耽搁 | | **约好的日子** | ❌ 日期到了可能无人提起 | ✅ 前一天提醒，过了还没动静再提一次 | | **答应别人的事** | ❌ 玩家也可能忘记 | ✅ 「今日」页提醒你；正文里相关的人会问一句，怎么办由你决定 | | **远方的人** | ❌ 远方人物的后续可能被忽略 | ✅ 不看在不在场，时间到了，消息照样找上门 | | **模型记错了** | ❌ 缺少独立台账核对 | ✅ 每条都附正文原话，代码逐字核对；台账可改可删，你确认过的模型改不动 | | **提醒的分寸** | ❌ 提醒频率取决于卡和预设 | ✅ 每件事最多两次，每轮最多 3 件，小事只记不提；只是表态的“意向”只记不提 | ## 功能特色 ### 到时间敲一下门 记下的每件事都有一个“该有动静”的时间：约好的日子、按路程估的回信时间、上司限的期限。到了这个时间，下一轮的请求里会多一段提醒，正文看到后可以在这一轮或之后几轮安排；过期仍没下文，再提一次；之后算“没下文”放下。正文实际看到的是这样一段： ``` 【敲敲门·该有动静的事】（截至二月初四）以下事情按时间该有后续了。可视情形在这一轮或之后几轮安排：到了、迟了、出了岔子都可以；不必硬插进当前场景： · 苏先生的回信（按路程约在正月三十至二月三十间可到；苏先生；原话「信经运河寄往杭州」）：可视情形安排送到，或交代路上耽搁 · 崔掌柜代寻旧刻（约 正月底，已过 4 日未见下文；崔掌柜；原话「正月底给相公回话」） · 主角答应的事：高梁桥踏青（期限 二月初五；沈恪）：沈恪可以问一句；主角怎么办由玩家决定，不要替主角去办 结果不预设，消息传到主角需要合理途径；不要替主角做决定，不要为呼应这里而新造原文没有的约定、期限或后果。 ``` ### 今日：下一轮会敲哪些门 「今日」页列出下一轮会提醒正文的事、主角眼下该办的事。主角的事可以一键填进输入框，也可以标“已办”或“延后三天”。 ![今日：等你决定、主角的事、下一轮会提的事](images/today.png) ### 台账：记下的每一件事 全部未了结的事按“已过期 / 三日内 / 更远 / 无日期”分组，每条附正文原话。改日期、改分量、冻结、延后、删除都在这里。 - **意向**：“可以帮你留意好砚”这种表态，记成意向，只记不提，过一阵没动静自然放下；后来说定了会自动转正。 - **确认无误**：点过确认的事，模型想改期、取消，要你点「照改」才生效；你手动改过的也算确认。 ![台账：按时间分组，可确认、改期、标为意向](images/ledger.png) ### 三种日历，开局自动判断 | 日历 | 什么卡 | 日期写法 | |---|---|---| | 古风 | 卡的变量里有古风日期（如“万历十五年二月初五”） | 二月初五、腊月底 | | 公历 | 变量或正文里有公历日期（如预设摘要里的 `2024-05-31`） | 5 月 31 日（周五）、下周三 | | 故事天数 | 都没有 | 第 45 天；提醒里写“3 天后”“两三个月后” | 时间按这个顺序取：卡的变量 → 正文里的日期标记 → 正文里的“时间流逝：3 小时” → 模型估计这一轮过了多久。“三年后”这样的大跳跃也能跟上。 ### 记账前先清洗正文 思考、序言、选项、小剧场、摘要、状态栏、记忆闪回、MVU 指令都会先去掉再记账，减少把选项里的“约她明天去看电影”误当成约定的情况。别的预设另有这类块，可以在设置里补上标签名。 ### 自动档，完成模型设置后使用 档位默认「自动」，提醒的范围、何时记账都由插件定；想细调就切到「自己调」。记账用的模型由你选，用的是本局后台模型时会提醒一次。 ![设置：自动档位、记账模型、日历](images/settings.png) ### 诊断与导出 每轮记了什么、用了多久、时间来自哪里，都在「诊断」页。出了问题点「导出数据」，把文件发给作者就行。已经玩了很久的局，点「从历史重建台账」，读最近若干轮整理出还没了结的事。 ![诊断：每轮耗时、时间来源、导出数据](images/diag.png) ### 史事（古风卡，可选） 给插件一份“历史事件表”：到了日子事件发生，按地点和路程，消息过些天传到主角耳边，之后进世界书条目池。写在卡内世界书里（标题以 `[敲敲门·史事]` 开头、设为禁用），或放进插件的 `packs` 文件夹。[写法 →](史事条目写法.md) ## 看看实际效果 两种皮肤：「古风（宣纸 · 朱砂）」和「跟随 DSH 主题」。 预览图用插件自己的面板代码和一份虚构的示例数据渲染：万历年间一局，主角林知远。 ## 快速开始 **目标环境**：DSH Tavern 2.6 或更新，需提供插件接口第 2 版。作者此前主要在 2.6 环境使用；本次发布整理未重新验证各宿主版本，更新版本的兼容性以实际运行结果为准。 1. **[下载最新版](https://github.com/dearacknowl/dsh-tavern-knock-knock/releases/latest)**，解压后把整个 `dsh-tavern-knock-knock` 文件夹放进 Tavern 数据目录下的 `plugins` 文件夹。桌面版通常是 `…\profile-data\tavern\data\plugins\`，放好后应有 `…\plugins\dsh-tavern-knock-knock\package.json`。 2. **完全重启 DSH**：托盘图标右键 →「退出」，确认任务管理器里没有残留进程，再重新打开。只关窗口或刷新页面不够。 3. 进一局游戏，右侧栏会出现「敲敲门」面板。到「设置」里给「记账用的模型」选一个便宜、快的小模型，就可以开始玩了。 **卸载**：删除这个文件夹，重启 DSH。 **更新**：用新版文件夹整个替换旧的，重启 DSH。台账保存在每局的插件存档里；更新前请先导出存档备份。本次发布整理未重新验证升级和回退行为。 ## 交流与反馈 - **[DSH Tavern 讨论区 · Show and tell](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)**：使用经验、建议、问题都欢迎。 - **[本仓库的 Issues](https://github.com/dearacknowl/dsh-tavern-knock-knock/issues)**：反馈故障。 反馈故障时，到「诊断」页「导出数据」，把文件附上。默认不含正文；勾选「附上正文」便于查漏记，但文件里会有你的剧情原文，分享前请检查。 ## 已知限制 - 记账可能漏记，也可能把条件建议误记为约定；本次发布未提供统一口径的准确率评测。错的可以在台账里改或删。 - 公历、故事天数两种日历是新加的，实测还少，欢迎用不同的卡试试。 - 史事只读得到**卡内**的世界书；单独挂载的世界书文件，DSH 目前没有给插件读的接口。 - 在 DSH 里给一局“开分支”后，分支里可能每轮都报“找不到本轮正文 operation”。该现象的原因尚未在本次发布中确认；可先回到原局检查，并附诊断信息反馈。 ## 隐私 插件只把本轮正文发给你选的记账模型；台账存在这一局的插件存档里，随存档导出、随回退和重新生成自动对齐。除了调用你选的模型，插件不访问别的网络，也不读其他局。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) ## 本次发布核验范围 本次仅核对发布文件、文档引用及安装包一致性，未重新进行宿主实机验收；预览图为示例数据渲染，不代表新增运行测试。

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | # dsh-useful-tools · DSH 有用小工具箱

小工具集合插件。**mark_read** 让指定命令（cat/grep/head/sed/awk…）读过的文件自动算已读，
解决官方原生 write/edit 的「cannot modify "…": file has not been read」门禁误伤
（内容明明已经用 grep/脚本等方式看过，原生写仍要求先用 read 工具读一遍）。

## 功能

| 工具 | 参数 | 简介 |
|---|---|---|
| `mark_read` | `commands` `undo` | 配置**读命令集合** + **自动标记钩子**（两者是同一功能）。`commands` 写命令串 / 传文件路径 / 不传用预置清单（`lib/core/mark-read/read-commands.json`）；`undo:true` 撤销。**两种读法都算**：① 宿主工具（如 `grep` 工具）；② `bash` 里跑的命令（`cat a.txt`、`grep x b.txt`）。跨平台别名归一：`Get-Content`/`gc`/`type`/`more` → cat，`Select-String`/`sls`/`findstr` → grep。集合里的命令执行后，钩子（`tools/post-execute`）自动把它读过的**所有文件**补发观测，不用指定文件；配置落盘 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`、每次现读 ⇒ 配置一次永久有效 |
| `quick_command` | `action` `name` `command` `cwd` `description` `timeoutMs` | **快捷命令**：执行/管理 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/quick-commands.json` 里定义的命令。`action=run`（缺省，按 `name` 执行；同时传 `command` 会**先持久化再执行**，等效 add 后执行）/ `add` / `edit` / `delete` / `list`（列出所有名字+命令）。`cwd` 指定执行目录（缺省空 = 宿主进程 cwd）。**无内置预置**：定义完全来自该文件，首次是空表；重启 DSH 这类命令由使用方自己 `add` |
| `sync_plugin` | `write` `profile` `source` `dshHome` `pluginName` `register` | 把插件工作区代码同步到 profile 的 local-plugins。缺省 dryRun，`write:true` 真写；`register:true` 写 profile 的 dependencies + bundles 并注册；`dshHome` 缺省当前实例，指向测试环境即可装进去 |
| `minihost` | `action` `plugin` `port` `path` `method` `body` `services` | **后端模拟**：本地 mini 宿主，把插件服务端代码跑起来。`action=start`（启动）/ `stop`（停止）/ `status`（状态）/ `call`（请求）；`services` 可注入宿主服务（插件依赖 storageDomain/sessions 等真实服务时用） |
| `preview` | `action` `plugin` `spec` `out` `file` `port` `backend` `host` `lan` | **前端模拟**：插件预览页。`action=gen`（生成，无 spec 时自动挂载插槽组件）/ `serve`（启动，`backend` 可反代真实后端或 minihost；`host=0.0.0.0` 或 `lan:true` 监听局域网并返回 `lanUrl`）/ `stop` / `status` |
| `verify_plugin` | `plugin` `source` `profile` `log` | 验证任意 DSH 插件是否装载成功、工具是否注册（只静态分析，不执行插件代码）。`plugin` 传插件名或根目录，缺省巡检所有已装插件 |
| `test_env` | `action` `kind` `version` `root` `force` `plugin` `pluginName` `dir` `dshBin` | 测试环境（隔离实例）：`action=create`（创建）/ `start`（启动）/ `stop`（停止）/ `status`（状态）。独立 DSH_HOME + 自动端口，随便崩不碰主实例 |
| `useful_tools` | `action` `tool` | **本插件工具清单**（动态扫描 `lib/shared`，不维护硬编码列表）：`action=help`（缺省，输出每个工具的名字/说明/参数/示例调用）/ `list`（紧凑清单）；`tool` 可选，只看某一个工具 |

## 用法

```
mark_read commands: "cat,grep,head"        # 加入读命令集合（持久生效）
mark_read                                   # 不传 commands = 用预置清单（20 个常见读文件命令）
mark_read commands: "<命令清单文件路径>"      # 从文件读命令集合（每行/逗号一个）
mark_read commands: "grep" undo: true       # 撤销 grep（从集合移除）

verify_plugin plugin: "dsh-git-push"        # 验单个插件（也可传插件根目录）
verify_plugin                               # 巡检所有已装插件

quick_command restart                       # 执行预置 restart（重启 DSH，当前连接会断）
quick_command list                          # 列出所有快捷名 + 命令
quick_command add name: "logs" command: "tail -n 50 <日志路径>"          # 新增定义（落盘）
quick_command run  name: "logs" command: "tail -n 20 <日志路径>"         # 先持久化（新增或更新）再执行
quick_command edit name: "logs" command: "..."                          # 修改已定义命令
quick_command delete name: "logs"                                       # 删除定义
quick_command run  name: "logs" cwd: "/var/log"                         # 指定执行目录（只对本次生效）

useful_tools                                  # 列出本插件所有工具（名字/说明/参数/示例）
useful_tools action: "list"                   # 紧凑清单
useful_tools tool: "quick_command"            # 只看一个工具
```

`mark_read` 的语义是**配置「哪些命令算读」**，不是逐个标记文件：集合里的命令执行后，
它读过的**所有文件**自动补发观测（`tools/post-execute` 钩子），不需要指定文件——要指定文件直接 `read` 就行。
集合落盘到 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`，钩子每次现读，所以**配置一次、永久有效**（改完即时生效、重启仍在）。

`verify_plugin` 给三项证据，专治「装完插件发现工具没出现」：

1. **装配结构**（静态读源码）：入口是否存在、是否导出 `apply`、是否有 tools 注册调用、
   `apply` 顶层是否 `return {`（cordis 会判 `Invalid effect` 并卸载整条 fiber，工具全部失效）、
   `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有顶层 `- insert:`。入口用 `export *` 转出的会跟进去看。
2. **部署一致性**：源码根 vs profile 的 local-plugins/node_modules 副本逐文件比内容，
   不一致说明宿主跑的不是你改的代码。
3. **宿主日志**：扫 `did not activate` / `TypeError` 等行；日志早于源码最后修改时间的
   判为修复前的历史记录，降级为提示。

只读文件、不 import 被验证插件——插件模块顶层和 `apply` 都可能带副作用，验证不该把它跑起来。
代价是「注册是否真的成功」仍需宿主内实测（工具是否真的出现在工具清单里），输出里的 `staticOnly`/`notes` 会标注这一点。

## 前后端模拟链路

`minihost` 是**后端模拟**，`preview` 是**前端模拟**，两者通过 `serve` 的 `backend` 参数串成一条链，
全程不碰真实后端：

```
minihost { action: "start", plugin: "<插件根>", port: 31177 }          # ① 起后端（插件服务端代码）
preview  { action: "gen",   plugin: "<插件根>" }                        # ② 生成前端预览页（无 spec 时自动挂载插槽组件）
preview  { action: "serve", file: "<插件根>/assets/preview.html", backend: "http://<本机IP>:31177" }
                                                                        # ③ 起前端，/api/* 打到 ①
minihost { action: "status" } · preview { action: "status" }            # 查状态
minihost { action: "stop", port: 31177 } · preview { action: "stop", port: 31188 }
```

### minihost 的两个细节

- **路由匹配只看路径**：`/api/xxx?fromIndex=true` 按 `/api/xxx` 匹配，query 留给 handler 自己解析
  （旧实现拿含 query 的完整 URL 比对，任何带参数的接口都会 404）。
- **宿主服务注入**：插件接线依赖真实服务（`storageDomain` / `sessions` / `workspaceRegistry` 等）时，
  传 `services` 指向一个模块——该模块默认导出一个「服务对象」或「返回服务对象的函数」，注入项覆盖同名默认服务：

```
minihost { action: "start", plugin: "<插件根>", port: 31177, services: "<插件根>/test/api/helpers/fake-services.mjs" }
```

`backend` 也可以指向真实 DSH 后端（如 `http://<本机IP>:30800`），此时是「前端模拟 + 真实后端」。

## 测试环境（隔离实例）

起一个与主实例完全隔离的 DSH：独立 `DSH_HOME`、独立端口（3083-3182），里面随便装插件、随便改、随便崩。

```
test_env { action: "status" }                                    # 看两个环境（test/clean）是否存在/运行
test_env { action: "create", plugin: "<插件根>" }                # 创建 <工作区>/<版本>@Save-test 并把插件装进去
test_env { action: "start",  plugin: "<插件根>" }                # 创建（若无）并启动，返回端口
test_env { action: "stop" }                                      # 停止（按端口记录找进程 TERM）
```

`plugin` 可选：给了就把该插件复制进 `profiles/web/node_modules` 并注册到 bundle 列表；不给就是纯裸环境。
环境根优先级：参数 `root` > 环境变量 `DSH_TEST_ENV_ROOT` > 插件配置 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json` 的 `testEnvRoot` > 推算（`DSH_WORKSPACE` / `DSH_HOME` 上一级「工作区」）。**不写死路径**，部署方按配置决定位置。

配合 `sync_plugin` 可以把插件同步 + 注册进这个隔离环境（`dshHome` 指向环境目录即可，缺省是当前实例）：

```
sync_plugin { write: true, register: true, dshHome: "<环境目录>" }
```

## 快捷命令（quick_command）

定义存 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/quick-commands.json`，形如：

```json
{
  "restart": {
    "command": "nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; \"/path/to/start.sh\" restart' >/dev/null 2>&1 &",
    "description": "重启 DSH 主实例"
  },
  "logs": { "command": "tail -n 50 /path/to/dsh.log", "description": "看最近日志" }
}
```

- **无内置预置**：文件不存在时是空表（`list` 返回 `count:0` 并提示用 `add`），定义完全由使用方创建。
  例如本机重启 DSH：
  `add name:"restart" command:"nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; /var/packages/DeepSeekHarness-NAS/target/start.sh restart' >/dev/null 2>&1 &"`
  （后台化以免重启杀掉进程后拿不到结果；该形态仅 Linux/macOS，Windows 换对应重启命令）。
- `run` 只执行 JSON 里已定义的命令；**同时传 `command` 时先写入 JSON（新增或更新）再执行**，不是临时执行。
- `cwd` 指定执行目录：缺省空 = 沿用**宿主进程的 cwd**（不一定是当前工作区）；
  传了会校验「存在且是目录」，并解析成绝对路径。`add`/`edit`/`run` 带 `command` 时随定义落盘，
  `run` 单独传 `cwd` 只对本次执行生效、不改已有定义。
- 执行走 `bash -c`（Windows `cmd /c`），默认超时 60 秒，stdout/stderr 各截断 20000 字符。

## 配置（`<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`）

```json
{
  "observeHook": true,
  "observeTools": ["cat", "grep", "head", "sed", "awk"],
  "testEnvRoot": "<可选，test_env 的环境根>"
}
```

- `observeHook`：自动标记钩子总开关（默认开）
- `observeTools`：读命令集合——**填什么、什么就生效**；钩子每次现读，改动即时生效无需重启
- 也可以直接用 `mark_read` 工具改这个集合（`commands` 加入 / `undo` 撤销）
- 预置清单：`lib/core/mark-read/read-commands.json`（20 个常见读文件命令）

## 语义与边界（实测结论）

- 观测**有效到文件版本再变为止**：版本不变一直放行；文件被任何一方改动后，
  原生写改为报 `file changed since it was read — re-read the file, then retry`，重新标记即可。
- 官方 read 带 offset/limit 只看几行同样算读过 ⇒ 把 grep 纳入与宿主自身尺度一致，不算放权。
- **bash 里跑的命令也算读**（0.1.13 起）：钩子解析命令串（`cat a.txt`、`grep x b.txt`），
  命令名在集合里就标记其文件参数；跨平台别名归一（`Get-Content`/`gc`/`type` → cat，`Select-String`/`sls`/`findstr` → grep）。
  已知边界：`xargs`、`$(...)`、`for` 循环里的文件参数提取不到（启发式解析）。
- 单次钩子调用最多标记 40 个文件（防全仓 grep 观测风暴）。

## 安装

DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2+。装好后需重启 DSH 生效（工具与钩子在启动时装配）。

本插件只注册工具，不提供斜杠指令（原因与恢复条件见契约 C-204）。

## 文档

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | 门面：简介、工具表、用法、配置、安装、目录结构、版本记录 |
| `docs/CONTRACT.md` | 契约：命名 / 装配 / 部署 / 依赖 / 验证 / 测试 / 版本的硬约束，实现与验收的唯一依据 |
| `docs/NOT-DONE.md` | 未实现能力与原因（预览页截图 / 自包含快照 / shell 启动器），含未来若做的形态 |

## 目录结构（目录即工具名 · 一个文件夹一个工具）

```
lib/
├── index.js                 装配入口：扫描 lib/shared/* 动态注册（工具名取文件夹名）
├── shared/                  工具适配层 —— 新增工具只需新建一个文

# dsh-context

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**上下文长度管理**插件：实施方案 + 可直接安装的最小骨架。
插件包名 **`ctx-mon-and-con`**（目录 `plugin-skeleton/`）。

> A context-length management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a design document plus a minimal, installable plugin skeleton.

## 这是什么

DSH 已经内置了完整的上下文管理底座——计量（`ctx.tokenMeter`）、压缩 seam（`ctx.compaction`）、
工具结果裁剪（`ctx.toolResultPruner`）、会话投影（`ctx.sessionProjections`）。
本仓库不重新造压缩，而是把「**插件应该在哪一层介入、怎么介入、有哪些红线**」讲清楚，
并给出一个能装在 Desktop 里的最小实现：宿主半侧的 `/ctx` 监控面板，加上挂在 agent preset 内、
按上下文自动压缩的 `ctx-mon-and-con/control` 控制半侧。

## 仓库结构

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/context-length-plugin-plan.md`](docs/context-length-plugin-plan.md) | 完整实施方案：请求组装链路、四条介入路线（L0 配置 / L1 观察 / L2 裁剪 / L3 换后端）、可抄的 patch 片段、安装验证、红线清单 |
| [`plugin-skeleton/`](plugin-skeleton) | 可安装插件：宿主半侧 `/ctx`（监控 + 会话级上下文覆盖）与 `settings.section` 面板；控制半侧 `control.js` 挂进 agent preset 后按上下文自动压缩。含 32 项静态检查、43 项 Cordis 冒烟、33 项控制测试 |
| [`research/arch.md`](research/arch.md) | DSH 插件机制调研：三层结构、Host 插件形态、`dsh` 清单字段、patch DSL、客户端 slots、安装与 HMR |
| [`research/context-core.md`](research/context-core.md) | 上下文/压缩子系统调研：请求组装、token 计量、压缩服务与事件协议、默认后端配置、五条内容变换通道、真实装配层 |
| [`research/sample-plugin.md`](research/sample-plugin.md) | 参考实现分析：`billion-context` / `dsh-bloom-theme` / `dshmarket`，以及第三方插件的模块解析结论 |
| [`docs/market-submission.md`](docs/market-submission.md) | 为什么在插件市场里搜不到、收录规则逐条核对、已实测的安装命令，以及还差的三步 |
| [`submission/`](submission) | 可直接复制进收录 PR 的条目文件 `qiangweiliu__dsh-context--plugin-skeleton.yml` |
| [`scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1`](scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1) | 实测「安装 → 生效 → 卸载 → 无残留」：快照对比、残留分类、`-Clean` 清理通用残留 |
| [`scripts/ui-probe.mjs`](scripts/ui-probe.mjs) | 无头浏览器（Windows Edge + CDP）实测 UI：打开设置、点开「上下文长度」、执行 `/ctx`，抓控制台错误 |
| [`scripts/ui-probe-ctx.mjs`](scripts/ui-probe-ctx.mjs) · [`ui-check-dock.mjs`](scripts/ui-check-dock.mjs) · [`ui-check-inventory.mjs`](scripts/ui-check-inventory.mjs) | 实测侧边栏 `ctx` 整页、面板改上下文/一键启用压缩、输入框 ctx 指示器，以及工具/提示词开关（会话生效 + 全局持久化） |
| [`scripts/wsl-install.sh`](scripts/wsl-install.sh) · [`scripts/wsl-uninstall.sh`](scripts/wsl-uninstall.sh) | 在 WSL 的 DSH profile 里安装/卸载并核对残留（含运行时探针说明） |

## 快速开始

先把 `plugin-skeleton/` 装进你的 profile（二选一）：

```powershell
# A. 由 agent 调用 plugin_manager 工具
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "C:\\path\\to\\dsh-context\\plugin-skeleton" }

# B. 命令行（把 <dsh> 换成你的 dsh 启动器完整路径）
& <dsh> plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-context\plugin-skeleton"
```

重启 Desktop，然后在会话里：

- 发 `/ctx` —— 显示当前会话的 `总用量 / 上下文 / 百分比 / 状态`
- 发 `/ctx 200000` —— 把**本会话**的上下文临时改成 200000 tokens；`/ctx reset` 恢复默认
- 左侧导航的 **`ctx`** —— 整页控制面板：用量/上下文/控制状态、可编辑的全局配置、一键启用自动压缩
- 输入框下方常驻 **`ctx 上下文 …`** 指示器（按插件上下文算百分比，不改 DSH 自带 HUD）
- **工具与提示词清单**：每个工具/提示词 section 可分别用「会话 / 全局」开关决定是否参与请求
- 设置 → **上下文长度** —— 同一块面板
  （装完必须**重启 dsh 进程**；只刷新页面不会加载新插件）

到达上下文后自动压缩需要把控制半侧挂进 agent preset（否则插件只做监控）：

```yaml
- id: ctx-mon-and-con-control
  name: 'ctx-mon-and-con/control'
  config: { mode: idle }
```

详情见 [`plugin-skeleton/README.md`](plugin-skeleton/README.md)。

也可以直接从 GitHub 安装（等价于插件市场上架后的安装命令，已实测可装可启动）：

```powershell
& <dsh> plugin --profile desktop add "github:qiangweiliu/dsh-context#path:/plugin-skeleton"
```

插件市场（dshmarket）目前搜不到本插件：市场只收录 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 精选目录里的条目。
原因与收录步骤见 [`docs/market-submission.md`](docs/market-submission.md)。

卸载与残留实测：`& <dsh> plugin --profile desktop remove ctx-mon-and-con`，
详见 [`scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1`](scripts/verify-uninstall.ps1) 与 [`plugin-skeleton/README.md`](plugin-skeleton/README.md#卸载与残留实测)。

## 关键结论（写插件前先看）

1. **没有请求中间件**：messages 由会话日志派生并冻结；改变历史的合法通道只有压缩协议（`surfaceOp: { op: 'replace' }`）与 `tool/result` replace + 影子价。
2. **Web 形态下自动压缩实例在 preset 里**：`dsh-web-app` 把宿主平面的 `compaction-basic` 置为 `disabled`，真身挂在 `preset-standard` 的 `cordis:group` 内，bundle 层按 id 打不中；调参必须整段覆盖 `preset-standard`（patch 是整体替换，不深合并）。
3. **第三方插件不能裸 import `@deepseek-ai/*`**：宿主包在 `app.asar` 内，只由 DSH 自己的 loader 解析。要么零 import（只用 `ctx` 服务 + 手写 Standard Schema），要么用 esbuild/tsup 打包进产物。
4. **token 计量是固定 4 字符/token 的启发式**：中文与 JSON schema 严重低估，阈值要留 headroom。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Desktop notifications for DSH Desktop that actually speak: Windows TTS out of the box, VOICEVOX voice packs optional, and an idle gate that waits for subagents before saying 'done'.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify-desktop

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Desktop 用的通知插件：**任务跑完会说话**。

> 别的通知插件"叮"一声；这个会喊你"主人、任务完成了"。
> 而且**子代理还在跑的时候，它不会骗你说完成了**。

---

## 它解决什么问题

你让 AI 跑一个较长任务，然后切去干别的。常见两种通知插件的毛病：

1. **该响的时候不响** —— 主会话一轮结束就报"完成"，但其实它派出的子代理还在跑，你回来发现没干完。
2. **不该响的时候一直响** —— 每个子代理结束都弹一次，连环轰炸。

本插件的做法：

- **空闲门（idle gate）**：主会话这轮结束、但仍有子代理或后台任务在跑时，**先不播**；等全部结束再播**一次**。超时（默认 10 分钟）兜底，防子任务卡死导致永不播报。
- **按会话去抖**：同一会话 60 秒内只响一次。
- **失败单独提醒**：回合出错时播**日语道歉语音**（可选），比"任务完成"更该让你立刻知道。

---

## 特性

| 特性 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **语音播报** | 本地 wav，不联网、不调用云端 TTS。发布版附 1 个音色，其余可按需下载 |
| **空闲门** | 有在飞工作时不误报"完成"，全部结束才播一次 |
| **五类事件** | 完成 / 出错 / 被拦截 / 待批准 / 要提问，各自独立开关 |
| **设置页 GUI** | 走官方 `Config` schema，DSH 设置页自动生成表单 |
| **命令行** | `tools/notify-config.ps1`，改完**立即生效、不用重启** |
| **点通知跳会话** | 点击 Toast 可直接回到对应会话（拿不到导航服务时自动降级为"唤出窗口"） |
| **不装语音也能用** | 没有语音包 = Toast + 系统提示音，这是正常配置 |
| **全离线** | 不联网、不发送任何会话内容 |

---

## 安装

### 前置

- DSH Desktop **0.1.7-rc.2 或更高**
- Windows（Toast 用 WinRT，播放用 MCI；暂不支持 macOS/Linux）

### 方式一：插件页（推荐）

在 DSH 的 **设置 → 插件** 里搜索 `dsh-notify-desktop` 安装。

### 方式二：手工 link（本地开发）

把本仓库目录链接进 profile：

```
D:\Program Files (x86)\DSH\profiles\desktop\package.json
  dependencies 里加:  "dsh-notify-desktop": "link:<本仓库路径>"
  dsh.profile.bundles 里加:  "dsh-notify-desktop"
```

然后在该 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

---

## 配置

三种方式，优先级由低到高（后者覆盖前者）：

```
1. schema 默认值
2. cordis.patch.yml 的 config
3. DSH 设置页里改的值
4. tools/notify-config.ps1 写的 storages/config.json
```

> ⚠️ **注意语义**：一旦你在设置页改过某项，再改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里同一项**不再生效**。
> 这是 DSH 官方设计（用户层优先级更高），不是本插件的 bug。

### 设置页

DSH **设置 → 通知**（由官方 Loader 从本插件的 `Config` schema 自动生成），共 12 项：

语音开关、音色模式（固定/随机）、音色名、音量，
以及完成/出错/被拦截/已中止/待批准/要提问/子代理/空闲门 八个开关。

### 命令行

```powershell
cd <插件目录>\tools

.\notify-config.ps1 -Show              # 看当前生效值
.\notify-config.ps1 -Voice off         # 静音（Toast 仍弹）
.\notify-config.ps1 -Volume 40
.\notify-config.ps1 -VoiceMode random
.\notify-config.ps1 -VoiceName ankomon
.\notify-config.ps1 -Disable aborted -Enable subagents
.\notify-config.ps1 -Clear             # 交还控制权给设置页
```

改完**立即生效**，不需要重启 DSH。

### 语音包管理

核心包只带**一个日语音色**（ずんだもん），体积约 2.8 MB。
完整多音色包体积较大（十余个音色约 40 MB），故不随包发布 —— 计划通过单独下载提供（尚未实现）。

```powershell
.\notify-config.ps1 -ListPacks         # 看已装哪些音色、各占多少
.\notify-config.ps1 -PurgeVoice <key>  # 删掉不用的音色
.\notify-config.ps1 -InstallHint       # 看怎么获取更多音色
```

**不装任何语音包也完全可用**：通知会退回 Windows Toast + 系统提示音。

想要更多音色，两条路：

1. **自己合成**：装 [VOICEVOX](https://voicevox.hiroshiba.jp/)（本地免费 TTS），启动引擎（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:50021`），
   然后按下面的命名规则把合成好的 wav 放进对应目录即可。
   （合成脚本不随本包发布——它依赖本地 VOICEVOX 引擎与特定音色表，放在发布包里只会误导。）
2. **手工放入**：把 wav 按下面的命名放进对应目录

```
sounds/voice-lines/<key>~1.wav            完成
sounds/voice-lines/question/<key>~1.wav   提问
sounds/voice-lines/approval/<key>~1.wav   审批
sounds/voice-lines/fail/<key>~1.wav       出错
```

---

## 兼容性与降级

本插件的首要目标是**稳定**，所以每个依赖外部能力的地方都有降级路径：

| 能力 | 拿不到时怎么办 |
|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（生成设置页） | 不导出 `Config` → **设置页不出现，插件照常工作** |
| `uiWorkspace.openSession`（点通知跳会话） | 不跳转，Toast 仍能唤出窗口（**退回旧行为**） |
| 语音包 | 回退系统提示音 |
| `$DSH_HOME` 未设置 | 配置走 patch 默认值；不写任何状态文件 |

**不会出现"静默失效"**：每个降级都有明确行为，并有测试锁定。

> 对比：某些插件写 `if (typeof sessions?.open === 'function') sessions.open(id)`，
> 而 `sessions.open` 在 0.1.7+ 已被移除 —— 该功能**静默失效，用户点通知没反应却无从察觉**。
> 详见 `CARD.md` 的 §零之二。

---

## 已知限制

- **仅 Windows**（Toast = WinRT，播放 = MCI，调用 Windows PowerShell 5.1）
- **设置页真实渲染尚未验证**（代码已就绪、schema 结构已测，但未在宿主里看过界面）
- **点通知跳会话依赖未文档化 API**（`uiWorkspace`），官方随时可能改；坏了会自动降级
- `blocked`（回合被拦截）只用系统蜂鸣，不播失败语音 —— 因为语义是"被拦下"而非"失败"
- **`fail` 语音包只覆盖 16 个基础音色**（103 个音色里的其余 87 个只有完成语音）。选到未覆盖的音色时，失败会在同池内换一个音色，不会哑掉、也不会播错语义

---

## 开发

```powershell
npm run test:all      # 101 条测试
npm test              # 主套件（route 测试会 skip）
npm run test:route    # 需要 --import loader 的 6 条接线测试
```

测试分九组：空闲门判定（20）、事件接线（12）、会话跳转降级（11）、配置持久化（11）、
语音包（10）、失败语音（10）、Config schema（8）、失败路由（6）、真实 Cordis（5）。

全部通过才算提交就绪；关键断言做过**变异测试**（故意改坏代码确认测试变红）。

---

## 许可

代码以 MIT 发布。
**语音文件不适用 MIT**，由 VOICEVOX 生成，各音色有其自身使用条款，
详见 [`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)。

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH MCP Installer

在 DSH「设置 → MCP 安装」中导入并管理 MCP 服务器，配置写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

## 快速开始

确认 npm 已可查询到该版本（首次发布完成后可用）：

```bash
npm view @equityq/dsh-mcp-installer version
```

普通 DSH CLI 用户可安装到 `web` profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @equityq/dsh-mcp-installer@1.0.1
```

将 `web` 替换为你实际使用的非 Desktop profile。安装后打开或重启该 profile，在 **设置 → MCP 安装** 中使用。

DSH Desktop 的 `desktop` profile 由 Desktop 自带的 DSH 命令管理。先启动 Desktop 初始化 profile，再在 Desktop 提供的命令环境中运行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @equityq/dsh-mcp-installer@1.0.1
```

不要用单独安装的通用 `dsh` CLI 管理 Desktop 的保留 profile。

## 管理 MCP 服务器

- **查看**：搜索服务器，查看连接状态、工具数、配置和来源。
- **添加**：粘贴配置、选择文件或输入网页链接，检查风险后安装。
- **编辑/删除**：仅支持当前 profile patch 中可唯一定位的服务器；其他来源请在所属配置层管理。

支持 JSON、YAML、TOML、Markdown、Claude/Codex CLI 命令和网页导入。支持 `stdio` 与 `streamable-http`，不支持 SSE。

示例：

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "."]
    }
  }
}
```

## 安全说明

- 导入的 env/header 值会写入 profile patch；敏感值建议使用 DSH 支持的 `!!js` 环境变量表达式。页面只显示键名，编辑时保留原值。
- 高风险命令或 URL 需要确认；网页导入会拒绝本机和内网地址。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm run typecheck
npm test
```

# dsh-model-picker · 模型速选器（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness 会话窗口右下角 **模型下拉框的左侧** 添加一个小按钮。
点击按钮弹出全量模型选择窗口：按提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、
真实能力标签、推理徽章、当前选中高亮，加载 / 失败 / 会话占用等状态都有清晰呈现。
**选择模型后立即回写模型下拉框并生效** —— 因为它与原生下拉框共用同一条
per-session 模型目录与 `selectModel` 提交路径（"任一端切换，另一端立刻显示"）。

## 效果

![模型速选窗口（深色主题，中文界面）](screenshot_zh.png)

![模型下拉左侧的触发按钮](button.png)

- **触发按钮**：28px 圆形图标按钮，紧贴模型下拉左侧，与 composer 工具栏
  「+」按钮同风格（悬停 / 焦点环 / 禁用态齐全）。
- **选择窗口**（居中弹窗，主题变量配色，深浅色主题自适应）：
  - **头部**：标题 + 提供商/模型计数 + 关闭；
  - **最近使用**：打开即见上次用过的模型（最多 8 个，自动记录、本地持久化），
    每行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    点一下即切回常用模型；
  - **提供商筛选**：搜索框左侧的自定义下拉（全部提供商 / 单个提供商），
    跟随主题渲染（不用原生 `<select>`，避免深色主题下系统面板惨白）；
  - **搜索**：模型名 / 模型 id / 提供商名模糊匹配，↑↓ 移动高亮、Enter 选中、Esc 关闭；
  - **列表**：按提供商分组（DeepSeek 账号 / 官方优先），分组带色条与计数徽章，
    每行显示 **完整模型名** + **能力标签** + 「推理」徽章 + 「当前」徽章 + 选中勾，
    大列表按需懒渲染（滚动才加载，打开更快）；
  - **底部**：当前模型摘要 + **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器** + 关闭按钮；
  - **状态**：加载中（spinner）、加载失败（重试）、提供商加载失败（逐条提示）、
    当前模型已不可路由（警告）、会话被占用（专用文案）。

### 能力标签是真实数据

行内的 `📝 文本` / `🖼️ 图像` 标签**不是**从模型描述文字里猜的，而是读
**用户自己配置里声明的 `input` 列表**（pi-ai 提供商配置，如
`providers.<id>.models[].input: [text, image]`）。实现走 DSH 已有的
`settings` Remote 读取 settings 文档，扫描各命名空间的 `providers → models[].input`
建索引；配置里没写 `input` 的提供商就不显示标签（如实反映配置，不做臆测）。
增删配置里的 `input`，标签随之变化。

> **契约说明（已验证）**：能力标签用 `group.id` 查询索引，而 `group.id` 与
> settings 中 `providers` 的**配置 key 同命名空间**（DSH 的 modelCatalog 以
> `provider.id` 作为分组 id、`provider.name` 作为显示名）。因此
> `providers.volcengine-agent-plan` 这类配置 key 能被可靠匹配；若未来 DSH
> 改变这一命名约定，标签会安静地不显示（不会报错），插件其余功能不受影响。

> **为什么只能从配置读（已验证）**：浏览器侧拿到的 `modelCatalog` RPC 返回的
> 模型对象**只有 `id` / `name` / `description` / `reasoning`，不含 `input`** ——
> DSH 的 Host 侧在构建浏览器目录时把 `input` 字段投影丢弃了（见
> `buildModelCatalog`）。因此插件无法从模型目录兜底读取能力，配置是浏览器侧
> 唯一的 `input` 来源。想给某个模型显示能力标签，就在 pi-ai 提供商配置里为它
> 写 `input`：
>
> ```yaml
> # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml，llm-pi-ai 提供商配置内
> models:
>   - id: deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731
>     input: [text, image]   # 声明后插件即显示「文本 / 图像」标签
> ```
>
> 这也解释了为什么**同一个模型 id 在不同用户那里标签可能不同**——它如实反映
> 各自配置，而非模型本身的客观能力。

## 工作原理

1. 注册进 composer 的 **`conversation.input.right`** slot —— 这是一个
   `kind: list`、`scope: session` 的官方扩展点，composer 栏在渲染模型
   seat（`conversation.input.model`）之前渲染它，因此按钮天然出现在
   模型下拉的**左边**。
2. 通过 `ctx.inject(['slots', 'modelDirectories'], …)` 拿到
   `ctx.modelDirectories`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`
   注册的共享服务），对当前会话解析出与原生下拉**同一个**
   `ModelDirectory` 实例。
3. 弹窗里选择模型 → `directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`
   → 走与原生下拉完全相同的 `selectModel` RPC。成功后共享 store 更新，
   原生模型下拉的标签**自动回写**，会话模型切换立即生效。
4. 能力标签由 `ctx.inject(['…', 'remote', 'remote.settings'])` 注入的
   `settings` Remote 读取：`settings.describe()` 返回各命名空间的合并配置，
   从中提取 `provider → model → input[]`。注意 **`remote.<namespace>` 必须显式
   写进 inject 列表**（cordis 规则），只注入根 `remote` 会在访问时报
   `cannot get property "remote.settings" without inject`。
5. 子代理（subagent addressed）会话没有模型目录，按钮自动隐藏。

## 安装

支持 **web 与 desktop** 两个 profile（`platform: web` 的插件在两者中均生效）。

### 方式 A：git clone 后本地安装（推荐）

```sh
git clone https://github.com/faxble/dsh-model-picker.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

把 `/path/to/dsh-model-picker` 换成实际 clone 路径；桌面版把 `web` 换成
`desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

安装后重启 DeepSeek Harness，在「设置 → 插件」中启用 `dsh-model-picker`，
或确认它已自动启用。

### 方式 B：远程直接安装（免 clone）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:faxble/dsh-model-picker
```

### 方式 C：手动加入 profile（开发者调试用）

1. 在 profile（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`）的 `package.json` 中：
   - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker": "file:D:\\Dev\\VibeCoding\\dsh-model-picker"`；
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker"`。
2. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-model-picker/
├── package.json        # 包元数据 + dsh.client 声明（platform: web）
├── index.js            # Host 半身（no-op，仅承载 bundle 行）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch：一行 insert（name 为裸包名）
├── client.js           # 浏览器半身：ModuleLoader bundle（由 src/ 构建）
├── install.ps1         # 安装脚本（web / desktop）
├── src/                # 源码（ES modules，开发用）
│   ├── dict.js         #   zh/en 文案字典
│   ├── pure.js         #   纯逻辑：排序/搜索打分/MRU/能力标签（单测覆盖）
│   ├── style.js        #   CSS（主题变量）
│   ├── icons.js        #   SVG 图标
│   └── entry.js        #   ModuleLoader bundle 入口（组件 + apply）
├── scripts/build.mjs   # esbuild 打包脚本
├── test/               # node:test 单元测试
└── README.md
```

## 说明

- 纯前端插件：**运行时无构建、无运行时依赖**（只用 shell 已提供的 `react`），
  全部颜色来自 DSH 主题 CSS 变量，切换深浅色主题无需重载。
  `client.js` 是构建产物，开发期用 `pnpm build` 从 `src/` 生成。
- 不修改任何 DSH 核心代码；`conversation.input.right` 目前没有任何占用者，
  注册不会遮蔽既有 UI。
- 界面文案**中英双语**，随 DSH 系统语言自动切换（zh / en），外国用户可直接使用。
- 附加功能：**最近使用（MRU）置顶**、**搜索打分排序**（精确 > 前缀 > 包含）、
  **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器**、大列表**懒渲染**、焦点陷阱等无障碍支持。
  - 最近使用行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    提供商名在模型左侧、本地化并浅灰次要显示，跨提供商时避免同名模型混淆。
- 主题取值注意：**不要用 `--dsw-alias-brand-text` 做选中行文字色** ——
  它的语义是"品牌色块**上**的文字"（浅色主题设计值），深色主题下解析为深色，
  配软高亮底会变成黑字看不清；文字统一用 `--dsw-alias-label-primary`。

## 开发调试

- 改 `src/` 后执行 `pnpm build` 重新生成 `client.js`，再复制到 profile 触发
  HMR 热更新（页面无需刷新，DSH 会检测到文件变更并重新加载 bundle）：

  ```powershell
  pnpm build
  Copy-Item .\client.js $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-model-picker\client.js -Force
  ```

- 单元测试：`pnpm test`（`node --test`，覆盖 `src/pure.js` 的纯逻辑）。
- 构建校验：`pnpm check`（`node --check` 产物）。**CI 会校验 `client.js` 是否为
  最新构建**，改了 `src/` 忘了 build 会让 CI 失败。
- 若要源码改动即时生效（免复制），改用 `link:` 符号链接方式安装。
- 移除插件：DSH「设置 → 插件」里卸载 `dsh-model-picker` 即可。

# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.
